Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, drop us a line.  We're bound to have just the thing for you.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From customer service representative to management, General Manager to Manager Corporate Operations or Franchisee, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

JOB REQUIREMENTS

You must be 16 years of age or older.

General job duties for all store team members

• Operate all equipment.
• Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.
• Prepare product.
• Receive and process telephone orders.
• Expedite orders to delivery and carryout vehicles.

• Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.
• Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions. Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the

phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).
• Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders.
• Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.
• Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to:

• Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.
• In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.
• Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

• Fumes from food odors.
• Exposure to cornmeal dust.
• Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.
• Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.
• Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

• Talking and hearing on telephone.
• Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.
• Depth perception.

• Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing: Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking: For short distances for short durations.

Surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

• Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.
• Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.
• Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

• Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.
• Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.
• Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

• To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24"- 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.
• Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

• Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.
• Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.
• Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.
• Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

• Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.
• Workers reach above 72"occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.
• Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.
• Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

• Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.
• Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.
• Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.
• Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.
• Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.
• Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Exposure to:

• Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product or distributing flyers and door hangers
• Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside - In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas

• Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts

Walking/Carrying/Climbing

Driving

Use safe driving practices to deliver products within a designated delivery area. Delivery drivers may make several deliveries per shift.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station. Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station. Talking and hearing on telephone. Depth perception as well as Near and mid-range vision required for most in-store tasks. Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces. Far and night vision required for driving

jobs.title: Delivery Driver(08630) 7229 N. Dale Mabry Highway
jobs.description:
Delivery Driver

It's more fun with us!

No one likes being bored at work, which is why a Domino's job is all about having fun! That's how we roll. So if you're looking for casual work or maybe something more permanent, our Delivery Driver position is the perfect way in.

It all starts with you

Domino's Pizza® loves Domino's people. Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential. In other words, we want you to be yourself, and as a Domino's Delivery Driver that's exactly what you can be. You'll enjoy your own space out on the road listening to a few tunes, and working your magic with our customers. And because we provide you with full training when you're not out there doing what you do best, you'll be able to help out your friends in-store. With variety like that, you'll never get bored.

Drive your own career

Being a Domino's Delivery Driver isn't your average pizza delivery gig. And the way Domino's works, it could be just the beginning. Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From delivery driver to management, general manager to franchisee, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

You'll find our Delivery Driver jobs offer you more. Yes, you'll be out on the road, but you'll also get to mix it up in-store, chipping in and having fun with the rest of the team. We'll train you up so you know your stuff, from deliveries to making pizza and everything in-between.

Domino's Delivery Drivers Must Be at Least 18 Years Old and Need:

· Friendly, positive attitude and great customer service skills

· Valid Driver's license

· Reliable vehicle to use for deliveries

· Proof of car insurance

· Safe driving record meeting company standards

· Possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings

Those are the basics, but here’s what else you can expect:

General Job Duties

· Operate all equipment

· Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler

· Prepare product

· Receive and process telephone orders

· Take inventory and complete associated paperwork

· Clean equipment and facility approximately daily

Communication Skills

· Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions

· Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person

Essential Functions/Skills

· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator)

· Must be able to make correct monetary change

· Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders

· Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed

· Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen

Work Conditions

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks

· In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas

· Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside

· Fumes from food odors

· Exposure to cornmeal dust

· Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler

· Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher

· Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts

Sensing

· Talking and hearing on telephone

· Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks

· Depth perception

· Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces

Temperaments

· The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions

Physical Requirements including, but not limited to the following:

Driving

· Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area, a Team Member may make several deliveries per shift

Standing

· Most tasks are performed from a standing position

Walking

· For short distances for short durations

Lifting

· Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck

· Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'

· Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72high

Carrying

· Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves

· Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store

· Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray

Pushing

· To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24- 30 and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push

· Trays may also be pulled

Climbing

· Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance

Stooping/Bending

· Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station

· Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station

· Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day

· Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients

Crouching/Squatting

· Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas

Reaching

· Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward

Hand Tasks

· Eye-hand coordination is essential; use of hands is continuous during the day

· Frequently activities require use of one or both hands

· Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists

Title: Outpatient Clinician (Bilingual Spanish)

Classification: Regular Full Time (1.0 FTE), Exempt

Regular Work Schedule: Full time, M-F

Our Outpatient Mental Health Services are uniquely suited to meet the needs of vulnerable and high-risk children, adolescents and families – particularly those involved in the Alameda County foster care system.

The Bilingual (Spanish) Outpatient Clinician sees clients at our Fruitvale clinic as well as in community settings, meeting the youth and families needs by centering their voice and choice throughout a collaborative treatment process.

As an Outpatient Clinician, you will work with a skilled team of mental health staff, including Intensive Care Coordinators, Case Managers, and other licensed (and license-eligible) clinicians on evidence-based collaborative treatment plans, psychosocial assessments, individual and family therapy, parent training, and provide ongoing support for the youth and families on your team’s caseload. Key Responsibilities:

• Maintain a clinical caseload of Spanish-speaking clients that meets productivity goals as set by the agency

• Provide individual therapy, family therapy, caregiver guidance, collateral contacts and case management in the clinic and community.

• Collaborate with other professionals within WestCoast and partnering agencies to ensure the highest quality of service to clients.

• Comply with WestCoast policies, procedures, and deadlines related to billing, clinical record keeping and timely, high-quality documentation

• Participate in agency wide trainings, specific program meetings, clinical supervision and case conference as required

• Work proactively with program leadership to ensure the strength of the program and completes additional tasks as requested

Qualifications and Competencies:

• Masters or doctoral degree in clinical or counseling psychology, social work, or marriage and family therapy (required)

• Bilingual in English and Spanish (required)*

• Minimum two years clinical experience in community mental health with emphasis on underserved and at-risk children and adolescents (preferred)

• Experience working with foster care, child welfare, court system, low-income and immigrant families in community mental health settings (preferred)

• Clinical training and experience providing trauma informed treatments to clients and families with complex trauma and attachment difficulties related to abuse, neglect, interpersonal and community violence, and foster care placement

• Sensitivity and awareness in dealing with issues of cultural competency, and experience working with diverse communities

• Clinical service skill – assessment/evaluation, clinical skills, crisis intervention, ability to use supervision effectively, ethical and legal responsibilities, high quality clinical documentation

• Ability to work effectively with clients who have complex, multiple diagnosis histories

• Efficiency and time management - ability to be well-organized and complete timely documentation

• Excellent interpersonal, communication and writing skills

• Knowledge of or ability to learn Medi-Cal documentation policies and procedures

• Collaboration and team functioning - able to work independently and collaboratively as part of a multidisciplinary team

• Ability to travel by car to meet with clients, generally within a 90 mile radius of the WCC office. Clean CA DMV record, current car insurance and a vehicle; travel is required.

*Spanish Language Proficiency Requirement

This is a bilingual Spanish/English position. Candidates must demonstrate advanced Spanish language proficiency in order to effectively provide services to Spanish-speaking clients and families.

• Medical and Dependent Care FSA and commuter plans

jobs.title: Manager, Technology Operations
jobs.description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...

Fulfillment Experience builds the capabilities and operating mechanisms that make Walmart a reliable, convenient on-demand partner. Our teams determine what customers can buy, the promise and fulfillment choices they see, how orders are managed and recovered, and how the network performs at scale. We partner across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Merchandising, Store Operations, Fulfillment Centers, Last Mile, Transportation, and Strategy to improve customer outcomes while balancing speed, assortment, cost, and operational feasibility.

Role summary

The (USA) Manager, Technology Operations identifies and solves complex, high-impact fulfillment problems across a defined product, operational, or customer-experience area. This role turns ambiguous customer, operational, and financial signals into a clear diagnosis, an aligned plan, and measurable results. Working across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, and operations partners, the Manager leads initiatives from discovery and analysis through decision, delivery, readiness, and impact measurement. Success requires structured problem solving, clear communication, sound business judgment, and the ability to influence without direct authority.

What you'll do

• Own a complex problem space or initiative that improves customer experience, fulfillment performance, or financial outcomes.

• Use customer, operational, and financial data to identify opportunities, quantify impact, isolate root causes, and define success measures.

• Translate ambiguous problems into clear problem statements, hypotheses, options, and data-driven recommendations.

• Lead cross-functional solution design and execution with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Store Operations, Fulfillment Centers, Last Mile, Transportation, and other partners.

• Build and manage end-to-end plans that make ownership, milestones, dependencies, risks, decision points, pilots, launch readiness, and success measures clear.

• Drive alignment and resolve trade-offs without direct authority; escalate issues with a clear recommendation when timely leadership decisions are needed.

• Create concise, executive-ready updates and decision materials that clarify what changed, why it matters, and the action required.

• Measure results after launch, identify gaps or unintended outcomes, and drive refinements, scaling, or corrective action.

• Improve the team's planning, visibility, and execution through better processes, tools, automation, and operating routines.

What you'll bring

• Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in eCommerce, supply chain, operations, product, strategy, analytics, or another fast-paced, data-rich environment.

• Strong structured problem-solving skills, including the ability to turn ambiguous issues into clear questions, synthesize disparate inputs, identify root causes, and recommend a practical path forward.

• Strong analytical fluency and comfort using data to form hypotheses, assess trade-offs, define metrics, and measure impact.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex work understandable and action-oriented for audiences at every level.

• Proven ability to influence without authority, build trust across functions, navigate competing priorities, and drive commitments to closure.

• Disciplined program-management skills, including planning, milestone management, dependency and risk management, and launch or change readiness.

• Sound customer, operational, and financial judgment; able to balance the ideal solution with what is practical to execute at scale.

• A high-ownership mindset, curiosity, attention to detail, and a bias for action.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience partnering directly with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to deliver technology-enabled business outcomes.

• Experience in omnichannel retail, eCommerce, fulfillment, supply chain, marketplaces, or a similarly complex operating environment.

• Working knowledge of SQL, BI and visualization tools, Jira, Airtable, or process-automation tools.

jobs.title: Account Executive, LE/GE, GTS
jobs.description:
About this role:

The Account Executive is a field sales role responsible for client retention and growth. Account Executives build trust-based relationships with C-Level Executives and their teams. They understand the mission-critical priorities of their clients and ensure clients receive the value from the Gartner relationship that they expect, while also identifying opportunities for stronger value delivery with alternative product offerings.

Account Executives will be given a territory of Large Enterprise clients.

In our End-User Large Enterprise segment, Account Executives work with clients who have +$1bil in annual revenue.

In our Tech Vendor Large Enterprise segment, Account Executives work with clients who have +$500mil in annual revenue.

What you will do:

• Drive value delivery with current Gartner clients, ensuring clients maximize the value they receive from their Gartner services
• Identify, cultivate, qualify and close client growth opportunities through cross-sell and upsell
• Continually build a pipeline of high-quality opportunities to deliver against your sales metrics, ensuring KPI’s are met.
• Quota responsibility for your assigned territory.
• Manage complex high-revenue sales across matrix and diverse business environments.
• Own forecasting and account planning on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis.

What you will need:

• 5-8+ years' B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments
• Experience selling to and/or influencing C-Level Executives
• Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets.
• Proven ability to own, manage, and forecast a complex sales process.
• Willingness to conduct travel as needed.
• Bachelor's degree preferred

What you will get:

• Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, and more!
• Uncapped commission structure
• World-class sales training programs and skill development programs
• Annual “Winners Circle” event attendance at exclusive destinations for top performers
• Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces inclusion
• Professional development and career growth opportunities

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 101,000 USD - 140,000 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. We also offer market leading benefit programs including generous PTO, a 401k match up to $7,200 per year, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount, and more.

The policy of Gartner is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

Gartner is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers, including job seekers with disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Company’s career webpage as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by calling Human Resources at +1 (203) 964-0096 or by sending an email to ApplicantAccommodations@gartner.com.

• Support prospecting and relationship-development efforts in partnership with internal and external sales colleagues across multiple regions.
• Complete administrative and data-quality tasks that improve business efficiency, including maintaining information in Salesforce CRM.
• Assist with business plan development, activity tracking, and performance reporting for senior team members and strategic relationships.
• Contribute to defined summer projects and North America Institutional initiatives focused on improving team reporting, communication, and overall effectiveness.
• Participate in team meetings, training sessions, and networking opportunities to build knowledge of Invesco, capital markets, and the retirement industry.

• A Launchpad for Your Career – Get ready to build real skills and set yourself up for a future at Invesco (and beyond).
• Your Own Mentor – You’ll be paired with a mentor who’s got your back, answers your questions, and helps you navigate your summer.
• Intern Community – Join a crew of fellow interns to collaborate, share ideas, and get to know—both in and out of the office.
• Pathway to Future Opportunities – Nail your internship, and you could be eligible for a full-time offer to join our Early Career Program after graduation!
• Real Experience, Real Impact – Work on meaningful projects, learn from our team, and see what it’s like to work at a global investment firm.

Minimum Qualifications

• Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree, with an interest in finance, economics, business, marketing, data analytics, or a related field, graduating in spring/summer of 2028.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
• Curiosity about capital markets, mutual funds, the retirement plan industry, and the U.S. institutional marketplace.
• A coachable mindset, willingness to ask questions, and desire to learn.
• Ability to manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and maintain attention to detail.
• Initiative and an entrepreneurial approach to identifying new or improved ways to support the team.

Full time

No

Pursuant to Invesco’s Workplace Policy, employees are expected to comply with the firm’s most current workplace model, which as of October 1, 2025, includes spending at least four full days each week working in an Invesco office. This reflects our belief that spending time together in the office helps us build stronger relationships, collaborate more easily, and support each other’s growth and development.

jobs.title: Senior Delivery Consultant, Professional Services - SAP
jobs.description:
Application deadline: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant specializing in VMware to AWS migrations. In this role you will work closely with customers to design, execute, and manage large-scale VMware estate migrations to AWS, delivering measurable business outcomes across every phase of the programme lifecycle. You will be a key player in driving customer success, providing technical expertise, migration best practices, and hands-on delivery leadership from initial assessment through production cutover.

With deep expertise in VMware environments and AWS migration services, you will lead enterprise data centre exit programmes spanning multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. You will assess VMware workloads through discovery tooling and application owner interviews, define migration strategies and target architectures, assign R-strategies across the portfolio, and design wave plans that respect dependency groupings, capacity constraints, and regulatory frozen zones. As a trusted advisor you will guide customers through risk mitigation, architecture decisions, and the organizational change that large-scale VMware exits require.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes on AWS. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives through a collection of offerings that help customers achieve specific outcomes related to cloud adoption and migration at scale.

What Makes This Role Different

VMware estates are not just infrastructure. They are the operational core of enterprise businesses built over decades. You will not be running a lift and shift. You will be designing the path from a legacy platform to a modern, cloud-native foundation, and making that transition invisible to the business. The complexity is real, the stakes are high, and the outcomes are permanent.

Key job responsibilities
Design and implement complex, scalable, and secure AWS target architectures for VMware workload migrations, covering compute, network, storage, and virtualization layers

Lead end-to-end VMware estate assessments using discovery tooling and application owner interviews, producing portfolio disposition recommendations with R-strategy assignments across rehost, replatform, refactor, retire, retain, and relocate

Define migration strategy and target architecture for VMware workloads, translating technical choices into business outcomes for executive audiences

Design and own wave plans including dependency grouping, capacity balancing, cutover sequencing, and multi-geography coordination under regulatory constraints

Apply AI-powered and agentic migration tools including AWS Transform, ModelizeIT, Kiro, and equivalent tooling to accelerate discovery, assessment, and migration execution at scale

Lead large delivery teams and matrix organizations, driving alignment across business and technology stakeholders throughout the program lifecycle

Partner with AWS Migration Services including Application Migration Service (MGN), Database Migration Service (DMS), and Migration Hub to execute migrations with precision and repeatability

Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout delivery, ensuring adherence to AWS Well-Architected principles and optimizing wave sequencing to minimize risk and business disruption

Act as a trusted advisor to customers on VMware licensing optimization, infrastructure modernization, and emerging AWS capabilities relevant to their environment

Share knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable migration artifacts, runbooks, and cutover playbooks that partners can execute at scale

Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- 10+ years of cloud architecture, solution implementation, or consulting experience with a focus on large-scale cloud migration and modernization programs
- Experience leading the delivery of large-scale, mission-critical enterprise IT and migration programmes including data center exits in a customer-facing role
- Deep hands-on experience with VMware environments including vSphere, vCenter, NSX, vSAN, and ESXi administration and migration
- Experience as the technical lead of large-scale migrations, defining migration strategy and target architecture, selecting the right approach for each workload, and translating technical choices into business outcomes for executive audiences
- Experience using AI-powered and agentic migration and modernization tools such as AWS Transform, ModelizeIT, Kiro, or equivalent to accelerate discovery, assessment, and migration execution at scale
- Hands-on experience with technology infrastructure including network, compute, storage, and virtualization
- Experience with wave planning including dependency grouping, capacity balancing, and multi-geography coordination under regulatory constraints
- Experience leading large teams and matrix organizations and driving alignment across business and technology stakeholders
- Experience with the software development lifecycle and agile and iterative delivery methods

Preferred qualifications:
- Work experience in financial services including banking, capital markets, payments, or insurance, with regulated workloads and compliance and security standards
- Deep knowledge of AWS services including EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, and VPC, and AWS migration services including Application Migration Service, Database Migration Service, and Migration Hub
- AWS Professional level certifications including Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional
- VMware certification including VCP, VCAP, or equivalent
- Experience with two or more migration domains beyond VMware such as SAP, Windows and SQL Server, database migrations including Oracle licensing and PostgreSQL, or mainframe
- Experience with infrastructure as code, automation, and scripting including Terraform, CloudFormation, Python, and PowerShell
- Experience with public, hybrid, and multi-cloud platforms including VMware Cloud on AWS
- Comfortable navigating ambiguity in complex multi-vendor environments with incomplete documentation and conflicting data sources while prioritizing needs and delivering measurable results
- Spanish language skills, written and spoken, are highly valued

jobs.title: Modern Engineering Apprenticeship, Prestwick, 2027 intake
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Our apprentices follow a three-year training programme, with day release college attendance. This is a full-time role, Monday-Friday.

Job Description

About GE Aerospace

Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft. You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives.  Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world!

Engineering is at the center of what we do, and we are looking for talented, innovative engineers who can help us design and develop products for today, tomorrow, and in the future. If you are a dreamer, doer, and inventor who wants your voice to be heard and see your ideas take flight, this is the opportunity for you.

Role description

The Engineering Apprentice will function under the overall guidance of the Apprentice Coordinator but also on a day-to-day basis be managed by the Team Leader / Supervisor in charge of the department where the Apprentices’ current training is taking place. For the duration of the Apprenticeship at GE Caledonian, you will gain practical experience and develop theoretical knowledge whilst obtaining formal qualifications, which are recognised and fully transferrable within the Aerospace industry.

Due to the broad range of engineering disciplines within GE Aerospace, engineering apprenticeships can encompass aircraft engine overhaul mechanics, CNC/ manual machinists, mechanical & electrical maintenance, mechanical inspectors and welders. The hiring manager will discuss this further with the relevant candidates during the recruitment process.

You will perform multiple aspects of maintenance and repair to the highest quality. Excellent communication skills are required, along with the ability to accurately follow work process instructions. You will have a keen sense of achievement and take pride in the work you undertake and produce. The ability to work efficiently within a team is essential.

You will:

• Adhere to GE Aerospace health & safety policy and safe working practices.

• Be highly self-motivated, be able to work in a small team and independently.

• Have good problem-solving abilities, able to think on your feet.

• Have basic PC knowledge of networking and communication.

• Be working to targets and deadlines.

• Be undertaking your qualification on jet engines.

• Be working with your team in the development and implementation of continuous improvement projects.

Qualifications/Requirements:

Performing Engineering Operations (PEO) at SCQF Level 5 Completed by July 2027

OR
Foundation Apprenticeship in Engineering Completed by July 2027.

• Team player, cooperative, interested in further personal and career development

• High degree of flexibility, highly motivated with the ability to work under pressure

GE Aerospace partner with Ayrshire College for training delivery, therefore we would recommend be living in an area commutable to the college.

Desired Characteristics

• Able to roll up your sleeves and get involved in projects

• Organised & able to work towards deadlines

• Inspired and curious to learn

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Able to take ownership for projects

• Analytical and problem-solving skills

• Proficient in Microsoft Office

• Able to work as part of a team

Recruitment Process

As part of our recruitment process, you will be required to submit an initial CV application. After this, the stages could include testing and assessment centre. Our recruitment team will be in touch with you at every stage to keep you updated and understand what is next in the process. Please ensure you review your emails (and junk folder) regularly as we will be communicating to you in this way and would not want you to miss vital messages.

If you require any adjustments to the process to enable you to be at your best, please email the team via Apprenticeship.Queries@geaerospace.com.

Please only submit one application. If you submit multiple applications, we will progress the most suitable one. If in future you are deemed to be suitable for other opportunities, we will automatically consider you for these too.

Please note our applications will close on Sunday 15th November but may close earlier dependent on application volumes. We would encourage you to apply as soon as possible to avoid disappointment.

Total Reward

At GE Aerospace we understand the importance of Total Reward. Our flexible benefits plan, called FlexChoice, gives you freedom, choice, and flexibility in the way you receive your benefits, as well as giving you the opportunity to make savings where possible.

As a new joiner to GE Aerospace, we are pleased to be able to offer you the following as default in your benefit fund, which you then can tailor to meet your individual needs.

• Non-contributory Pension

• Life Assurance

• Group income protection

• Private medical cover

• Holiday Hourly equivalent of 26 days, with flexible option to buy or sell

Security Clearance

Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) clearance is required and must be maintained for this role. Please note that in the event that BPSS clearance cannot be obtained, you may not be eligible for the role and/or any offer of employment may be withdrawn on grounds of national security. Please see the link below for further details regarding the requirements for BPSS clearance: BPSS

Right to Work

Applications from job seekers who require sponsorship to work in the UK are welcome and will be considered alongside all other applications. However, under the applicable UK immigration rules as may be in place from time to time, it may be that candidates who do not currently have the right to work in the UK may not be appointed to a post if a suitably qualified, experienced and skilled candidate who does not require sponsorship is available to take up the post. Further, sponsorship is not available for our Early Careers opportunities.  For further information please visit the UK Visas and Immigration website.

Whether we are manufacturing components for our engines, driving innovation in fuel and noise reduction, or unlocking new opportunities to grow and deliver more productivity, our GE Aerospace teams are dedicated and making a global impact. Join us and help move the aerospace industry forward.

jobs.description:
About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

08

The Team:

The team is comprised of ambitious, commercially minded people looking to start a career in Account Management. While reporting directly into the Regional Manager, Revenue Associates, the ADR will spend a significant amount of time working directly with a team of account managers who they will be supporting in the day-today.

Responsibilities and Impact:

The Account Development Representative is a critical entry point into our commercial organization and a core component of our centralized Revenue Associate Program. This role is designed for high-potential early-career professionals who are motivated to build a successful career in revenue generation. Through a structured onboarding, training, and rotational development program, Associates will gain deep product knowledge, client engagement skills, sales methodology, and commercial acumen preparing them to seamlessly transition into quota-bearing Account Manager roles upon successful completion of the program.

Associates will work alongside regional Account Managers and commercial leaders to drive client engagement, identify growth opportunities, and improve retention outcomes. This role is both developmental and impact-oriented: while learning, Associates contribute directly to revenue objectives through targeted outreach, pipeline generation support, usage expansion initiatives, and early-stage sales qualification.

This is not a support role, it is a launchpad. As an Account Development Representative, you will be directly contributing to revenue impact while building a long-term commercial career. You will have early exposure to client interactions, senior leadership, high-value accounts, and strategic growth initiatives that accelerate your advancement into a revenue-generating role.

This role serves as a strategic feeder for the next generation of revenue leaders. Associates will accelerate their understanding of financial markets, workflow solutions, and client needs while contributing to commercial performance from day one. At the culmination of the program, top-performing Associates will be placed into quota-carrying roles, equipped with the capabilities, confidence, and relationships required for success.

• Execute revenue-generating activities including prospecting, qualification, and expansion outreach across existing client accounts.
• Support Account Managers in renewal preparation, client communication, usage expansion campaigns, and identification of upsell/cross-sell opportunities.
• Engage directly with clients to understand workflows, uncover unmet needs, and position the value of S&P Global solutions aligned to commercial strategy.
• Manage outbound cadences using Salesloft, Salesforce, and CRM tools to build pipeline and advance opportunities.
• Conduct account intelligence research to prepare client meetings, evaluate whitespace, and assess risk indicators.
• Track and report progress on KPIs including meetings booked, opportunities created, usage expansion, client engagement scores, and renewal support.
• Participate in structured training covering product mastery, commercial negotiation, objection handling, and financial value articulation.

What We’re Looking For:

Basic Required Qualifications:

• Must be fluent in Spanish or Portuguese, with proficiency in both a strong plus to support our LATAM client base.
• Strong interest in financial markets, client engagement, and commercial career progression.
• Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
• Proactive self-starter with resilience, intellectual curiosity, and growth mindset.
• Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM tools; experience with Salesforce is a plus.

Additional Preferred Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
• Internship or experience in sales, account management, financial services, or client support.
• Demonstrated success in team-based or target-driven environments.
• Ability to analyze data and articulate insights for commercial actions.

We require all external candidates who reach the final stage of our interview process to attend at least one in-person interview, which is ordinarily at your nearest S&P Global office. This must be completed before we can proceed to an offer.

About S&P Global Market Intelligence

At S&P Global Market Intelligence, a division of S&P Global we understand the importance of accurate, deep and insightful information. Our team of experts delivers unrivaled insights and leading data and technology solutions, partnering with customers to expand their perspective, operate with confidence, and make decisions with conviction.

For more information, visit www.spglobal.com/marketintelligence.

What’s In It For You?

Our Mission:

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

Our People:

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

Our Values:

Integrity, Discovery, Partnership

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.

Our benefits include:

For more information on benefits by country visit: https://spgbenefits.com/benefit-summaries

At S&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasize fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain top talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive innovation and power global markets.

jobs.description:

Job Description & Summary

Our Cyber Risk & Strategy  team helps organization understand and manage the risks that come with using technology and digital services.​
​
We work with clients to answer practical questions such as: Are our most important systems sufficiently protected? Are the right controls in place? Where are the biggest risks, and what needs to improve? Are we meeting regulatory and industry expectations?​
​
As a Senior Associate, you will work at the intersection of business, technology and risk, taking ownership of key parts of client engagements. You will work directly with client teams, structure assessments, translate findings into practical recommendations and help junior colleagues deliver high-quality work

Core Activities: "What you'll be working on":

• Own parts of client projects: Take responsibility for defined workstreams, from planning and information gathering through analysis, documentation and finalrecommendations. ​
• Understand how clients manage technology risks: Review processes, policies and controls, speak with relevant stakeholders and identify where risks orimprovement opportunities exist. ​
• Translate requirements into practical actions: Help clients understand what regulations and industry standards mean for their organization and where changes maybe required.​
• Turn analysis into clear recommendations: Structure findings, explain their business impact and develop practical actions that clients can implement. ​
• Work directly with clients: Facilitate interviews and workshops, discuss findings and support client teams in resolving questions throughout the engagement. ​
• Support and develop junior colleagues: Review their work, provide guidance and help them build their consulting and cyber risk capabilities.​

Skills: "What you need to have"

Typically 3–6 years of relevant experience, for example in cyber or technology risk, GRC, IT audit, technology consulting, risk management or related fields. We are looking for people who can take a complex problem, structure it and turn it into a clear conclusion or recommendation. You should be comfortable taking ownership of your work, engaging directly with clients and managing several activities within a project.​

Candidates ideally have experience with assessing risks, processes or controls and turning findings into practical recommendations. You should be comfortable structuring complex topics, communicating directly with clients, producing clear management-ready deliverables. Experience guiding junior colleagues is beneficial. Strong English is required; German or Dutch skills are a plus. ​

Knowledge of areas such as ISO 27001, NIST, IT audit, regulatory compliance or third-party risk is beneficial. Relevant certifications such as CISA, CISM, CRISC or ISO27001 are an advantage, but should support rather than define the profile.​

Knowledge Exposure: "What you'll build expertise in"

As a Senior Associate, you will deepen your expertise in cyber risk and governance while building the skills required to manage increasingly complex client engagements. You will lead work packages, structure assessments, engage directly with clients and turn complex risks and requirements into practical recommendations. You will also support and guide junior colleagues and build your project delivery and stakeholder management skills, with opportunities to specialize further over time.​

Job Description & Summary

At PwC, our people in project portfolio management focus on optimising project portfolios to drive strategic business outcomes. These individuals oversee project selection, prioritisation, and resource allocation to facilitate successful project delivery.

In project management at PwC, you will oversee and coordinate various projects to facilitate successful delivery within budget and timeline. You will leverage strong organisational and communication skills to effectively manage teams and stakeholders.

About the Team

The Capital Project Services (CPS) team is made up of skilled professionals with expertise in delivering capital projects across a variety of sectors, including Energy, Utilities, and Resource, Transport, Oil & Gas and Government & Healthcare. We help clients maximise the value of their projects and businesses by providing the knowledge and support needed to navigate complex and challenging situations.

Role Overview

As a CPS Manager, you will design and implement effective project and programme management strategies for clients across multiple industries. You will work closely with senior leaders of major global organisations to improve the efficiency of their capital programmes, support the achievement of project objectives, and provide guidance to clients managing projects within tight budget constraints. You will also assist clients in overcoming project delivery challenges. The role will be predominately focussed on the UK market, which you will typically support remotely from the ETIC. Candidates should be available to travel regionally and to the UK, although this will not be required regularly.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage multiple client engagements simultaneously, reporting to senior members of staff, both in ETIC and the UK.

• Lead, mentor, and develop junior team members, providing training and guidance as required.

• Build and maintain strong working relationships with clients, acting as a key point of contact.

• Contribute to the technical development of both yourself and the wider team, ensuring up-to-date knowledge of industry best practices.

• Stay informed about local and national business and economic trends relevant to capital projects.

• Participate in business development activities, including identifying and researching new opportunities with existing and prospective clients.

• Foster strong internal relationships and actively promote the CPS team’s capabilities within the firm.

Types of Engagements you will work on:

CPS assists clients with a broad range of challenges relating to their capital programmes. We are constantly adapting our approach to meet our clients needs and challenges. Some typical engagements are as follows:

• Programme Recovery and Turnaround: Supporting a public sector client whose major infrastructure programme was facing significant delays and cost overruns. Conduct a comprehensive review, identify root causes, and implement a recovery plan to bring the programme back on track.

• Capital Programme Optimisation: Work with a utility company to review and optimise their capital investment portfolio. This includes prioritising projects, streamlining governance processes, and introducing new performance management tools to maximise return on investment.

• Digital Transformation of Project Controls: Assist a infrastructure asset owner in implementing digital project controls across their capital projects portfolio. Selecting and deploying new project management software, training staff, and embedding new ways of working to improve transparency and reporting.

• Procurement and Supply Chain Strategy: Advising a utilities company on the development and execution of a new procurement and supply chain strategy for a multi-billion-pound capital programme. Support supplier selection, contract negotiations, and the establishment of robust commercial management processes.

• Independent Project Assurance: Providing independent assurance to a client on the delivery of a major capital project. Including regular health checks, risk assessments, and recommendations to improve project governance and delivery confidence.

Candidate Profile We are seeking a candidate who:

• Communicates confidently and delivers clear, impactful messages to a range of audiences to influence outcomes.

• Demonstrates leadership skills and a strong commitment to coaching and developing others.

• Possesses strong technical and analytical abilities, with the capacity to simplify complex issues and deliver practical client solutions.

• Is passionate about capital project delivery and motivated to learn from colleagues and build collaborative relationships at all levels.

• Has a solid academic background and relevant industry experience, with a commitment to ongoing professional development.

• Is willing to travel nationally and internationally as required.

Experience and Skills The ideal candidate will have:

• Experience working in asset management environments.

• Proven ability to lead, manage, or work effectively within teams to deliver projects and solutions.

• Strong relationship-building skills and self-motivation to achieve high-quality results.

• Experience managing contracts, suppliers, or projects, with a thorough understanding of the core principles underpinning successful project delivery.

• A commitment to continuous personal and team development.

• Management consulting experience, including the design and implementation of operating and delivery models.

• Experience in digital transformation or technology consulting.

• Commercial experience in supply chain management, procurement, commercial management, or contract negotiations.

Job Description & Summary

At PwC, our people in project portfolio management focus on optimising project portfolios to drive strategic business outcomes. These individuals oversee project selection, prioritisation, and resource allocation to facilitate successful project delivery.

In project management at PwC, you will oversee and coordinate various projects to facilitate successful delivery within budget and timeline. You will leverage strong organisational and communication skills to effectively manage teams and stakeholders.

About Us

For our Consulting business unit, we are looking for motivated professionals from ETIC to join our German team on exciting consulting projects in the area of Portfolio, Program and Project Management (PPM). As part of our Team, you can expect a structured entry into the world of consulting with extensive training opportunities, a strong international network, and the chance to take on responsibility from day one.

Your Responsibilities – What to Expect

• Consulting projects: You support digitalization and transformation projects for clients across industries such as Commercial, Financial Services, and the Public Sector – applying both agile and traditional project management approaches as well as modern digital PPM tools.
• Project management: You contribute to the Project Management Office (PMO) and help ensure transparency on progress, risks, dependencies, and budgets across projects, programs, and portfolios.
• Methods & frameworks: You work with established methodologies such as Scrum, SAFe, PRINCE2, or classic process models, and apply them together with the team.
• Personal development: You gain exposure to complex, large-scale projects across a variety of industries and grow professionally through targeted trainings and internationally recognized certifications.
• Team & business development: You become part of an international team, actively contributing to the growth of our PPM services and expanding your professional network within PwC.

Your Profile – What You Bring

• You have successfully completed (or are about to complete) your studies in Business Administration/Economics, (Business) Information Technology, (Industrial) Engineering, or a comparable field of study.
• Ideally, you have already gained some practical experience through internships, working student positions, or thesis work in the areas of project management, PMO, or consulting.
• You have an interest in project management methodologies (e.g., Scrum, SAFe, PRINCE2, PMI, IPMA) as well as digital PPM tools. Initial certifications are a plus, but not a requirement – we will support you with relevant training.
• You are analytically and conceptually strong, work in a structured manner, and enjoy collaborating within a team.
• Your strong communication skills and confident demeanor help you engage with colleagues and clients on equal footing.
• Very good German and English skills, both written and spoken, round off your profile. (German at least C1 – this is a mandatory requirement for this role.)

What We Offer

• Structured career entry with clear development perspectives
• Mentoring from experienced colleagues in our German PPM team
• Extensive trainings and certifications (e.g. PRINCE2, Scrum, SAFe)
• International working environment with close collaboration between ETIC and Germany
• Flexible working arrangements – predominantly remote work
• Attractive compensation

Thank you for your interest in a career at Regions. At Regions, we believe associates deserve more than just a job. We believe in offering performance-driven individuals a place where they can build a career --- a place to expect more opportunities. If you are focused on results, dedicated to quality, strength and integrity, and possess the drive to succeed, then we are your employer of choice.

Regions is dedicated to taking appropriate steps to safeguard and protect private and personally identifiable information you submit. The information that you submit will be collected and reviewed by associates, consultants, and vendors of Regions in order to evaluate your qualifications and experience for job opportunities and will not be used for marketing purposes, sold, or shared outside of Regions unless required by law. Such information will be stored in accordance with regulatory requirements and in conjunction with Regions’ Retention Schedule for a minimum of three years. You may review, modify, or update your information by visiting and logging into the careers section of the system.

Job Description:

At Regions, the Commercial Relationship Specialist provides general administrative support to Relationship Managers within Commercial Banking to include Commercial Banking and/or specialized business segments of Agricultural Banking (AG), Government and Institutional Banking (GIB), Small Business Administration (SBA), and Franchise Lending.

Primary Responsibilities

• Assists Relationship Manager(s) by performing daily support activities related to client relationships and keeps respective Relationship Manager informed when appropriate
• Acts as a point of contact for Commercial Banking clients for all servicing requests related to client relationships
• Attends weekly scheduled meetings with Relationship Manager(s) to discuss workflow items such as renewals, new pipeline items, servicing requests, past due reports, etc.
• Provides reports for Relationship Manager(s) such as 360 Report, Weekly Sales Report, OneView Pipeline Report, Maturities, Past Due and Exception Reporting
• Facilitates and manages credit application workflow as it applies to the appropriate credit channel including collecting financial information from clients, submitting facility applications and managing loan workflows to closing
• Manages post-closing requirements including tickler requirements and exception citing's
• Manages Relationship Manager(s) loan maturity pipeline, ensuring that renewals are approved and closed in a timely manner
• Acts as a liaison between Credit Products and the Commercial Team with both underwriting and loan fulfillment processes and procedures and manages due diligence requirements from the field
• Assists Relationship Manager(s) with sales support functions to include marketing requests, client and prospect presentations and building prospect information files
• Opens new deposit products for clients
• Works closely with the Treasury Management team to successfully onboard new Treasury Management clients as well as provide the clients with guidance and aid in locating appropriate resources for servicing
• Maintains consistent data integrity for relationship team’s client accounts within all source systems
• Maintains OneView administrative data to include updating client contact information, merging client records, managing pipeline reports for renewals and creating prospect/centers of influence (COIs) records
• Manages data organization within Relationship Grouping Application (RGA) to ensure client records are properly grouped for accurate 360 reporting
• Provides support if assigned for clients in specialized business segments such as GIB, SBA, AG, and Capital Markets within Commercial Banking
• Supports Relationship Manager(s) with miscellaneous administrative tasks as assigned
• May serve as a mentor for new associates

This position requires the tracking of time and is eligible for overtime for hours worked in excess of 40 per week under the Fair Labor Standards Act.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree and two (2) years of banking or client support experience
• Or High School Diploma or GED and three (3) years of general banking experience

Preferences

• College degree

Skills and Competencies

• Ability to partner with various internal partners across the organization
• Ability to research, analyze data and derive facts
• Advanced verbal, written communication, and organizational skills
• Advanced work ethic and self-motivation
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

jobs.description:
Canada

11120 154th St, Edmonton, Alberta T5M3M9 Canada

Are you a people person? Do you love helping others? U-Haul is in search of friendly, motivated people for the position of Customer Service Representative. As a Customer Service Representative, you will work as part of a supportive team to be the face of U-Haul company’s exceptional service and ensuring that customers get all the help they need on their journeys by inspecting and maintaining equipment. As well as assisting customers, using up-to-date technology to dispatch and return equipment. This position offers on-the-job education.

Position Details:

• This position is part-time
• Hours: min of 25 hours a week (ideal for a student).

U-Haul Offers:

• Career stability
• Opportunities for advancement
• Mindset App Reimbursement
• Gym Reimbursement Program
• Health insurance & Prescription plans, if eligible
• Paid holidays, vacation, and sick days, if eligible
• Life insurance
• MetLaw Legal program
• MetLife auto and home insurance
• Discounts on Apple products, Dell computers, cell phone plans, hotels, and more
• 401(k) Savings Plan
• Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
• 24-hour physician available for kids
• Dental & Vision Plans
• Business travel insurance
• You Matter EAP
• LifeLock Identity Theft Protection
• Critical Illness/Group Accident Insurance
• Dave Ramsey’s SmartDollar Program

Customer Service Representative Responsibilities:

• Assist customers inside and outside a U-Haul center with U-Haul products and services.
• Use smartphone-based U-Scan technology to manage rentals and inventory.
• Move and hook up U-Haul trucks and trailers.
• Clean and inspect equipment on the lot including checking fluid levels.
• Answer questions and educate customers regarding products and services.
• Prepare rental invoices and accept equipment returned from rental.
• Install hitches and trailer wiring.
• Other duties as assigned
• Participate in ongoing continuous U-Haul education through U-Haul University.

Customer Service Representative Minimum Qualifications:

• Valid driver’s license and ability to maintain a good driving record
• High school diploma or equivalent

Physical Demands:

The work requires some physical exertion such as long periods of remaining stationary, moving around indoors and outdoors, positioning oneself to reach objects at varying heights and moving equipment weighing a minimum of 50 lbs. assisted or unassisted.

Consistent with applicable state law, U-Haul will not hire or re-hire individuals who use nicotine products.  The states in which U-Haul will decline to hire nicotine users are: Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Iowa, Kansas, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Nebraska, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, and Washington. U-Haul has observed this hiring practice since February 1, 2020 as part of our commitment to a healthy work environment for our team.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Raytheon's Receiver/Exciter & Processing Architecture (REPA) Department is the focal point for receiver, exciter, beam steering, and signal processing technology within Raytheon. The department is responsible for the design, development, integration, and support to production builds, and lifecycle support of Raytheon products.

The REPA Department has an opening on their team to join as a Principal Electrical Engineer – Proposal Lead. This is a great opportunity for a flexible, multi-disciplined engineer who is seeking to utilize his/her strong background in radars to compliment his/her experience leading costing activities.

What You Will Do:

• Craft strongly researched and well-documented engineering bids.
• Write Basis of Estimates (BOEs) based on well thought out reasoning.
• Defend bids to management while interfacing with hardware leads.
• Support both Electrical and REPA Department level proposals at 50%, department level metrics development and support at 25%, and technical department initiatives at 25%.
• This 1st shift role will be 100% on-site and based in Marlborough, MA. Travel is anticipated between multiple sites including Andover, MA and Tewksbury, MA.

Qualifications You Must Have:

• Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 8 years’ prior relevant experience.
• Experience leading multi-disciplined teams to meet deadlines for proposal submissions.
• Experience developing and submitting compliant Basis of Estimates (BOEs) aligned with regulatory requirements.
• Experience analyzing Statements of Work (SOWs) and Requests for Proposal (RFPs) to extract and define project scope.
• Experience identifying risks and opportunities, preferably on detailed analysis of proposal cost rollups.
• Experience adjusting and aligning bids to meet the requirements of various contract types, such as Firm Fixed Price (FFP) and Cost-Plus Fixed Fee (CPFF).
• Experience delivering presentations of proposal details to management.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Cloud Network Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

12

The Team:

Global Network Services is a high-impact, globally distributed engineering team responsible for designing, securing, and automating S&P Global's cloud and hybrid network infrastructure. The Cloud Network Engineering team operates at the forefront of GCP adoption, network automation, and security platform modernization — combining hands-on engineering rigor with infrastructure-as-code discipline to deliver a cloud network estate that is faster to provision, safer to operate, and built to scale. You will work both autonomously and collaboratively, with direct influence over the standards and architecture that underpin business-critical connectivity across the enterprise.

The Impact:

You will shape how S&P Global builds and secures its Google Cloud network. Your designs will determine the scalability, segmentation and performance of GCP connectivity for business-critical applications, and the automation you write will become the standard way those networks are provisioned. Through the Palo Alto egress and inspection platform, you will directly strengthen our security posture, reducing data-exfiltration risk and replacing inconsistent legacy controls with centrally governed, observable policy. The result is a cloud network that is faster to deliver, cheaper to operate and materially harder to misconfigure.

Job Responsibilities

• Own the enterprise GCP network architecture — design, deploy and manage GCP network services including VPCs/Shared VPC, Cloud Interconnect, Cloud Router, Cloud NAT, Cloud DNS, Cloud Load Balancing and Private Service Connect across multi-project, multi-folder environments, including hierarchical firewall policies, VPC Service Controls and hybrid connectivity to on-premises and other cloud providers via BGP and routing policy.

• Build and maintain Terraform modules for GCP and multi-cloud network provisioning; develop Python and Ansible automation to eliminate manual network provisioning, reduce configuration drift, and materially shorten delivery timelines across the network estate.

• Establish and operate CI/CD pipelines for network change delivery — including automated validation, policy-as-code checks, pre-deployment testing, and controlled rollback — setting version-controlled, peer-reviewed, modular engineering standards across shared automation repositories.

• Design, deploy and operate Palo Alto Networks VM-Series firewalls at enterprise scale — including autoscaling deployments, centralized policy management via Panorama and Strata Cloud Manager (SCM), full security policy configuration (App-ID, URL filtering, anti-spyware, decryption), and integration with SIEM and observability tooling; contribute to the migration of legacy firewall platforms onto the Palo Alto estate.

• Drive network segmentation and security posture across cloud, data center, and hybrid infrastructure — partnering with Security, InfoSec, application, and infrastructure teams to ensure designs meet enterprise governance, audit, and compliance requirements; support egress proxy platform onboarding and phased policy enforcement.

• Serve as the senior technical authority for GCP networking across engineering and operations — troubleshooting complex network failures across hybrid environments, participating in on-call rotation, delivering approved changes within maintenance windows, and identifying continuous improvement opportunities to reduce risk, optimise capacity, and elevate engineering standards.

What We’re Looking For:

Basic Required Qualifications:

• Proven experience (10+ years) in enterprise networking, including significant hands-on experience in large-scale cloud environments.

• Hands-on experience designing, deploying and operating Palo Alto Networks firewalls, including VM-Series in cloud and centralized management via Panorama.

• Deep, hands-on GCP networking experience, including VPC and Shared VPC design, Cloud Interconnect, Cloud Router, Cloud NAT, Cloud DNS, Cloud Load Balancing and Private Service Connect.

• Demonstrable production experience with network automation and infrastructure-as-code, including Terraform and Python, with version control using Git.

• Excellent knowledge of networking standards, protocols and technologies, including BGP, OSPF, routing policy, switching, VPNs, DNS and load balancing.

• Working knowledge of AWS and Azure networking, including Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, VPC and security groups, ExpressRoute and Virtual WAN.

• Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills to diagnose and resolve complex network issues across cloud and hybrid environments.

• Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Team player who enjoys a mix of autonomy and collaboration-based delivery.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, commitments and projects.
• Bachelor's degree or advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience demonstrating technical leadership capabilities

Additional Preferred Qualifications:

• Google Professional Cloud Network Engineer certification. Palo Alto Networks PCNSE certification.

• HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Advanced Networking Specialty or Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate certification.

• Experience with network segmentation and micro-segmentation technologies such as Akamai Guardicore or Illumio.

• Familiarity with Cloud Native NaaS (Network as a Service) platforms such as Alkira, Prosimo or Aviatrix.

• Understanding of AI and its practical application to cloud networking, such as using LLM-based assistants and AI-assisted tooling for Terraform and policy generation, configuration review, log and flow analysis, root-cause troubleshooting and documentation.

• Experience with Ansible, and with automated network testing using tools such as Batfish or pyATS.

• Exposure to network observability and AIOps platforms such as Selector AI or ThousandEyes.

• Experience working in a regulated financial services environment with formal change, audit and evidence requirements.
