jobs.title: (CAN) Customer Service Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary...

Working as a Customer Service Manager at Walmart Canada is a great opportunity to build strong leadership and operational skills in a fast paced retail environment. In this role, you lead front end operations to deliver exceptional customer service, support a positive shopping experience, and drive customer loyalty. The Customer Service Manager also plays a key role in ensuring compliance with company programs and operational standards, helping the store run efficiently and effectively. This position is ideal for individuals seeking an engaging leadership role in customer service or retail.

What you'll do...

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Safety, Security, and Emergency Readiness
Ensures safe work practices and emergency procedures are followed at all times, including proper lifting techniques, maintaining clean work areas, managing down registers, responding to emergency codes, and supporting theft prevention and evacuation procedures.

Customer and Associate Support
Handles customer and associate concerns professionally, providing guidance and support as required to resolve issues and maintain a positive front-end experience.

Front End Coverage and Operations
Monitors Front End operations to ensure proper associate coverage, coordinates breaks, and provides support to outlying registers to maintain efficient customer flow.

Associate Training and Development
Trains associates on systems and Company procedures, including scanning accuracy, productivity standards, company programs and initiatives, discount programs, EAS processes, and safety requirements.

Transaction Oversight and Compliance
Oversees purchase, return, and exchange transactions, provides approvals when required, assists with correcting errors, and verifies processes are followed in accordance with Company guidelines.

EAS and Loss Prevention Support
Ensures EAS systems are functioning properly by confirming cashiers deactivate merchandise correctly, greeters handle alarms appropriately, and “Failure to Deactivate” logs are completed accurately.

Cash Management and Register Controls
Prepares registers for daily opening and closing, supports cashiers by providing change as needed, maintains appropriate front-end cash levels, and completes audits to ensure register accuracy.

Promote Company Programs and Initiatives

jobs.description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...

Leads department sales growth through effective merchandising, pricing accuracy, inventory oversight, and seasonal execution. Forecasts sales trends and aligns product assortments with member needs, community demographics, and local economic patterns. Monitors competitive pricing and adjusts strategies to strengthen market relevance and achieve financial targets. Uses sales data to identify opportunities, refine merchandising tactics, and drive continuous improvement in revenue performance. Encourages team engagement in store and builds connections with stakeholders to enhance departmental visibility and long-term impact. Leads community outreach efforts to promote optical services, expand brand presence, and strengthen local relationships. Represents the optical department in both community programs and internal business initiatives that support organizational goals.

Sets and upholds high service standards to ensure the prompt, accurate resolution of member inquiries and concerns. Leads lifestyle consultations and recommend visual solutions with clear guidance on product and features that will fill patient needs under appropriate supervision. As permitted by scope-of-practice requirements, oversees precise eyewear measurements, fittings, adjustments, and contact lens education, maintaining safety and accuracy under applicable optometric supervision. Ensures the confidentiality of member information and maintains accurate, compliant documentation, including HIPAA and safety protocols. Manages quality assurance processes, resolves complex optical issues under applicable optometric supervision, and maintains equipment calibration, cleanliness, and readiness.

Leads, coaches, and develops the optical team through hiring, training, performance management, and recognition. Fosters a collaborative and inclusive culture grounded in accountability, engagement, and continuous development. Assigns duties strategically to optimize workflow, elevate skills, and ensure operational excellence. What you'll do...

Are you a dynamic leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, turns complex challenges into actionable solutions, and inspires teams to deliver exceptional results? Walmart's Last Mile Delivery organization is looking for a Senior Manager, Operations to help lead our Digital Identity team, where innovation, operational excellence, and adaptability are essential to success.

In this role, you'll lead a team responsible for driving identity verification operations that help protect our delivery ecosystem while supporting a seamless experience for drivers. You'll navigate an evolving landscape of operational challenges and emerging fraud risks, using data to uncover opportunities, solve problems, and build scalable solutions.

Success in this role requires more than managing day-to-day operations. You'll develop talent, build high-performing teams, and partner across the business to turn ambiguity into action. If you're energized by solving problems, developing people, and making a measurable impact in a rapidly growing and evolving business, this is an opportunity to help shape the future of Last Mile Delivery at Walmart.

What You'll Do

• Build and inspire a high-performing team: Lead, coach, and develop associates by setting clear expectations, identifying skill and knowledge gaps, and creating opportunities for growth. Build a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and strong execution.

• Turn data into solutions: Go beyond reporting metrics to uncover the root causes of operational challenges. Translate complex data and business trends into actionable insights, develop solutions, and measure their impact on business performance.

• Lead through ambiguity and change: Navigate the fast-moving Last Mile Delivery environment with confidence and adaptability. Establish priorities, make informed decisions with incomplete information, and guide your team through evolving business needs while maintaining operational excellence.

• Drive operational improvements that scale: Identify inefficiencies, anticipate challenges, and implement innovative solutions that improve accuracy, streamline identity verification processes, reduce costs, and strengthen operational performance.

• Lead complex initiatives from strategy to execution: Build and oversee operational workstreams, establish milestones, align resources, and drive successful implementations. Remove roadblocks, monitor results, and adjust strategies to deliver meaningful business outcomes.

• A problem-solving mindset grounded in data: The ability to interpret data, recognize patterns, identify root causes, and translate insights into practical solutions that drive measurable improvements. Deep technical expertise isn't required, but curiosity and analytical thinking are essential.

• Confidence navigating ambiguity: A track record of delivering results in fast-paced, evolving environments where priorities shift, challenges emerge, and solutions aren't always clearly defined.

jobs.title: Head of Risk Malaysia and Thailand
jobs.description:
Head of Risk Malaysia and Thailand

At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as a Head of Risk Malaysia and Thailand to play your part in that transformation. It’s an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.

Make your mark in Enterprise Risk Management

The Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) team partners across the AIG organization, facilitating rational risk-taking that drives profitable growth. ERM is responsible for ensuring that our organization has the right tools, processes, and systems in place to identify, measure and manage these risks. The team plays a critical role in strategic decisions about where to expand or contract businesses, where to invest to collect premiums that are enough to cover future claims, and how much capital we need to reserve to weather unexpected events. It also helps the enterprise to develop effective controls that support the successful execution of organizational strategy.

As an ERM colleague, you will shape and support how AIG manages its risks. Your knowledge about the company’s risks will shape the daily decision-making among AIG’s businesses and functions, while informing our clients and the markets that we serve. You will also have the opportunity to enhance your risk and business acumen as we continue to navigate an ever-changing risk environment.

ERM advocates a healthy risk culture, encouraging our diverse colleagues to speak up when we spot something that fosters risk so that we can address it effectively.

About the role

What you need to know:

The role of the Head of Risk is to maintain a robust risk management framework that is appropriate for the size, business mix and complexity of AIG Malaysia and Thailand, is in line with AIG policies and meets regulatory expectations.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

• Responsible for the overall management and execution of the risk management strategy and activities.
• Maintain an effective risk management framework to identify, assess, manage, monitor and report all material risks that AIG Malaysia is exposed to.
• Adequate support of the Board of Directors and the CEO in meeting their responsibilities with respect to the protection of policyholders and the management of the risk profile of the company.
• Facilitate quarterly management’s Risk and Capital Committee meetings.
• Engagement with the regulator on a needs basis.
• Maintenance of AIG Malaysia’s Risk Appetite Statement, KRIs, Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment process, top and emerging risks.
• Oversight over the implementation of the Operational Risk Management (ORM) framework, including facilitating the Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) annual work plan, maintaining the Risk Event capture and reporting program, Key Risk Indicators, etc.
• Strengthen the risk culture to underpin the effectiveness of the overall risk management framework.
• Risk reviews of material outsourcing, major initiatives and business development (e.g. new products, business plan).
• Timely escalation of any risk matters to Malaysia and Thailand management, within the ERM function and to the Board as needed.
• Participate in and contribute to APAC and Global ERM/ORM initiatives. (e.g. International Center of Correspondence, eGRC rollout for APAC, etc)
• Designated Senior Officer accountable for overseeing the effective management of climate-related risks and ensuring climate deliverables are met, in accordance to BNM expectations.
• Team talent development

Key Measuring Parameters

• Implementation of ERM initiatives in an effective and efficient way
• Support local management in the whole risk management process including but not limited to identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation etc. by using qualitative and quantitative tools

What we’re looking for:

• Experience preferably in broad scope of Risk Management; or experience in general insurance industry operations;
• Minimum Bachelor’s degree. Partially or fully qualified in Actuarial, ERM, CFA or other related profession is an added advantage;
• Excellent communication skills in both oral and written English;
• Self-motivated and can drive initiatives independently;
• Have flexibility to work in a dynamic, multinational and challenging environment.

#LI-SK1

At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

Enjoy benefits that take care of what matters

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.

Welcome to a culture of inclusion

We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.

Immigration sponsorship is not available for this role. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States without current or future visa sponsorship.

Role Summary:
The Principal Data Scientist will lead the development and deployment of advanced machine learning models and machine learning solutions to address complex business challenges. This role requires expertise in end-to-end model development lifecycle from data to features to modelling to deployment.  The position involves mentoring team members, collaborating cross-functionally, and ensuring the quality and effectiveness of data sources and models. The successful candidate will drive innovation by applying cutting-edge techniques and delivering measurable business impact while maintaining high standards of integrity and operational excellence.

About the Team:
The Marketplace Data Science team at Walmart Global Tech drives innovation in global commerce by supporting a rapidly expanding eCommerce platform. The team empowers thousands of sellers to efficiently manage digital storefronts, optimizing product listings, pricing, and inventory. They deliver seamless pre- and post-order experiences through intelligent, resilient systems. Utilizing real-time data and integrating with partner platforms across Walmart’s ecosystem, the team ensures exceptional customer experiences. Focused on scalable, reliable solutions, they collaborate across functions to advance technology roadmaps and support sustained business growth.

What You'll Do:

• Develop, test, and deploy advanced machine learning models and data-driven solutions aligned with business requirements.

• Analyze complex business problems to identify root causes and recommend effective technology-focused approaches.

• Identify, assess, and validate data sources ensuring quality and relevance for analytical modeling.

• Lead feature engineering, exploratory data analysis, and model evaluation to optimize performance and robustness.

• Demonstrate strong thought-leadership and consult with product and business stakeholders to build, scale and deploy holistic data science products after successful prototyping.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable data science strategies and measurable outcomes.

• Mentor team members on advanced modeling techniques, data visualization, and best practices.

• Drive continuous improvement by integrating emerging machine learning trends and automation tools.

What You'll Bring:

• PhD in Computer Science or related field and 10 years of relevant data science experience or master's degree in related field and 12 years of relevant data science experience.

• Demonstrable experience of architecting large scale ML systems.

• Deep knowledge of and extensive experience in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, and reinforcement learning to develop advanced analytical models.

• Proven experience working with state-of-the-art agentic, Gen AI, supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms on real-world problems, preferably in ecommerce domain.

• Proficiency in Python programming and AWS SageMaker for scalable model development and deployment.

• Strong knowledge of statistical analysis and exploratory data analysis techniques to interpret complex data sets.

• Ability to translate business requirements into data-driven strategies and measurable outcomes.

• Expertise in data source identification, quality assessment, and data ecosystem management.

• Proven leadership skills in mentoring and guiding technical teams toward innovative solutions.

• Effective communication skills to present insights and influence stakeholders.

Preferred Experience:

• Experience in the e-commerce domain.

• Experience in the fraud/risk domain.

• Demonstrated success in data science platforms like Kaggle.

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.

Walmart’s culture is a competitive advantage, and it’s fostered by being together. Working together in person allows us to collaborate, align quickly and innovate with greater speed.  We use our campuses to create purposeful connections rooted in deepening understanding and investing in the development of our associates.

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include 401(k) match, stock purchase plan, paid maternity and parental leave, PTO, multiple health plans, and much more.

Job Description

Are you ready to thrive in a fast-paced, high-energy environment? As a Nordstrom Rack team member, you'll be continuously moving and collaborating with teammates to create a welcoming and inclusive atmosphere for all customers. You’ll ensure a quick and easy customer experience and keep the store clean and clutter free. Flexibility is key, as you may occasionally work in different areas of the store to maintain the cleanliness of the floor and stockrooms and help customers find great deals.

We have roles available in Sales, Customer Service, Stock, and Fulfillment departments. Apply now and discuss which role interests you most during the interview process.

A day in the life for Sales and Customer Service …

• Work with the team to ensure the salesfloor stays "runway ready", and is sized and filled in through re-merchandising and straightening throughout the day
• Assist customers when cashiering with a variety of transactions across different platforms (in-store, online and mobile), which includes operating a point-of-sale system, bagging items of all size, handling bulky sometimes heavy items including boxes, and ensuring a seamless and friendly experience
• Create a smooth fitting room experience when supporting as a fitting room attendant by greeting and assisting customers and sorting and returning clothing to the floor
• Create a clean and clutter-free customer experience by sorting and returning clothing to the salesfloor
• Keep the stockrooms organized and ensure merchandise is properly checked in and accurately ticketed
• Demonstrate expertise in all technologies used in the store environment
• Adhere to all operational, merchandise and asset protection standards
• Promote initiatives like our Nordstrom Rewards program

A day in a life for Stock Support and Fulfillment…

• Receive, unload freight, unpack and deliver newly arrived merchandise to selling departments
• Fulfill customer orders in a timely manner following quality standards
• Prepare and ship customer’s orders following quality, packing and shipping standards
• Utilize inventory management systems to scan, process and research merchandise shipments in accordance with our inventory control processes
• Assist in maintaining clean and organized selling floors and stockrooms
• Provide general support to the store, e.g. set up special events, organize backroom, markdowns, and relocate store fixtures

You own this if you have…

• Clear, effective communication with strong interpersonal skills
• Accountability, initiative and a high level of ownership
• Organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
• The ability to work a flexible schedule based on business needs
• Physical Requirements:Continuous movement for 6-8 hours per shift, which includes frequent bending, twisting, squatting, flexing and reaching in order to handle merchandise and assist customers.Frequent use of hands for grasping, fine manipulation, pushing and pullingHandle bulky and sometimes awkwardly shaped items, which includes reaching for and lifting these items above the head. Regularly lift items weighing up to 10 pounds and occasionally up to 25 poundsStock and Fulfillment Only: Frequently lift and carry up to 25 pounds and occasionally up to 50 pounds

Pay offers are dependent on the location, as well as job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

$21.00 - $21.85 Hourly

jobs.title: SY26-27 Enrollment Strategy and Engagement Manager
jobs.description:
Ingenuity Prep is a high-performing public charter school in Ward 8, serving scholars from Pre-K through Middle School. We are a supportive school community dedicated to academic rigor and civic leadership, preparing students for the path to colleges and careers of their choosing. We are unapologetically outcomes-driven, with an instructional model that emphasizes small-group learning, collaborative teaching teams, and robust coaching and professional development, all within a culture rooted in joy, belonging, and authentic relationships.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
As the Enrollment Strategy and Engagement Manager, you will lead the day-to-day implementation of our community-based student recruitment efforts, building authentic relationships with families, community organizations, and neighborhood partners while developing innovative approaches to increasing enrollment. Working closely with the CEO, Data & Enrollment team, academy leaders, and Family & Community Engagement team, the manager will help translate Ingenuity Prep's enrollment priorities into a focused, measurable outreach and recruitment plan. In this role, you will:

Build Community Relationships and Partnerships

• Develop and sustain relationships with neighborhood organizations, childcare providers, community leaders, and other partners who connect with prospective families.

• Establish a consistent presence in the communities Ingenuity Prep serves, meeting families where they are.

• Identify new opportunities to introduce families to Ingenuity Prep through partnerships, community gatherings, and trusted networks.

• Build and maintain a pipeline of community partners and prospective-family referrals.

• Listen to families and community members to better understand school choice decisions, barriers to enrollment, and opportunities to strengthen IP's outreach.

Lead Creative, Proactive Student Recruitment

• Develop and implement a year-round community outreach and recruitment plan aligned with schoolwide enrollment priorities.

• Design and execute creative campaigns and activities that generate interest in Ingenuity Prep.

• Organize and participate in recruitment events, neighborhood outreach, school tours, and other opportunities to engage prospective families.

• Establish and support a network of parent and family ambassadors who can share their experiences and introduce other families to IP.

• Maintain personal relationships with prospective families, providing consistent follow-up and connecting them with enrollment staff to complete required steps.

• Partner with communications staff to develop compelling recruitment messages and materials informed by family feedback and market research.

Turn Outreach Into Measurable Enrollment Results

• Establish clear outreach goals, timelines, and deliverables aligned with schoolwide enrollment targets.

• Work with the Data & Enrollment team to monitor recruitment leads, application progress, conversion, and grade-level enrollment needs.

• Use enrollment data to prioritize outreach efforts and identify opportunities to strengthen recruitment.

• Track the effectiveness of community partnerships, recruitment activities, and family referrals.

• Regularly evaluate results and recommend adjustments to improve performance.

• Provide the CEO with concise updates on progress, challenges, opportunities, and decisions needed.

Collaborate Across Teams to Strengthen Enrollment and Retention

• Partner with academy leaders and the Family & Community Engagement team to identify opportunities to strengthen family advocacy and school-community relationships.

• Support targeted outreach associated with key academy transitions, particularly kindergarten to first grade and fourth to fifth grade.

• Coordinate with existing teams to ensure prospective and newly enrolled families experience a welcoming, responsive introduction to IP.

• Share family and community feedback that can inform schoolwide recruitment and retention strategies.

• Participate in cross-functional enrollment planning and accountability meetings, following through on assigned recruitment commitments.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR
We are seeking passionate professionals who bring the mindset of a community organizer to mission-driven work. As the Enrollment Strategy and Engagement Manager, you will listen carefully, build trust, connect people, mobilize networks, and turn relationships into meaningful action. They bring energy, initiative, creativity, and a genuine commitment to building relationships with families and communities.

• Community Builder: You build authentic relationships, earn trust, and connect with people across different backgrounds and experiences.

• Creative Problem Solver: You generate new ideas, test approaches, and adapt when something isn't working.

• Action-Oriented Organizer: You turn ambitious goals into concrete activities, organize people around shared objectives, and follow through consistently.

• Results-Driven: You understand that relationships and activities should ultimately produce measurable outcomes, and you use data to improve your work.

• Collaborative Leader: You influence others, build partnerships, and move work forward without relying on formal authority.

• Compelling Communicator: You can tell the story of Ingenuity Prep in ways that resonate with prospective families and community partners.

WHAT YOU BRING

• At least 3 years of relevant experience in community organizing, grassroots outreach, student recruitment, community engagement, relationship-based marketing, or a related field.

• Demonstrated success building community relationships and translating outreach into measurable results.

• Experience organizing campaigns, coordinating community initiatives, or mobilizing supporter networks.

• Strong interpersonal communication and relationship-building skills.

• Excellent project management, organization, and follow-through.

• Comfort using basic data and tracking tools to monitor progress and adjust activities.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.

• Familiarity with Washington, DC communities, particularly Wards 7 and 8, strongly preferred.

• Experience in education or school enrollment preferred but not required.

• Willingness to work occasional evenings and weekends to connect with families and attend community events.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
In the first year, the Enrollment Growth & Community Outreach Manager will:

• Establish a sustained community outreach presence and active network of referral partners.

• Develop and execute a measurable recruitment plan aligned with IP's enrollment priorities.

• Build a family ambassador program that generates prospective-family referrals.

• Increase qualified family inquiries and strengthen inquiry-to-enrollment conversion.

• Identify and test new recruitment approaches, using results to refine outreach.

• Contribute meaningfully to schoolwide enrollment growth while strengthening the relationships and recruitment infrastructure needed for future years.

MORE ABOUT US
Ingenuity Prep offers among the strongest compensation and benefits packages of any public charter school in Washington, D.C. Our compensation and benefits package includes:

• Competitive compensation with up to 7% annual salary growth

• 401(k) IRA with 100% match up to 3% + Smart Save auto increase option

• 100% employer-paid medical, disability, and life insurance for employees + dependents; 50% spouse coverage for medical; 50% employer-paid dental + vision

• Paid parental leave for all staff, regardless of gender

• Ongoing wellness support with monthly Wellness Days + free mental health services

• MacBook Air provided for professional and personal use, 100% IP-paid cell phone plan (keep your number!), and tax-free commuter benefits

• Robust coaching and learning model with monthly PD and staff-led learning; dedicated time and funding for growth with early-release Wednesdays + external PD funds

Salary Range: $73,833 - $92,208 (commensurate with 1-10 years of experience)

Ingenuity Prep does not make hiring decisions based on race, color, creed, ethnicity, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, socio-economic background, age, disability, veteran status, religion, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by state, federal, or local law.  However, at this time, we do not provide job sponsorship for international candidates.

jobs.title: Head of Solutions Engineering
jobs.description:
Every year, companies spend over a trillion dollars moving freight across the U.S. but the system for matching trucks with jobs is still slow, manual, and fragmented. FleetWorks is fixing that.

Our customers are freight brokers, and every one of them runs a little differently. Getting a new customer from signed contract to a working, adopted product means learning how they operate, deciding what we're building for them, keeping the project moving across their team and ours, and managing expectations on both sides. Today that work is spread across customer success, engineering, and the founders. We’re looking for a Head of Solutions Engineering to own the technical customer journey through onboarding & implementation and custom builds that power our customers’ core business.

You'll personally run our most important implementations and write the playbook from what you learn. You'll be the person who scopes what we're committing to, sets expectations with the customer, and balances them against what engineering can deliver.


What You'll do

 - Own Customer Deployments at the intersection of of customers and engineering. This includes onboarding as well as new product features, rollouts, etc

 - You’ll own customer implementations end to end: from contract signature through onboarding, go-live, and steady-state adoption.

 - Partner with engineering and product leadership on changes that reduce engineering’s role in customer builds

 - Work with Product to train and enable customers, including building documentation that will help users self-serve.

 - Build a project management system that can be used across Product, CS, and Engineering to keep up to date on current status of customer builds. Be the owner of escalations between engineering and CS.

 - Scope the work and manage expectations. Turn what a customer wants into clear, realistic requirements engineering can build against. Scope how integrations work, with customers and with partners.

 - Learn the product deeply. Get hands-on enough to configure workflows and agents yourself at the start, and know when a one-off should become a product feature.

 - Own the rollout and the custom workflows that drive expansion with existing customers. This also includes enablement, training, and documentation that lets customers get more value without waiting on us.

 - Manage and develop the deployment team, starting with our deployment strategist.



What We Look For

 - Experience owning implementation, solutions, or another technical customer-facing delivery role at B2B software companies.

 - Experience managing technical customer relationships at a level where you could coach others on it, and a track record that engineers will trust.

 - Technical enough to learn a complex product deeply, configure workflows, read an integration, and ask engineers the right questions.

 - Operator's instincts. You understand how a business runs, you care about your customer's margins, and you spot issues before they become a problem.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication.

 - High ownership and hands-on by default. You'd rather do the first version yourself than write a plan for someone else to execute.

What we offer

 - Top tier cash and equity compensation—we aim to be above 75th %ile for companies who have raised a similar amount of cash

 - Competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits

 - Fully covered lunches and dinners

 - The opportunity to learn quickly, grow fast, and be rewarded for your contributions

 - Work with Product to train and enable customers, including building documentation that will help users self-serve.

 - Learn the product deeply. Get hands-on enough to configure workflows and agents yourself at the start, and know when a one-off should become a product feature.

 - Own the rollout and the custom workflows that drive expansion with existing customers. This also includes enablement, training, and documentation that lets customers get more value without waiting on us.

 - Manage and develop the deployment team, starting with our deployment strategist.

 - Experience owning implementation, solutions, or another technical customer-facing delivery role at B2B software companies.

 - Experience managing technical customer relationships at a level where you could coach others on it, and a track record that engineers will trust.

 - Technical enough to learn a complex product deeply, configure workflows, read an integration, and ask engineers the right questions.

 - Operator's instincts. You understand how a business runs, you care about your customer's margins, and you spot issues before they become a problem.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication.

 - High ownership and hands-on by default. You'd rather do the first version yourself than write a plan for someone else to execute.

What we offer

 - Top tier cash and equity compensation—we aim to be above 75th %ile for companies who have raised a similar amount of cash

 - Competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits

 - Fully covered lunches and dinners

 - The opportunity to learn quickly, grow fast, and be rewarded for your contributions

jobs.title: Special Education Teacher (9-12) 2027-2028
jobs.description:
Who are We?

Brooke Charter Schools is a network of four public charter schools, serving grades K-12 in Mattapan, Roslindale, and East Boston. At Brooke, we coach and invest in our teachers so that they can help our students achieve at the highest levels and graduate from college. We believe academic achievement empowers our students to live choice-filled lives and enhances their ability to contribute to creating a just world. In a culture of achievement, educators support students in recognizing and building on their identities as sources of strength even as they work to grow and achieve in new ways.

What is the Special Education Teacher Role?

As a Special Education Teacher (referred to as a Student Support Coordinator at Brooke), you build strong relationships with students in order to push them to be their best selves both academically and personally. You collaborate with colleagues in order to meet the needs of every student by ensuring accommodations are met and developing intervention plans. To that end, you will take part in regular data meetings, and participate in nearly 300 hours of professional development over the course of the school year.

You are a critical member of our instructional team, teaching daily support classes in math, science, life skills, and/or literacy. You also oversee the drafting, implementation, and maintenance of IEPs and 504 plans, co-lead child study team meetings, and coordinate standardized test accommodations, special education screenings, and related services.

Hours for this role are  7:45 am - 4:00 pm and Student Support Coordinators work at one campus.

Salaries are based on years of special education experience. Candidates who join our team with a license or degree in special education are eligible for competitive salaries, aligned with local districts. The salary range is $74,000–$130,000, commensurate with experience.

Student support coordinators will also earn an additional $3,300 stipend for teaching a high-need subject area.

Is This You?

• You’ve earned a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in special education or hold a special education teaching license

• You have a working knowledge of federal and state special education laws

• After at least 2 years as a lead teacher, you know the importance of building a joyful classroom culture where students are held to high behavioral and academic expectations. See what this looks like in action at Brooke here

• You are committed to fostering diversity by cultivating anti-racist practices and removing bias, empowering students with the resources they need to create choice filled lives for themselves and their futures. Read more about how we are working on this at Brooke here.

• You are professional, warm, and collaborative with students, families, and colleagues

• You are able to start in July of 2027

The community and students we serve are diverse, and we are committed to reflecting that diversity in our staff. We strive to have the most diverse applicant pool possible; to that end, we encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply for any position at Brooke Charter Schools. By fostering a diverse and inclusive environment, we provide the best educational experience to prepare our students for a future reflective of the world we live in.

jobs.title: Brigádnik študent/Brigádnička študentka, Dunajská Streda Galéria Tesco
jobs.location: Dunajská Streda, Trnavský kraj, Slovakia (Slovak Republic)
jobs.description:
ČO BUDETE ROBIŤ

Ako Brigádnik/Brigádnička v H&M zohráte kľúčovú úlohu pri vytváraní vynikajúceho zákazníckeho zážitku. Privítate zákazníkov, prevediete ich predajňou a pomôžete im nájsť, čo potrebujú, pričom budete prezentovať naše produkty. Svojimi rozhodnutiami v súlade s našimi hodnotami prispejete nielen k svojmu vlastnému úspechu, ale aj k úspechu celej spoločnosti.

Vaša náplň práce:

• Budete zdieľať svoje znalosti o móde a produktoch, aby ste pomohli zákazníkom urobiť informované rozhodnutia.
• Čaká vás spolupráca s vaším tímom na poskytovaní výnimočnej služby počas celého zákazníckeho zážitku, vrátane aktívnej propagácie vernostného programu H&M.
• Pomôžete zabezpečiť, aby predajná plocha a sklad boli dobre zásobené, organizované a prívetivé.
• Podporovať tím budete aj pri otváraní a zatváraní predajne.
• A taktiež budete pozitívne reprezentovať seba a značku pri všetkých interakciách so zákazníkmi.

S KÝM BUDETE PRACOVAŤ

Naše predajne sú srdcom našej spoločnosti, kde si zákazníci môžu naplno vychutnať zážitok s našou značkou. Ako súčasť dynamického predajného tímu – či už na pozícii Predajného poradcu, Vedúceho oddelenia, Vedúceho predajne, Dekoratéra alebo Hlavného pokladníka – budete prispievať k vytvoreniu inšpiratívneho a prívetivého prostredia. Okrem vášho tímu budete spolupracovať aj so širším Area tímom, vymieňať si poznatky a spoločne prispievať k celkovému úspechu. Spolu s kolegami budete zohrávať dôležitú úlohu pri pomoci zákazníkom cítiť sa sebavedomo, a pomôžete im vyjadriť svoju individualitu prostredníctvom najnovších trendov i nadčasových štýlov. Budovaním pevných vzťahov so zákazníkmi robíme módu prístupnou a udržateľnou pre všetkých.

KOHO HĽADÁME

Hľadáme ľudí, ktorí majú…​

• Skúsenosti so zákazníckym servisom v oblasti módy, retailu alebo v podobných odvetviach (predošlé skúsenosti budú považované za výhodu).
• Vášeň pre pomoc zákazníkom a záujem o módu alebo retail – zvyšok vás naučíme!

A ľudí ktorí…​

• Majú radi spoluprácu a dynamické prostredie.
• Sú komunikatívni, kreatívni, zvedaví na prácu s technológiami obchodu, s veľkou túžbou učiť sa a rozvíjať.
• Flexibilní a orientovaní na výsledky.
• Majú viac ako 18 rokov
• Sú flexibilní a môžu pracovať na popoludňajších zmenách

KTO SME​

H&M Group je globálna spoločnosť silných módnych značiek a inovatívnych projektov. Naším cieľom je dokázať, že nie je nutné robiť kompromisy medzi výnimočným dizajnom, dostupnými cenami a udržateľnými riešeniami. Chceme sprístupniť módu širokej verejnosti a zákazníci sú v centre každého nášho rozhodnutia. Máme tisícky vášnivých a talentovaných kolegov, ktorých spájajú spoločná kultúra a hodnoty. Spoločne chceme využiť našu silu, rozsah a znalosti na to, aby sme posunuli módny priemysel smerom k inkluzívnejšej a udržateľnejšej budúcnosti.

PREČO SI NÁS OBĽÚBITE

V H&M Group sme hrdí na to, že sme dynamickou a prívetivou spoločnosťou. Ponúkame atraktívne benefity a rozsiahle rozvojové príležitosti po celom svete.

• Stabilný zamestnávateľ,
• Rozsiahly program školení,
• Možnosť rastu v rámci spoločnosti (viac ako 70% našich náborových procesov je interných),
• Šanca zažiť unikátnu kultúru spoločnosti H&M,
• Občerstvenie na pracovisku.

PRIDAJTE SA K NÁM​

Naša jedinečnosť spočíva v kombinácii mnohých faktorov – našej inkluzívnej a spolupracujúcej kultúry, silných hodnôt a možností rastu. No predovšetkým sú to naši ľudia, ktorí robia našu spoločnosť tým, čím je.​ ​

Ide o pozíciu na dohodu s miestom výkonu práce v Dunajskej Strede. Typ mimopracovnoprávneho vzťahu bude upresnený v priebehu náborového procesu.

Platové ohodnotenie vo výške 6,12 € za hodinu.

Neváhajte a prihláste sa čo najskôr, najneskôr však do 14.11.2026. Z dôvodu ochrany osobných údajov môžeme prijímať žiadosti len prostredníctvom našej kariérnej stránky.

Urobte ďalší krok vo svojej kariére spolu s nami. Vaša cesta začína tu.​

­­*Hodnotenie pozícií v predajni:

Aby sme zvládli vysoký objem prihlášok na pozíciu Predajného poradcu, používame online hodnotenie na základe zručností v rámci niektorých našich predajní. Tento proces budete musieť dokončiť ako súčasť prihlášky a výberového procesu. Vaše odpovede budú hodnotené nástrojom na hodnotenie, ktorý aplikuje vopred stanovené kritériá určené spoločnosťou H&M Group.

Po dokončení hodnotenia budete mať možnosť zdieľať feedback a položiť otázky. Ak narazíte na akékoľvek problémy alebo preferujete alternatívnu metódu hodnotenia, kontaktujte nás na  recruitment_support@hm.com. Výber alternatívy nebude mať vplyv na vašu prihlášku.

Viac informácií o tom, ako spracúvame vaše osobné údaje, nájdete v našich Zásadách ochrany osobných údajov.

** Zaviazali sme sa k spravodlivému a nestrannému výberovému procesu založenému na kompetenciách. Preto vás prosíme, aby ste k žiadosti neprikladali motivačný list.

jobs.title: School Psychologist 2027-2028
jobs.description:
Who are We?

Brooke Charter Schools is a network of four public charter schools, serving grades K-12 in Mattapan, Roslindale, and East Boston. At Brooke, we coach and invest in our teachers so that they can help our students achieve at the highest levels and graduate from college. We believe academic achievement empowers our students to live choice-filled lives and enhances their ability to contribute to creating a just world. In a culture of achievement, educators support students in recognizing and building on their identities as sources of strength even as they work to grow and achieve in new ways.

What is the School Psychologist Role?

As a school psychologist at Brooke, you provide direct support to individual and small groups of students in the areas of social skills, self-regulation, self-advocacy, etc and create and implement positive behavioral plans. You collaborate with stakeholders including serving as a liaison between the school, student, parent, and external agencies, as well as engaging parents and teachers as partners in students' therapeutic interventions. You conduct comprehensive evaluations including cognitive, academic, attention, social/emotional and functional behavior assessments and conduct classroom screening to assist teachers in planning effective educational strategies for all students. You participate actively in IEP and child study team meetings in order to produce comprehensive and appropriate educational plans for students, make referrals to external agencies and appropriate programs for students in need of support services, and provide crisis intervention for students, which may include risk assessments, safety contracts and social service interventions. You may also perform other related duties as requested by the principal.

Salaries are competitive with local districts. The salary range is $90,000-$129,000, commensurate with experience.

You must hold an appropriate license issued by the Massachusetts Board of Allied Mental Health Professionals as an Educational Psychologist, national certification from the National Association of School Psychologists, or a school psychologist license from the Massachusetts Department of Elementary and Secondary Education.

Is This You?

• You have extensive knowledge of child development and age-appropriate social and emotional skills

• You have demonstrated competency in the theory, administration, and interpretation of standardized instruments

• You have the ability to efficiently write comprehensive and informative reports that contain appropriate educational goals

• You are professional, warm, and collaborative with students, families, and colleagues

• You are committed to fostering diversity by cultivating anti-racist practices and removing bias, empowering students with the resources they need to create choice filled lives for themselves and their futures. Read more about how we are working on this at Brooke here.

• You are able to start in July of 2027

The community and students we serve are diverse, and we are committed to reflecting that diversity in our staff. We strive to have the most diverse applicant pool possible; to that end, we encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply for any position at Brooke Charter Schools. By fostering a diverse and inclusive environment, we provide the best educational experience to prepare our students for a future reflective of the world we live in.

jobs.title: Clinical Manager, RN
jobs.description:
Clinical Manager, Habilitation

New BAYADA Office | Poplar Bluff, Missouri

BAYADA is seeking a compassionate, clinically strong Clinical Manager to help establish and support our new Habilitation office in Poplar Bluff, Missouri. This is an opportunity to help individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities build greater independence, participate in their communities, and receive thoughtful, person-centered support.

As the office grows, you will provide clinical leadership and guidance to the team, help maintain high standards of care, and partner with clients, families, colleagues, and community partners. You will bring sound judgment, a collaborative approach, and a commitment to BAYADA’s values of compassion, excellence, and reliability.

What You’ll Do

• Provide clinical guidance and oversight for Habilitation services, supporting safe, respectful, person-centered care.

• Help assess client needs and support the development, implementation, and review of service plans and clinical documentation.

• Conduct or support required client and employee supervisory visits in accordance with applicable state requirements and BAYADA policies.

• Coach and mentor team members, including supporting clinical skill development and sound decision-making.

• Collaborate with clients, families, case managers, care coordinators, and other professionals to promote coordinated support.

• Monitor service quality, clinical documentation, and outcomes; identify opportunities to improve care and processes.

• Support the office as it develops by helping build dependable clinical practices and a culture of compassion, excellence, and reliability.

• Participate in hiring, onboarding, training, and other activities that support a strong and growing team.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need

• Current, unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in Missouri.

• Prior supervisory experience.

• Strong clinical assessment, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to complete required competencies for the services and cases overseen.

• Commitment to supporting people with intellectual and developmental disabilities with dignity, respect, and person-centered care.

• Ability to travel within the assigned service area for client and employee visits, as needed.

• Basic computer skills and comfort with clinical documentation systems.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) highly desired but not required.

• Experience supporting people with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

• Experience in Habilitation, home- and community-based services, or a related care setting.

• Experience mentoring staff or supporting clinical quality and compliance initiatives.

Position Details

• Location: Poplar Bluff, Missouri

• Office: New Habilitation office

• Work model: In-office

• Schedule: Monday through Friday; 8:30-5pm

• Travel: Home Visits

Why BAYADA

At BAYADA, we believe every person deserves compassionate, high-quality care and the opportunity to live with dignity and purpose. Join us in building a new Habilitation team in Poplar Bluff—one that supports individuals, strengthens families, and creates a lasting positive impact in the community.

As an accredited, regulated, certified, and licensed home health care provider, BAYADA complies with all state/local mandates.

BAYADA is celebrating 50 years of compassion, excellence, and reliability. Learn more about our 50th anniversary celebration and how you can join in here.

BAYADA Home Health Care, Inc., and its associated entities and joint venture partners, are Equal Opportunity Employers. All employment decisions are made on a non-discriminatory basis without regard to sex, race, color, age, disability, pregnancy or maternity, sexual orientation, gender identity, citizenship status, military status, or any other similarly protected status in accordance with federal, state and local laws.  Hence, we strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of other marginalized communities.

Supports the culinary team with dishwashing, sanitation, cleaning, and routine meal preparation and service-support tasks. Helps ensure the kitchen, dining service areas, and meal service operations are clean, organized, stocked, and prepared to provide excellent service to residents and guests.

jobs.title: Brigádnik študent/Brigádnička študentka, Eperia Prešov
jobs.description:
ČO BUDETE ROBIŤ

Ako Brigádnik/Brigádnička v H&M zohráte kľúčovú úlohu pri vytváraní vynikajúceho zákazníckeho zážitku. Privítate zákazníkov, prevediete ich predajňou a pomôžete im nájsť, čo potrebujú, pričom budete prezentovať naše produkty. Svojimi rozhodnutiami v súlade s našimi hodnotami prispejete nielen k svojmu vlastnému úspechu, ale aj k úspechu celej spoločnosti.

Vaša náplň práce:

• Budete zdieľať svoje znalosti o móde a produktoch, aby ste pomohli zákazníkom urobiť informované rozhodnutia.
• Čaká vás spolupráca s vaším tímom na poskytovaní výnimočnej služby počas celého zákazníckeho zážitku, vrátane aktívnej propagácie vernostného programu H&M.
• Pomôžete zabezpečiť, aby predajná plocha a sklad boli dobre zásobené, organizované a prívetivé.
• Podporovať tím budete aj pri otváraní a zatváraní predajne.
• A taktiež budete pozitívne reprezentovať seba a značku pri všetkých interakciách so zákazníkmi.

S KÝM BUDETE PRACOVAŤ

Naše predajne sú srdcom našej spoločnosti, kde si zákazníci môžu naplno vychutnať zážitok s našou značkou. Ako súčasť dynamického predajného tímu – či už na pozícii Predajného poradcu, Vedúceho oddelenia, Vedúceho predajne, Dekoratéra alebo Hlavného pokladníka – budete prispievať k vytvoreniu inšpiratívneho a prívetivého prostredia. Okrem vášho tímu budete spolupracovať aj so širším Area tímom, vymieňať si poznatky a spoločne prispievať k celkovému úspechu. Spolu s kolegami budete zohrávať dôležitú úlohu pri pomoci zákazníkom cítiť sa sebavedomo, a pomôžete im vyjadriť svoju individualitu prostredníctvom najnovších trendov i nadčasových štýlov. Budovaním pevných vzťahov so zákazníkmi robíme módu prístupnou a udržateľnou pre všetkých.

KOHO HĽADÁME

Hľadáme ľudí, ktorí majú…​

• Skúsenosti so zákazníckym servisom v oblasti módy, retailu alebo v podobných odvetviach (predošlé skúsenosti budú považované za výhodu).
• Vášeň pre pomoc zákazníkom a záujem o módu alebo retail – zvyšok vás naučíme!

A ľudí ktorí…​

• Majú radi spoluprácu a dynamické prostredie.
• Sú komunikatívni, kreatívni, zvedaví na prácu s technológiami obchodu, s veľkou túžbou učiť sa a rozvíjať.
• Flexibilní a orientovaní na výsledky.
• Majú viac ako 18 rokov
• Sú flexibilní a môžu pracovať na popoludňajších zmenách

KTO SME​

H&M Group je globálna spoločnosť silných módnych značiek a inovatívnych projektov. Naším cieľom je dokázať, že nie je nutné robiť kompromisy medzi výnimočným dizajnom, dostupnými cenami a udržateľnými riešeniami. Chceme sprístupniť módu širokej verejnosti a zákazníci sú v centre každého nášho rozhodnutia. Máme tisícky vášnivých a talentovaných kolegov, ktorých spájajú spoločná kultúra a hodnoty. Spoločne chceme využiť našu silu, rozsah a znalosti na to, aby sme posunuli módny priemysel smerom k inkluzívnejšej a udržateľnejšej budúcnosti.

PREČO SI NÁS OBĽÚBITE

V H&M Group sme hrdí na to, že sme dynamickou a prívetivou spoločnosťou. Ponúkame atraktívne benefity a rozsiahle rozvojové príležitosti po celom svete.

• Stabilný zamestnávateľ,
• Rozsiahly program školení,
• Možnosť rastu v rámci spoločnosti (viac ako 70% našich náborových procesov je interných),
• Šanca zažiť unikátnu kultúru spoločnosti H&M,
• Občerstvenie na pracovisku.

PRIDAJTE SA K NÁM​

Naša jedinečnosť spočíva v kombinácii mnohých faktorov – našej inkluzívnej a spolupracujúcej kultúry, silných hodnôt a možností rastu. No predovšetkým sú to naši ľudia, ktorí robia našu spoločnosť tým, čím je.​ ​

Ide o pozíciu na dohodu s miestom výkonu práce v Prešove. Typ mimopracovnoprávneho vzťahu bude upresnený v priebehu náborového procesu.

Platové ohodnotenie vo výške 6,12 € za hodinu.

Neváhajte a prihláste sa čo najskôr, najneskôr však do 13.11.2026. Z dôvodu ochrany osobných údajov môžeme prijímať žiadosti len prostredníctvom našej kariérnej stránky.

Urobte ďalší krok vo svojej kariére spolu s nami. Vaša cesta začína tu.​

­­*Hodnotenie pozícií v predajni:

Aby sme zvládli vysoký objem prihlášok na pozíciu Predajného poradcu, používame online hodnotenie na základe zručností v rámci niektorých našich predajní. Tento proces budete musieť dokončiť ako súčasť prihlášky a výberového procesu. Vaše odpovede budú hodnotené nástrojom na hodnotenie, ktorý aplikuje vopred stanovené kritériá určené spoločnosťou H&M Group.

Po dokončení hodnotenia budete mať možnosť zdieľať feedback a položiť otázky. Ak narazíte na akékoľvek problémy alebo preferujete alternatívnu metódu hodnotenia, kontaktujte nás na  recruitment_support@hm.com. Výber alternatívy nebude mať vplyv na vašu prihlášku.

Viac informácií o tom, ako spracúvame vaše osobné údaje, nájdete v našich Zásadách ochrany osobných údajov.

** Zaviazali sme sa k spravodlivému a nestrannému výberovému procesu založenému na kompetenciách. Preto vás prosíme, aby ste k žiadosti neprikladali motivačný list.

jobs.title: High School History Teacher 2027-2028
jobs.description:
Who are We?

Brooke Charter Schools is a network of four public charter schools, serving grades K-12 in Mattapan, Roslindale, and East Boston. At Brooke, we coach and invest in our teachers so that they can help our students achieve at the highest levels and graduate from college. We believe academic achievement empowers our students to live choice-filled lives and enhances their ability to contribute to creating a just world. In a culture of achievement, educators support students in recognizing and building on their identities as sources of strength even as they work to grow and achieve in new ways.

What is the High School History Teacher Role?

As a History teacher at Brooke High School, you set the tone for student growth and learning. You are the leader of your classroom and build strong relationships with students in order to push them to be their best selves both academically and personally. You crave feedback, think deeply about instruction to ensure student mastery of critical college-level reading and writing skills, and collaborate with colleagues in order to meet the needs of every student. To that end, you will take part in regular data meetings, engage in approximately 20 administrative observations, and participate in nearly 300 hours of professional development over the course of the school year.

Hours for this role are 7:45 am-4:00 pm daily. You will partner with other history teachers to refine and teach the entire curriculum in social studies, and history. In this role you will teach multiple history classes and also serve as an advisor; advisors mentor students, communicate with families, and share information about colleges and character education. In addition, this role may include teaching an AP class, which would require you to attend AP-specific training to support high-level academic instruction. You may also choose to lead an after-school club or coach a sport for an additional stipend.

Salaries are competitive with local districts. Salary range is $74,000-$130,000. Commensurate with experience.

Is This You?

• You’ve earned a Bachelor’s degree.

• After at least 2 years as a lead teacher, you know the importance of building a joyful classroom culture where students are held to high behavioral and academic expectations. See what this looks like in action at Brooke here

• You are committed to fostering diversity by cultivating anti-racist practices and removing bias, empowering students with the resources they need to create choice filled lives for themselves and their futures. Read more about how we are working on this at Brooke here.

• You are professional, warm, and collaborative with students, families, and colleagues.

• You are able to start in July 2027

The community and students we serve are diverse, and we are committed to reflecting that diversity in our staff. We strive to have the most diverse applicant pool possible; to that end, we encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply for any position at Brooke Charter Schools. By fostering a diverse and inclusive environment, we provide the best educational experience to prepare our students for a future reflective of the world we live in.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant Business Partner II
jobs.description:
About the role and team

Working at Uber means solving hard problems in a high-stakes, fast-moving environment. As an Executive Assistant Business Partner (EABP), you are a strategic operator who provides the foundation for our leadership to move fast. This isn't just about scheduling; it's about navigating a global environment where priorities shift instantly and the logistical \"messiness\" of the real world-from complex conference room landscapes to international visa requirements-is yours to master.

Success here requires extreme ownership, grit, and the ability to stay steady under pressure. You will be part of an extraordinary EA community that prides itself on excellence and \"going boldly together.\" We are looking for a partner who thrives in ambiguity, anticipates needs before they are voiced, and is motivated by the challenge of coordinating movement at a global scale. If you are energized by a rapid pace and want to build a career where your impact is tangible every day, this is where you'll grow.

This role will support leaders in our Marketing and Safety organizations.

What you'll do

• Master complex, rapidly shifting calendars by acting as a strategic filter, vetting and prioritizing requests to ensure your leaders are focused on Uber's most critical goals.
• Lead the seamless execution of domestic and international travel logistics, managing intricate itineraries and visa processing with precision and urgency.
• Unblock leadership by driving accountability for project deadlines and deliverables, taking ownership of action items to ensure the team stays on track.
• Coordinate high-impact events-including QBRs, all-hands, and summits-balancing logistical complexity with a focus on team collaboration and morale.
• Navigate the intricacies of a matrixed environment, building trust fast with internal and external stakeholders to move projects forward through ambiguity.
• Manage sensitive operational tasks, including morale budgets and expense auditing, while handling confidential information with absolute discretion.

Basic Qualifications

• 6+ years of professional administrative experience.
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
• Proficiency in Google Workspace (Calendar, Mail, Docs, Sheets).

Preferred Qualifications

• 8+ years of administrative experience, with at least 4 years supporting VP or global Director-level leaders in a tech environment.
• Proven ability to take ownership over ambiguous situations and make high-stakes judgment calls with minimal oversight.
• Experience coordinating complex projects from start to finish within a global, matrixed organization.
• Strong financial acumen with experience in budget management and team expense reporting.
• Exceptional communication skills and the resilience to thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.

For New York City, NY-based roles: The base hourly rate range for this role is USD $51.93 per hour - USD $57.70 per hour.

You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, Account Expansion (Existing Customers)
jobs.description:
What Makes Us Stand Out:

Granum is the leading software company devoted to serving landscapers and arborists across North America, providing intuitive, industry-specific solutions designed to help them improve and grow their businesses while impressing their customers. Granum brings together three of the most trusted software names in the industry — LMN, SingleOps, and Greenius — into one powerful software ecosystem. More than just a software company, Granum works alongside its clients to implement systems for estimating, scheduling, crew training, invoicing, and payments, blending technology with hands-on onboarding and human support. The company's mission is to help industry professionals unlock their potential and achieve their most important goals, all united by the belief that its clients’ success is not just a milestone, but a shared mission.

As a team, we’re on a mission to reshape an age-old industry, and we’re looking for people who thrive on challenging and meaningful work. Our environment is highly collaborative, innovative, and supportive, with a shared commitment to having fun while making an impact. We live by our core values: We Before Me, Bias to Act, The Extra 1%, Accountable to Outcomes, Unconditional Transparency, and Forgiveness. If this resonates with you, we’d love to meet you and explore how you can help us build the future of the green industry!

Our culture and growth has been recognized with multiple awards, it’s a great time to join!

• Comparably 2024 #23/100 Best (small/ medium sized companies) Leadership Teams

• Comparably 2024 #63/75 (small/ medium sized companies) Happiest Employees

• #9 Atlanta Business Chronicle's 2024 Best Places to Work (Our second year in a row!)

• #6 of Built In’s 2024 Best Places to Work: Top 50 start-ups in Atlanta (Our second year in a row!)

• Inc Magazine’s 2023 Best Places to Work

• Inc. 5000: #131 of 2024 Southeast Regional America’s Fastest Growing Companies. (Our third year in a row!)

• Inc 5000 America's fastest-growing private companies (Our third year in a row!)

• Certified Great Place to Work Canada 2024

About the Role:

Our existing clients have already bet on Granum, and this role exists to make sure they’re getting everything they came for. As the founding Sales Development Representative for Account Expansion and LMN Pay, you’ll call into our current customer base to uncover untapped value: connecting clients to products they’re not yet using, driving adoption of our invoicing and payments solution, and generating expansion revenue by deepening the relationship.

This isn’t cold calling into a cold market. You’re reaching people who already know us, which means conversations start with trust and move faster when you bring the right energy and the right story.

You’ll report into the Sr. Director of Sales and work closely with Customer Success, Onboarding, and the Payments team to identify the right moments to engage and make sure clients land on the full platform. As our first person in this role, you’ll also help shape the playbook, from the messaging to how we hand off to Customer Success.

You’re a natural relationship-builder who gets energized by helping people see what’s possible. You ask good questions, listen closely, and know how to connect a client’s current frustrations to a solution that’s already inside their account.

What You'll Do:

• Call into our existing customer base to identify and qualify expansion opportunities, with a focus on upsell and cross-sell of the invoicing and payments product

• Drive adoption conversations with clients who haven't yet activated key Granum features

• Qualify and book expansion meetings for the Customer Success team, building pipeline from within the existing book of business

• Run high-volume outreach, phone-first with email and sequences as support, staying organized and consistent in your activity

• Partner with the Payment team and Customer Success to identify expansion signals and coordinate warm handoffs

• Track activity, pipeline, and outcomes in Salesforce with accuracy and discipline

• Stay sharp on the invoicing and payments product so you can speak to it confidently and handle common objections in the moment

• Share what messaging is landing, what objections you're hearing, and what's moving clients to act

Does This Sound Like You?

• Previous experience in sales, customer success, or account management, especially if you've had upsell or expansion conversations

• You're personable, energetic, and genuinely enjoy talking to people

• You're a natural conversationalist who can move from small talk to a real business conversation without it feeling forced

• You're goals-oriented and motivated by hitting numbers

• You're organized and disciplined, because high-volume outreach requires a system

• You work well in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and take feedback well

• You can pick up a product quickly and speak to it with confidence

• You're looking to build a career in sales and see this as a launchpad

A few ways to stand out

• Experience selling payments solutions to SMBs

• Experience selling into the green industry (landscape, tree care, snow and ice removal)

• Experience in B2B SaaS sales

Compensation:

• Canada-based candidates: Base $65-70,000 CAD + $20,000 CAD on target commission

• US-based candidates: Base $55-60,000 USD + $30,000 USD on target commission

#LI-Remote

Reasons why you would love it here!

• Join a team culture that’s all about collaboration, support, and having fun while making a real impact every day.

• In the U.S., we offer comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with multiple plan options, plus additional add ons like HSA/FSA accounts, disability and life insurance, and more.

• In Canada, we provide an employer-funded HSA-based benefits plan with drug, dental, and mental health coverage - giving you a flexible way to manage your healthcare needs.

• We're committed to your financial future, with 401(k) matching for U.S. employees and RRSP matching for those in Canada.

• We invest in your growth through tailored career development conversations and support for tools, courses, and resources to help you thrive.

• And when it comes to work-life balance? We offer unlimited Paid Time Off, paid company holidays, and a company-wide winter break from December 24 to January 1 - so you can truly recharge.

jobs.description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. Are you the person your recruiting team goes to when something needs fixing, answering, or building? As a Recruiting Operations Specialist, you'll keep the day-to-day requests from the recruiting team and our hiring partners moving quickly and accurately across our recruiting systems, reporting, and AI tools. Baseten is growing fast, and this role helps the recruiting team keep up.

Much of your time goes to intake: sorting requests, resolving what you can, routing the rest, and closing the loop. As you learn our systems, you'll take on project work that makes those requests less frequent over time.  - Pull data for recruiters and leadership, such as pass-through rates, interviewer load, and time-to-hire, and keep recurring reports accurate.

 - Build and maintain workflows, automations, and AI-powered tools that cut manual work, and help the team get the most out of them.

 - Write and maintain how-to guides, short video walkthroughs, onboarding material, and announcements when recruiting processes or tools change.

 - Spot patterns in incoming requests and turn them into lasting fixes, such as a guide, template, or tool.

 - Support larger recruiting programs by preparing data, testing new tools, and handling rollout tasks, and own smaller recruiting operations projects end to end.



REQUIREMENTS

 - 1+ year in recruiting coordination or recruiting operations, ideally at a fast-growing company.

 - Hands-on experience administering or configuring an applicant tracking system, not just using it (Ashby strongly preferred; Greenhouse, Lever, or Workday also relevant).

 - Experience building something with AI, like a prompt workflow, a custom GPT or Claude Project, or a small automation.

 - Strong triage judgment: you can decide what's urgent, what can wait, and when to escalate.

 - Highly organized and detail-oriented, and comfortable with a high volume of small requests without letting things drop.

 - Comfortable with spreadsheets and basic data work, such as filters, pivot tables, and spotting numbers that don't add up.

 - Clear, friendly written communication, especially in Slack and documentation.

 - Able to work from our San Francisco office Tuesday through Thursday.



NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience training others on tools or processes.

 - Experience in technical or AI/ML recruiting.



BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

 - (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

 - Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

 - Paid parental leave

 - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

 - (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

 - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.
