jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer
jobs.description:
JOIN THE SLEEP FITNESS MOVEMENT

At Eight Sleep, we’re on a mission to fuel human potential through optimal sleep. As the world’s first sleep fitness company, we’re redefining what it means to be well-rested and building the most advanced hardware, software, and AI technology to make it possible. Our products power peak mental, physical, and emotional performance by transforming every night of sleep into a personalized, data-driven recovery experience. We are trusted by high performers, professional athletes, and health-conscious consumers in over 30 countries worldwide. Recognized as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies in 2019, 2022, and 2023, and twice named to TIME's “Best Inventions of the Year.” We operate like a high-performance team: fast, focused, and motivated by impact. We don’t just ship; we iterate, refine, and obsess over the details that help our members sleep better and wake up stronger.

 

Every role at Eight Sleep is a chance to create cutting-edge technology, collaborate with world-class talent, and help shape a future where sleep isn’t passive - it’s a powerful tool for living better. If you’re tired of the ordinary and driven to build at the edge of what’s possible, this is your moment. Join us and lead the movement that’s transforming how the world sleeps and what we’re all capable of when we wake up.

 


HIGH STANDARDS. NO APOLOGIES.

We operate with intensity because our mission demands it. At Eight Sleep, we bring the same mindset as the world’s top performers: focused, relentless, and always pushing to be in the top 1% of our craft. Think Kobe Bryant’s mamba mentality, applied to bold ideas, next-gen tech, and flawless execution. This isn’t a 9-to-5. Our team is deeply committed, often putting in 60+ hours a week –not because we’re told to, but because we’re invested. We’re here to build fast, push limits, and deliver without compromise. If you thrive under pressure and want to do the most meaningful work of your career, you’ll feel right at home. If you’re looking for something easier –this isn’t it.

 


THE ROLE

You will work very closely with backend, firmware, and data engineers, with R&D and clinical teams, and directly with the Head of Security.

We are looking for an experienced Security Engineer who embraces an AI-first culture to enable them to scale beyond themselves. This is a generalist role with real ownership from day one: various portions of the security program including corporate IT, identity, AI Security, enterprise, and cloud. The ideal candidate has been "the security person" on a small team before — someone who takes whatever comes up, automates the second occurrence of anything, and writes clearly enough that engineers, auditors, and executives can all act on their work.

 


HOW YOU’LL CONTRIBUTE

Own Vulnerability management end-to-end

 - Design and run a risk-based vulnerability management program spanning cloud infrastructure, containers, application dependencies, the corporate fleet, and connected devices.

 - Prioritize by real-world exploitability and business impact — exploitation, reachability, internet exposure, and data sensitivity — not raw CVSS volume.

 - Define remediation SLAs  and build the automation that routes findings to the right owner, tracks them to closure, and escalates breaches before they become audit exceptions.

 - Own software supply chain security: dependency and package risk, SBOMs, container image hygiene, and guardrails in CI/CD.

 - Partner with firmware and hardware teams on vulnerability handling for the Pod, including coordinated disclosure intake and patch rollout.

 - Run penetration testing and any bug bounty program — scoping, vendor management, triage, and verified fixes.

 - Report vulnerability posture through clear metrics (exposure, SLA adherence, mean time to remediate) suitable for executives, auditors, and the board.

Participate in other areas of security

 - We're looking for someone that can lean in to other areas as needed including 
   
   - Set the technical strategy for corporate IT and identity: Google Workspace, device management, SSO, and an access lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, access reviews) that holds up to audit.
   
   - Keep compliance green with code: remediate failing controls at the infrastructure level.
   
   - Define how AI is adopted safely and ethically across the company, building the governance and tooling that make sanctioned AI easier to use than shadow AI.
   
   - Assist in incident response.
   
   - Run security design reviews for new systems and internal tools, and partner with teams to find secure paths to their goals rather than blockers.
   
   - Act as the Head of Security’s technical counterpart and the team’s second brain: triage inbound work, make sound calls independently, and represent security in cross-functional decisions.
   
   - Mentor engineers inside and outside security and set the standards, runbooks, and patterns others build on.


WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

 - AI-first mindset.   We empower the team with the best tools available to scale beyond themselves

 - 10+ years across security and/or IT engineering, including time leading major initiatives

 - Experience operating a SIEM (Datadog Cloud SIEM, Panther, Splunk, Elastic, or similar)

 - Corporate IT fluency: Google Workspace admin, MDM, identity lifecycle

 - Scripting ability (Python or similar)

 - Clear security writing and documentation: triage notes, runbooks, and audit evidence that engineers, agents, auditors, and executives can act on


BONUS POINTS FOR

 - Vanta (or Drata) ownership through a real audit cycle for SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA

 - Experience in a regulated or health-adjacent environment

 - Incident response experience beyond tabletop exercises

 


WHY JOIN EIGHT SLEEP?

Innovation in a culture of excellence

Join us in a workplace where innovation isn’t just encouraged - it’s a standard. Our flagship product, the Pod, is a testament to our culture of excellence, beloved by hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide. At Eight Sleep, you will be part of a team that continuously pushes the boundaries of technology in sleep fitness.

 

Immediate responsibility and accelerated career growth

From your first day, you’ll take on substantial responsibilities that have a direct impact on our core business and product success. We are a small team that empowers you to own your projects and see the tangible effects of your efforts, enhancing both your professional growth and our company’s trajectory. Collaboration with exceptional talent

jobs.title: Director / Senior Director, Technical Operations
jobs.description:
ARS Pharmaceuticals is a fast-growing, innovative company dedicated to transforming the treatment of severe allergic reactions with neffy®, the first and only FDA-approved needle-free epinephrine product. If you’re motivated to make a meaningful impact, this is your opportunity to join a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and inclusive culture.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Director / Senior Director, Technical Operations will provide strategic leadership for ARS' external manufacturing and Technical Operations activities supporting the continued development, lifecycle management, and commercial supply of neffy™. The successful candidate will combine strong technical, business, and operational leadership with cross-functional influence and CMO management expertise to drive manufacturing excellence, scalable operations, and reliable product supply.

This role is accountable for manufacturing strategy, CMO performance, process and technology lifecycle management, resolution of major technical issues, and execution of key Technical Operations initiatives across the ARS outsourced manufacturing network. Working closely with internal stakeholders and external partners, the position leads complex cross-functional programs, oversees partner performance and agreements, manages departmental planning and budgets, and ensures technical, supply, regulatory, and business risks are appropriately identified, assessed, and escalated.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Provide leadership for Technical Operations programs and external manufacturing activities, establishing strategy, priorities, scope, timelines, deliverables, responsibilities, budgets, risks, and key decision points.

• Own senior-level Technical Operations relationships with key CMOs/CDMOs and other external partners; establish governance, performance expectations, escalation pathways, and accountability for delivery against manufacturing and business commitments.

• Provide technical leadership for formulation and process development, scale-up, technology transfer, process characterization, process validation/PPQ, continued process verification, and manufacturing lifecycle management, as applicable.

• Oversee clinical and commercial manufacturing strategy and execution in coordination with external manufacturers and internal stakeholders; ensure appropriate Technical Operations support for critical manufacturing campaigns, product launches, and supply requirements.

• Provide senior technical review and oversight of manufacturing and process documentation, process performance, significant vendor changes, investigations, annual/product reviews, and significant deviations, out-of-specification or atypical results, and complex manufacturing problems; ensure robust technical investigation, root-cause analysis, effective corrective and preventive actions, continued process control, and reliable manufacturing in partnership with Quality Assurance.

• Lead technical assessments of significant manufacturing, process, component, and supplier changes and coordinate evaluation of quality, regulatory, supply, financial, and business impacts with appropriate functional stakeholders.

• Establish and review manufacturing, supply, and external partner performance metrics and KPIs, including service, quality, on-time delivery, right-first-time, cost, capacity, and other appropriate measures; drive lifecycle improvements, operational excellence, capacity planning, cost improvement, and risk-reduction initiatives across the external network.

• Lead external partner business and technical governance, including selection and strategic development of CMOs, CDMOs, suppliers, and other critical partners; establish performance expectations and governance mechanisms, oversee business reviews, scopes of work, proposals, change orders, contract and supply agreement support, and escalation of commercial or operational issues; and develop business continuity, capacity, and second-source strategies for critical manufacturing capabilities and materials.

• Represent Technical Operations on cross-functional program and leadership teams; communicate manufacturing strategy, program status, significant risks, financial implications, and recommendations to senior management and key stakeholders.

• Partner with Regulatory Affairs on CMC strategy, regulatory submissions, post-approval changes, and health authority responses; ensure manufacturing plans and technical decisions are aligned with regulatory commitments.

• Lead Technical Operations business planning and continuous improvement initiatives, including departmental budget development with Finance/FP&A, contract lifecycle management, operational process standardization, and long-range manufacturing planning.

• Provide leadership and governance for commercial supply operations managed within Technical Operations, including 3PL and distribution partner performance, inventory and supply continuity, shipping/returns interfaces, and support of product launches and new markets.

• Oversee the commercial serialization program, including serialized packaging operations, EPCIS data exchange with trading partners and service providers, and compliance with applicable Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA) requirements; ensure issues are appropriately escalated and resolved cross-functionally.

• Provide leadership and oversight for clinical supply operations, including clinical material planning, packaging, labeling, distribution, inventory/expiry management, and coordination of Interactive Response Technology/Interactive Web Response System (IRT/IWRS) activities with Clinical Operations and external vendors.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

• Broad and deep knowledge of cGMP, pharmaceutical manufacturing, quality systems, formulation and process development, scale-up, technology transfer, process validation, lifecycle management, and applicable CMC regulatory expectations, with the technical credibility to critically challenge external partner data, conclusions, and recommendations.

• Demonstrated leadership of outsourced manufacturing relationships, complex cross-functional programs, and teams, including governance, performance management, contract/scope management, budgeting, executive-level escalation, influence without direct authority, and accountability of external partners for performance and commitments.

• Strong strategic, analytical, and problem-solving capability, with demonstrated ability to evaluate complex technical and business issues, balance risk, cost, supply continuity, and regulatory considerations, and make sound recommendations.

• Excellent written, verbal, negotiation, and presentation skills with the ability to influence across functions and organizational levels and communicate effectively with senior management and external partners.

• Strong business and financial acumen, including the ability to translate budgets, forecasts, manufacturing costs, contract terms, and operational metrics into business decisions and actions.

• Experience establishing scalable Technical Operations processes and systems; proficiency with Microsoft Office and relevant project, reporting, or data-management tools.

• Demonstrated knowledge of commercial and clinical supply operations within an outsourced model, including 3PL management, serialization/EPCIS and DSCSA compliance, and clinical supply/IRT/IWRS processes.

• Must be able to travel domestically and internationally up to approximately 25% to support external manufacturing partners, governance meetings, and key manufacturing activities.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor’s degree in pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry, chemical engineering, engineering, or related scientific/technical discipline; an advanced degree (MS, PhD, or MBA) is preferred. An acceptable combination of education and relevant experience will also be considered.

• Minimum of 10+ years of relevant pharmaceutical/biotechnology experience in Technical Operations, manufacturing, process development, CMC, or related functions, with demonstrated leadership of complex programs and external manufacturing relationships.

• Significant experience managing external CMOs/CDMOs in an outsourced operating model and supporting GMP clinical and commercial manufacturing is required.

• Experience with drug-device combination products, nasal/inhalation products, sterile manufacturing, process validation/PPQ, commercial product launch, and lifecycle management is strongly preferred.

• Experience supporting CMC regulatory strategy and submissions, major investigations and change controls, vendor/supply agreements, budget planning, and business continuity is preferred. Prior people-management or functional leadership experience is strongly preferred.

• Experience overseeing commercial distribution and 3PL partners, serialization/EPCIS and DSCSA compliance, and clinical supply operations including IRT/IWRS is strongly preferred; experience across multiple of these areas is preferred.

At ARS, we are proud to offer a highly competitive compensation & benefits package.

The full-time salary range for this posted position is $225,000 to $275,000 and may be eligible for a discretionary annual performance bonus. Actual pay rates are determined by considering multiple factors including qualifications, relevance of experience, education & credentials, subject matter expertise, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

This position is also eligible for Equity, 401k matching, and our excellent benefits package including 100% employer paid Medical, Dental & Vision for employees. View the full package here: ARS Careers Page

ARS Pharmaceuticals is also committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals so that an individual can perform their job-related duties. If you are interested in applying for an employment opportunity and require special assistance or an accommodation to apply due to a disability, please contact us at careers@ars-pharma.com

jobs.title: Organizational Effectiveness Lead
jobs.description:
About Tutor
We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business.
Tutor Intelligence is changing that.
Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Sonny is a semi-humanoid robot with frontier dexterity approaching the human form. Cassie does back-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence.
Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems.
Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world.
 
Why Tutor?
Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable.
Our team of 160+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in.

jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer
jobs.description:
The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our AI/ML team. This individual will play a central role in designing, building, and deploying the machine learning systems that power our platform, with a focus on large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic orchestration, and production-grade model deployment.

You will work across the full ML lifecycle, from framing problems and experimenting with models, to fine-tuning and deploying them in production and monitoring their performance. Beyond shipping models, you will influence architecture decisions, set ML best practices, and help define how AI shapes our product and scientific workflows. This is an opportunity to work closely with world-class scientists, engineers, and researchers in a fast-moving, mission-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, build, and deploy ML systems that power the product, translating scientific and product requirements into concrete ML problems (e.g., retrieval, summarization, classification, agentic reasoning)

• Architect and implement scalable RAG and LLM-based systems that integrate multi-modal data sources, including structured datasets, documents, and knowledge graphs where relevant

• Build and maintain agentic orchestration frameworks that coordinate LLM-based agents for end-to-end reasoning, data retrieval, and decision support

• Own the ML pipeline end-to-end: data collection, cleaning, feature engineering, labeling, training, evaluation, and deployment

• Fine-tune and evaluate LLMs and other models for production use, with attention to reliability, latency, and cost

• Set up lightweight MLOps practices, including CI/CD for models, reproducibility, and experiment tracking

• Make pragmatic technical decisions, balancing off-the-shelf APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) against custom-built or fine-tuned solutions

• Influence architecture decisions and help define ML best practices across the team

• Collaborate cross-functionally with data engineering, product, and domain experts to translate interdisciplinary insights into computational frameworks

• Communicate findings and technical tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Professional Experience & Qualifications

• Master's degree (or above) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field; equivalent practical experience considered

• 5+ years of professional experience in applied machine learning

• Strong foundation in machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing (NLP)

• Proven experience deploying LLM-powered applications in production environments, including experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, vLLM, or LangGraph

• Hands-on experience with RAG, agentic orchestration, or multi-agent systems is strongly preferred

• Proficiency in Python and tools for ML development, large-scale data pipelines, and standard evaluation protocols

• Experience owning systems end-to-end in a production environment, including monitoring and iterating post-deployment

• Self-motivated and comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments with evolving goals

• Excellent communication and presentation skills; able to work with both technical and non-technical collaborators

• Experience in a previous startup is a plus

• Publications at top ML / NLP venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, or EMNLP are a bonus

About Flagship

Flagship Pioneering is a bioplatform innovation company that invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health or sustainability. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated and fostered more than 100 scientific ventures, resulting in more than $90 billion in aggregate value. Many of the companies Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture.  Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies, and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Learn more about Flagship at www.flagshippioneering.com.

Flagship Pioneering and our ecosystem companies are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Experience comes in many forms, skills are transferable, and passion goes a long way. We are dedicated to building diverse and inclusive teams and look forward to learning more about your unique background.

jobs.title: Guest Experience Agent
jobs.description:
The Guest Experience Agent is responsible for delivering exceptional, personalized, and memorable guest experiences throughout the entire guest journey, from pre-arrival to departure.

As a key ambassador of Our Habitas Ras Abrouq, the Guest Experience Agent ensures that every guest feels genuinely welcomed, valued, and connected to the resort's unique philosophy of hospitality, culture, and human connection.

The role involves managing guest arrivals and departures, handling inquiries and requests, coordinating guest experiences, and ensuring seamless communication across departments. The Guest Experience Agent is expected to demonstrate warmth, professionalism, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to anticipating guest needs while maintaining luxury hospitality standards.

Guest Arrival and Departure Experience

• Deliver a warm, personalized, and seamless welcome to all arriving guests in accordance with Our Habitas brand standards.
• Manage guest check-in and check-out procedures efficiently while ensuring accuracy and professionalism.
• Review daily arrivals, departures, VIP guests, repeat guests, and special requests.
• Ensure guest preferences, room allocations, and special arrangements are communicated to relevant departments.
• Escort guests to their assigned villas when required, providing an introduction to the resort's facilities, services, and experiences.
• Coordinate luggage handling and transportation arrangements with the appropriate teams.
• Ensure all departure formalities, including billing and payment settlements, are completed accurately.
• Create positive and memorable first and last impressions.

Guest Relations and Personalized Service

• Build genuine relationships with guests through warm, engaging, and attentive interactions.
• Anticipate guest needs and proactively offer personalized recommendations and assistance.
• Maintain accurate guest profiles, preferences, special occasions, and service history.
• Recognize VIP guests, repeat visitors, and guests celebrating special occasions.
• Handle guest inquiries, requests, and concerns promptly and professionally.
• Resolve guest complaints with empathy, discretion, and effective service recovery.
• Follow up on guest requests to ensure complete satisfaction.
• Promote a welcoming and inclusive environment that reflects the Our Habitas philosophy of human connection.

Guest Experience and Resort Activities

• Provide accurate information about resort facilities, dining venues, wellness offerings, activities, and experiences.
• Assist guests with restaurant reservations, wellness appointments, recreational activities, and special arrangements.
• Coordinate with Food & Beverage, Spa & Wellness, Housekeeping, and other departments to facilitate personalized experiences.
• Recommend resort activities and experiences based on guest interests and preferences.
• Support the organization of special occasions, celebrations, and private guest experiences.
• Ensure guests are informed of activity schedules, operational updates, and resort guidelines.
• Promote resort offerings in a natural and guest-focused manner.

Front Office Operations

• Perform daily Front Office duties, including reservations verification, guest registration, billing, cashiering, and administrative tasks.
• Maintain accurate guest information and transaction records in the Property Management System (PMS).
• Answer telephone calls, emails, and guest messages promptly and professionally.
• Coordinate room readiness, early arrivals, late departures, and special accommodation requests.
• Ensure proper handover of outstanding guest requests and operational information between shifts.
• Maintain cleanliness, organization, and professional presentation of guest reception areas.
• Follow established cash-handling, payment-processing, and financial procedures.
• Support other Front Office functions as required by operational needs.

Luxury Service Standards – LQA and Forbes Travel Guide

• Deliver consistent service in accordance with applicable Leading Quality Assurance (LQA) and Forbes Travel Guide standards, as well as Our Habitas brand expectations.
• Demonstrate professional telephone etiquette, personalized guest recognition, and attentive communication.
• Ensure guest interactions are warm, natural, courteous, and tailored to individual preferences.
• Anticipate guest needs and demonstrate proactive service rather than relying solely on guest requests.
• Maintain high standards of personal grooming, body language, communication, and professional conduct.
• Participate in service quality assessments, training sessions, and departmental audits.
• Apply feedback from quality assessments to continuously improve guest experiences.
• Maintain discretion and confidentiality when handling guest information and sensitive situations.
• Support the resort's preparation for internal and external luxury service assessments, where applicable.

Guest Feedback and Service Recovery

• Actively seek guest feedback during their stay to identify opportunities for improvement.
• Respond promptly to guest concerns and escalate unresolved matters to the appropriate supervisor or manager.
• Record guest complaints, incidents, and service recovery actions accurately.
• Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure timely resolution of guest issues.
• Follow up with guests after service recovery to confirm their satisfaction.
• Share recurring guest concerns and feedback with management to support continuous improvement.
• Contribute to improving guest satisfaction scores and positive online reviews.

Safety, Security and Compliance

• Ensure compliance with company policies, operational procedures, and applicable Qatar regulations.
• Verify guest identification and registration details in accordance with legal requirements.
• Protect guest privacy and maintain the confidentiality of personal and payment information.
• Follow resort safety, security, and emergency response procedures.
• Report suspicious activities, safety hazards, guest incidents, and operational concerns immediately.
• Coordinate with the Security Team when required to ensure guest safety and comfort.
• Maintain awareness of emergency evacuation procedures and resort safety protocols.

Teamwork and Cross-Departmental Coordination

• Maintain effective communication with Housekeeping, Engineering, Food & Beverage, Spa & Wellness, Security, and other departments.
• Participate in daily briefings, departmental meetings, and training sessions.
• Support colleagues during busy operational periods to ensure seamless guest service.
• Communicate important guest information and operational updates accurately.
• Demonstrate flexibility in assisting with other guest-facing responsibilities when required.
• Promote a positive working environment based on teamwork, respect, and collaboration.
• Support newly joined associates in understanding guest service expectations and resort procedures.

• Diploma or bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Tourism, Hotel Management, or a related discipline is preferred.
• Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Front Office, Guest Relations, or Guest Experience, preferably within a luxury hotel or resort.
• Previous experience in a five-star hotel, boutique luxury resort, or lifestyle hospitality brand is an advantage.
• Familiarity with LQA, Forbes Travel Guide, or other luxury hospitality service standards is desirable.
• Experience using hotel Property Management Systems, preferably Opera or a similar platform.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; additional languages are an advantage.
• Strong interpersonal skills with a warm, engaging, and guest-focused personality.
• Ability to handle guest complaints and challenging situations professionally.
• Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multicultural team.
• Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays according to operational requirements.

What's in it for you...

• The opportunity to join an innovative, fast-growing, international group that’s committed to not just building new hotels but building a global brand.
• The chance to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.
• Become part of a team that’s very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences and exploring new locations at every opportunity.
• A competitive package and plenty of opportunity for development.
• Excellent discounts across the entire Ennismore family of brands.

Working at Our Habitas means being part of a purpose-driven movement. You will help shape stories that go beyond rooms and amenities, creating emotional experiences and connecting people through shared rituals, culture, and a sense of belonging.

If you believe in luxury that speaks to the soul, and want to build something meaningful in two of Middle East's most extraordinary destinations, we’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: GTM Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells https://blog.roboflow.com/cancer-research-computer-vision/ to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety https://blog.roboflow.com/preventing-accidents-on-construction-sites-with-computer-vision/, digitizing floor plans https://blog.roboflow.com/floor-plan-analysis-computer-vision/, preserving coral reef populations https://blog.roboflow.com/reefos-supercharging-coral-reef-restoration-with-ai/, guiding drone flight https://blog.roboflow.com/georeferencing-drone-videos/, and much more https://roboflow.com/templates.

Our team is small relative to our impact, and we believe our user success is our success (not the inverse). A team member summarized: “Roboflow is a company full of giant brains and tiny egos.” We find software has a multiplier effect on all roles (not only product and engineering), so Roboflow employs developers across the company in design, sales, customer support, marketing, and beyond.

We’re supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Google Ventures, Y Combinator, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

We’re hiring a GTM Systems Engineer to build and scale the systems our revenue team runs on, reporting into the Revenue Operations lead and working hand-in-hand with sales leadership, finance, marketing, and data engineering. Revenue Operations owns the operating system for go-to-market at Roboflow: how pipeline is measured, how the forecast is built, how territories and account handoffs work, and whether the numbers can be trusted. This role is hands-on and execution-focused: you’ll implement, customize, and scale Salesforce and the broader GTM tech stack (Outreach, enrichment platforms, and more), while also building custom tooling and AI-powered workflows where off-the-shelf solutions fall short.

You’ll start by building under the direction of the Revenue Operations team and grow into ownership of our Salesforce architecture as the function scales. As our sales team grows, the systems you ship will shape how quickly new reps ramp, how accurately we forecast, and how cleanly accounts move from a first land to enterprise-wide expansion. You’ll partner closely with sales stakeholders, ops, and engineering to turn requirements into shipped solutions.

 - Build and extend Salesforce functionality (Apex, LWC, Flows, custom objects), turning Revenue Operations designs into working, tested, source-controlled systems

 - Implement the data models behind how we sell: account hierarchies and site-level data, product catalog and packaging, territory and coverage assignment, and account handoffs between sales teams

 - Build the inputs and enforcement behind our forecasting models: stage exit criteria and stage gates, forecast categories, pipeline snapshots, and the field history needed to track forecast accuracy over time

 - Partner with data engineering on programmatic BI: SQL and BigQuery, code-defined dashboards on Salesforce data, and native Salesforce reports, templates, and folder/permission structures as the self-service layer for end users

 - Own data quality across Salesforce and connected GTM systems, including deduplication, field standardization, ownership cleanup, and the cleanup views that show each rep what to fix and why it matters

 - Lead integration and data pipeline work across the GTM stack, including migrations as we retire and replace tools

 - Build the infrastructure for partner and cloud marketplace revenue: deal registration, sourced vs. influenced attribution, and reporting the whole team trusts

 - Facilitate the variable compensation program by providing data quality and management support

 - Serve as the control point for AI agents in our GTM stack (permissions, access, and rollout), and design and deploy AI- and LLM-powered GTM workflows yourself

 - Share end user support with the rest of the team, including lead routing and assignment troubleshooting, round-robin logic, SLA misses, and bulk list uploads for marketing campaigns and sales prospecting


WHO YOU ARE

You are a systems builder with strong GTM instincts who wants to be an important part of an exceptional team that focuses on using Roboflow's computer vision tools to impact and improve every industry. You have high agency and a bias toward action.

Required Skills:

 - 5+ years of experience building on Salesforce in a technical admin or developer capacity

 - 5+ years supporting Sales, RevOps, or GTM teams

 - Working knowledge of Salesforce, Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce Integrations

 - Experience testing and deploying solutions, ideally with source tracking and the Salesforce Metadata API

 - Experience implementing automation, custom objects, and non-trivial business logic

 - Working SQL and experience with a data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar)

 - Practical understanding of GTM concepts: product catalogs, pipeline, forecasting, territories, renewals, expansion, compensation planning and administration

 - Experience working across an ecosystem of GTM tools including communication platforms, enrichment platforms, quoting tools, CLMs, e-signature platforms, etc.

 - Hands-on experience building or integrating LLM-based workflows, and building with AI coding agents

Preferred Skills:

 - Salesforce Platform Developer Level 1 certification or higher

 - Hands on experience with source control, particularly for Salesforce deployments

 - Experience with land-and-expand enterprise sales motions, PLG, or developer-first companies

 - Experience with partner, channel, or cloud marketplace operations

 - Experience with stakeholder management

 - Experience with, and a willingness to learn, how to leverage AI to optimize output and outcomes

 - Experience managing or supporting variable compensation programs


WHERE YOU'LL WORK

Roboflow is a fully distributed company. We currently have Hubs in New York City, San Francisco and Brazil (and plan to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources https://blog.roboflow.com/how-we-work-together-at-roboflow/ (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!




WHAT YOU'LL RECEIVE

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

📈 In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

 - $4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

 - Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family

 - $350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

 - $350/mo AI Stipend

 - $500 one time home office stipend

 - $150/mo Team lunch stipend

 - Unlimited PTO - with an annual 2 week minimum, we encourage you to take time off for yourself

 - 12 weeks parental leave

 - Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision


INTERVIEW PROCESS 

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role. We’re committed to building an exceptional team and aim to be thoughtful while also moving quickly. We respect your time and strive to make decisions efficiently, depending on scheduling and availability.

You’ll have several conversations with the hiring manager, a member of the Roboflow leadership team, and complete a role-relevant project or challenge.

Throughout the process, you’ll speak directly with team members about what it’s like to work and succeed at Roboflow. Below is the interview process you can expect for this role.



Before the Interview:

 - We’ll review your application, LinkedIn, Github, etc.

 - The best way to stand out is to write about something you’ve built with Roboflow or contribute to one of our open source projects https://roboflow.com/open-source.

Introduction Phase:

 - [30m] Meet with recruiter and/or hiring manager to assess for overall mindset and skillset

 - [60m] Technical Assessment

Team Interview Phase:

 - [30m] Meet with another member of the team

 - [30m] Meet with another member of the team

Final Interview Stage

 - [30m] Additional leadership discussion to discuss culture

References

 - References are required as part of our process. We will reach out to coordinate timing.

Note: you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet and we will accommodate as best we can.



Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team with a broad range of experience and perspectives. We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

Learn More About Us

At Roboflow, we believe great ideas come from everywhere, and everyone. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team:

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn, and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding, and happiness. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

The Opportunity:

As an NYC-based Strategic Account Manager, Marketing Programs, you will play a critical role in driving the growth and performance of Agoda and Priceline's North American hotel partner network. This is a highly cross-functional role that combines commercial account management, regional operations, analytics, and strategic project execution.

What You’ll Do:

You will work closely with Market Managers, Regional Directors, and commercial leadership to identify growth opportunities, improve partner performance, and support key regional initiatives. Leveraging data, market insights, and partner feedback, you will help shape supply strategies, optimize marketing program adoption, and deliver actionable recommendations that drive business results.

The ideal candidate is analytical, commercially minded, comfortable working with data, and passionate about solving business problems in a fast-paced environment.

• Working knowledge of SQL (or similar query language) and experience with BI / data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Superset, etc.) or willingness to learn quickly

jobs.title: Staff Radar Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Radar team at Anduril develops state-of-the-art airborne sensing capabilities for air-to-air surveillance, aerial threat detection, and intelligence gathering missions. Our software-defined radars provide persistent, all-weather detection and tracking of aerial targets and ground threats from airborne platforms, seamlessly integrating with Lattice OS to enable autonomous decision-making and multi-sensor fusion. We're building next-generation airborne radar systems that are rapidly deployable, adaptable across multiple aircraft platforms, and designed for modern air combat operations—from protecting airspace to enabling advanced airborne early warning and fire control capabilities.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Lead systems architecture and mode development for airborne radar systems across manned and unmanned platforms

• Develop and implement advanced radar processing algorithms with focus on DSP, waveform design, and electronic protection techniques

• Drive end-to-end radar system design from concept through operational deployment, ensuring operationally-focused solutions

• Design and refine advanced airborne RF sensing modes and algorithms including SAR, ISAR, GMTI, and air-to-air tracking

• Conduct rigorous system-level analysis and requirements decomposition for airborne radar subsystems

• Provide technical leadership in software development for radar mode implementation and real-time processing

• Engage directly with government customers and operational users to understand mission requirements and translate them into technical solutions

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define architectures and concepts of operations for airborne systems-of-systems

• Create, communicate, and establish consensus for internal development roadmaps for airborne radar capabilities

• Mentor and guide team members in radar theory, systems engineering, and operational best practices

• Support programmatic and business leadership with technical expertise for strategic decision-making

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 12+ years of experience & a Bachelor's degree in mathematics, physics, engineering, or other technical field (advanced degree strongly preferred)

• Proven experience in a Staff or Principal-level technical leadership role developing operational airborne defense radar systems

• Deep expertise in airborne radar systems engineering, mode development, and software architecture

• Strong background in algorithm development, digital signal processing, and electronic protection techniques

• End-to-end radar systems experience spanning hardware, software, and operational deployment

• Demonstrated ability to work directly with operational customers and translate mission needs into technical requirements

• Operationally-focused mindset with experience fielding systems in real-world environments (not purely academic/research focused)

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Delivery Expert Domino's (6311)- Manhattan KS
jobs.description:
Check all products for accuracy against quality standards and deliver products to customers safely, courteously, and timely while working as part of a team. Support the restaurant by performing other workstation duties. Comply with Domino’s uniform, appearance, operations standards and federal, state, and local laws and ordinances.

Perform duties including pre-delivery vehicle preparation, learning the delivery area, checking orders for quality and accuracy, following proper delivery procedures, and providing quality customer service through positive and professional interaction with customers in person or by phone. Deliver flyers and door hangers.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

 Perform duties including pre-delivery vehicle preparation, learning the delivery area, checking orders for quality and accuracy, following proper delivery procedures; providing quality customer service through positive and professional interaction with customers in person or by phone. Deliver flyers and door hangers.

 Deliver pizza to individual customer homes.

 Must be able to safely interact with customers at their homes.

 Receive and process telephone orders.

 Handle sensitive and confidential customer information in a responsible manner.

 Execute credit transactions, and make bank deposits as necessary.

 Work as part of a team and assist each other by being on time for their shift, supporting other workstations during their shift and completing all closing duties, including cleaning, at the end of each shift. Contribute to an atmosphere of teamwork, energy and fun.

 Navigational skills needed to read a map and locate addresses within designated delivery area. Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

 Operate all equipment. Clean equipment and facility daily. Perform other assigned workstation duties including making quality products, preparing ingredients, preparing product, and taking orders.

 Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change. Must have verbal, written and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/finders to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed. Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touchscreen.

 Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler. Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

 Ability to safely operate a motor vehicle.

Physical Demands

 STANDING: Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with some linoleum in the back area. Height of work surfaces is between 28" — 48".

 WALKING: Walking is generally in short distances for short durations.

 SITTING: Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

 LIFTING: Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are lifted/moved to walk-in cooler or other sections of the store by the team member. Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'. Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

 CARRYING: Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves. Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store. Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray. During delivery, carry pizzas, sides and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

 PUSHING: Pushing is performed to move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24"-72" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push. Trays may also be pulled.

 CLIMBING: Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, and perform maintenance.

 STOOPING/BENDING: Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station. Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station. Duration of this position is approximately 30-45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day. Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

 CROUCHING/SQUATTING: Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

 REACHING: Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward. Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves. Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes. Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

 HAND TASKS: Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day. Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists. Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the railing cutter. Frequent and/or

forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes. Team members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

MACHINES, TOOLS, EQUIPMENT, WORK AIDS: Team members may be required to utilizepencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizzapeel.

DRIVING: Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A team member may makeseveral deliveries per shift.

WALKING: Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and fromthe delivery vehicle to the customer's location with a steady and efficient (hustle) pace.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO: Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks, as well as when delivering product, driving and couponing. In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas. Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside. Fumes from food odors. Exposure to cornmeal dust. Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher. Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING: Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks. Depth perception. Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces. Far vision and night vision for driving.

TEMPERAMENTS: The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people,analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

Education and/or Experience

High School diploma or GED

Additional Information

Must be 18 years of age or older

Must have a driver’s license valid under the laws of the state(s) where the team member works, acceptable motor vehicle record, proof of insurance, and satisfactory vehicle

Must be able to work scheduled or unscheduled shifts, which will include nights, weekends, and as emergencies arise

Must be cross-trained and perform other workstation duties within the restaurant as needed

Bilingual in certain markets

Non-exempt, hourly position.  Split pay wage based on in store and on the road rates.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Production Engineering
jobs.description:
About Tutor
We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business.
Tutor Intelligence is changing that.
Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Our robots range from a semi-humanoid with frontier dexterity approaching the human form to workhorses that do back-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence.
Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems.
Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world.

jobs.title: Float Phlebotomist / Administrative Assistant (Sugarloaf)
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

The Opportunity

As a One Medical Float Phlebotomist/Administrative Assistant (internally known as Flex Lab Services Specialist/Member Support Specialist), at one of our offices presently focused on our Senior Health member population (age 65+), you’ll provide an exceptional experience for our patients and help them accomplish an important part of their care journey by providing venipuncture as well as other clinical support services. You will be an ambassador for patients, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for our patients, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or providers.

You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You combine excellent specimen collection technique with tactful interpersonal skills during every interaction with your patients, at both the front desk and in the lab. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. You bring self-awareness to your daily work to utilize your strengths and develop your areas of opportunity. You thrive in cultures that focus on feedback and growth and are nimble in their approach to respond to the needs of the patients and team. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect. Our Flex Lab Services Specialist/Member Support Specialists support multiple offices in a Market.

What you’ll likely work on:

jobs.title: Night Porter - 32-hour contract
jobs.description:
Please only apply if you have a year of experience in a Hotel overnight or on Reception. We do not have any opportunities for sponsorship, so please only apply if you have unrestricted right to work in the United Kingdom.

We are looking for a reliable, confident and customer-focused Night Porter to become an important part of our team at Mercure Newcastle George Washington Hotel, Golf & Spa.

Working overnight, you will be one of the key people responsible for the hotel while much of the world is asleep. This is a varied and responsible role where you will be the welcoming face of the hotel for arriving guests, the reassuring point of contact for guests staying overnight and an important part of maintaining the security, safety and smooth operation of the entire property.

As our Night Porter, you will be trusted to work independently and use your initiative. You will need to balance exceptional guest service with important operational and security responsibilities, ensuring that guests receive a warm, professional and helpful experience while maintaining the standards expected of a Mercure hotel.

No two nights will be exactly the same. You may be checking in a late-arriving guest, assisting with a guest query, preparing food or drinks from our overnight offering, completing the Night Audit, responding to an emergency, preparing meeting rooms for the following day or carrying out security checks around the hotel and its grounds.

You will be expected to know the hotel inside and out. From bedrooms, Food & Beverage and meeting facilities to our Montana Spa & Leisure Club and Golf Course, you will be able to confidently assist guests and provide helpful information throughout their stay.

The role requires someone who is comfortable taking responsibility. During the night, you will often need to make decisions independently and respond calmly and professionally to unexpected situations, while knowing when to involve the Night Manager, Duty Manager or emergency services.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Providing a warm, professional and welcoming service to all guests throughout the night.
• Welcoming late arrivals and completing guest check-in and check-out procedures accurately and efficiently.
• Assisting guests with luggage and providing information about the hotel, its facilities and the local area.
• Acting as the main point of contact for guest enquiries and requests overnight.
• Operating the hotel telephone and switchboard professionally and ensuring calls are handled and transferred appropriately.
• Completing the Night Audit accurately and balancing the hotel's daily revenue.
• Checking that guest charges, payments and overnight transactions have been posted correctly.
• Handling cash and card payments in accordance with hotel financial procedures and reporting any discrepancies.
• Preparing and serving food and beverages from the hotel's overnight offering, including alcoholic beverages in accordance with licensing requirements.
• Ensuring Food & Beverage charges are correctly posted to guest rooms.
• Identifying opportunities to promote and upsell hotel facilities, Food & Beverage and other services where appropriate.
• Maintaining the security of the hotel, including guest valuables, departmental keys, cash floats and restricted areas.
• Carrying out regular patrols of the hotel building and grounds throughout the night.
• Monitoring and appropriately responding to suspicious behaviour, unauthorised persons or security concerns.
• Ensuring the safety and wellbeing of guests and colleagues by following hotel fire, health and safety, security and emergency procedures.
• Responding calmly and effectively to incidents, emergencies and unexpected situations.
• Maintaining a visible presence throughout the hotel during the night.
• Setting up and breaking down meeting rooms and event spaces when required for the following day's business.
• Ensuring Reception, public areas, restaurant, function rooms and other designated areas are clean, tidy and presented to the required standard.
• Supporting the wider hotel operation by completing reasonable overnight duties and preparing the hotel for the following day.

This is a role for someone who enjoys responsibility, takes pride in looking after people and understands the importance of being both welcoming and vigilant.

When guests need assistance in the middle of the night, you will be the person they turn to. When the hotel needs someone to protect its guests, property and reputation, you will be there to take responsibility.

We are looking for someone who is dependable, professional and comfortable taking responsibility.

Previous hotel experience is essential for this role, as you will be expected to work confidently and independently during overnight shifts.

You will ideally have:

• Previous experience working in a hotel environment, ideally within Reception, Night Reception, Night Porter or Duty Management responsibilities.
• Excellent customer service skills and a genuine ability to make guests feel welcome.
• A professional, friendly and approachable personality with strong communication skills.
• The confidence to work independently and make sensible decisions when senior management are not immediately present.
• Experience of hotel reservation, billing or property management systems.
• Good numerical skills and strong attention to detail, particularly when handling cash, payments and completing the Night Audit.
• Experience of cash handling and following financial reconciliation procedures.
• A strong awareness of security and the confidence to challenge suspicious or unauthorised behaviour appropriately.
• The ability to remain calm, professional and decisive in challenging or emergency situations.
• Good general IT skills and the ability to learn new systems quickly.
• A good knowledge of customer service and the ability to handle guest complaints and concerns professionally.
• A flexible approach to work and a willingness to undertake a wide variety of duties across the hotel.
• The physical ability to undertake practical duties, including assisting with luggage, moving furniture and setting up meeting rooms.
• Excellent attention to cleanliness, presentation and detail.
• A strong sense of responsibility and integrity.

A Food Hygiene Certificate would be advantageous, although full training can be provided.

You must be aged 18 or over, as serving alcoholic beverages forms part of the role.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone we can trust to represent the hotel professionally throughout the night. You will need to combine excellent hospitality with sound judgement, operational awareness and the confidence to take ownership when situations arise.

At Mercure Newcastle George Washington Hotel, Golf & Spa, our Night Porters play an essential role in the success of the hotel.

While the majority of our guests are asleep, the hotel never stops operating. From welcoming late arrivals and supporting guests with unexpected requests to completing important financial processes, preparing the hotel for the next day and maintaining the security of the building and grounds, you will be trusted with significant responsibility.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working independently and wants a varied hotel role where no two shifts are the same. You will gain experience across Reception, guest services, Food & Beverage, meetings and events, hotel security and wider overnight operations.

As part of the Mercure and Accor family, you will also have access to learning and development opportunities and the chance to develop your hospitality career.

What we can offer:

• Competitive salary.
• Company pension scheme.
• Discounted Food & Beverage and hotel stays.
• Employee discount benefits.
• Complimentary meals whilst on duty.
• Complimentary uniform.
• Complimentary employee car parking.
• Access to our onsite gym and leisure facilities.
• Learning, training and professional development opportunities.
• Access to Accor employee benefits and discounted hotel rates worldwide.

The position is based at Mercure Newcastle George Washington Hotel, Golf & Spa, Washington, Tyne & Wear, and applicants must be able to reliably commute to the hotel for overnight shifts.

This is a full-time, permanent position. Flexibility is essential, as the role operates overnight and may include weekends and public holidays.

We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent. We believe that exceptional hospitality comes from exceptional people, and we want every member of our team to feel valued, supported and able to develop.

If you are an experienced hotel professional who enjoys independence, responsibility and delivering outstanding service when it matters most, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Environmental Health & Safety Consulting Manager
jobs.description:
Environmental Health & Safety Consulting Manager

Triumvirate Environmental is one of the largest integrated environmental, health, and safety (EHS) services firms in North America, serving life sciences, healthcare, higher education, and advanced manufacturing sectors. Our model combines on-site embedded specialists, project-based consulting, field services, and waste management into a single platform that delivers comprehensive support no pure-play competitor can replicate. With more than 500 embedded professionals working inside client facilities across the country, we maintain deep, enduring relationships with many of the most recognized names in pharmaceutical manufacturing, biotechnology, and medical devices. We are in a significant growth phase, scaling our consulting and professional services division substantially over the next several years.

What sets Triumvirate apart is that we do not just manage waste — we transform it. Our Plastics4Purpose program, built over more than a decade, converts tens of millions of pounds of regulated medical and laboratory plastics into commercial products every year. Combined with embedded specialists who drive daily waste reduction inside client facilities and a consulting team that designs the multi-year programs to make it durable, we deliver the kind of measurable, self-funding outcomes clients actively want in their plans.

The EHS Consulting Manager leads a portfolio of consulting and embedded services accounts, pairing deep technical EHS expertise with account leadership to deliver outstanding client outcomes, grow relationships, and develop a high-performing team. You will serve as the connection point between our on-site specialists and our consulting practice, ensuring that every client interaction strengthens the partnership.  You will support embedded consulting operations as well as EHS consulting projects.

What distinguishes this role from a traditional EHS consulting position is the integrated model behind you. Triumvirate's embedded specialists work inside client facilities every day, generating real-time insight into operational and compliance needs that no outside consultancy can match. Your ability to convert that insight into high-value programs — and to orchestrate the right mix of consulting, embedded, and waste services for each client — is what defines success in this role.

The ideal candidate brings both technical depth across multiple EHS disciplines and the commercial instinct to grow accounts, lead proposals, and manage engagement economics. What matters most is a proven record of solving complex EHS challenges, earning the trust of senior client leadership, and building long-term relationships that expand over time.

Essential Responsibilities

• Lead complex, multi-disciplinary EHS assessments and programs spanning occupational safety, industrial hygiene, environmental compliance, biosafety, radiation safety, and process safety.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders at the site EHS Director and VP levels, owning client satisfaction, retention, and account renewals.

• Support EHS consulting operations through technical billable delivery, project management, quality control, and oversite of delivery services.

• Grow a portfolio of consulting and embedded accounts by identifying expansion opportunities, leading proposals, and bringing the right mix of Triumvirate services to each client.

• Manage multi-workstream consulting and embedded engagements with disciplined scope, budget, and milestone control, consistently delivering high-quality work on time and on budget.

• Lead and develop a team of 6 to 10 EHS consultants, creating clear development plans, career pathways, and quality standards that raise the performance of the practice.

• Provide training, technical guidance, and quality review of the work performed by your team.

• Spot new opportunities from on-site observations and client conversations, and partner with sales and field teams to convert them into scoped engagements.

• Make pricing and scope decisions that optimize total client value across our integrated consulting, embedded, and waste services model.

• Interpret evolving regulatory requirements and translate them into practical, actionable programs that keep clients ahead of their compliance obligations.

Required Qualifications

• 6 to 10+ years of progressive EHS consulting or corporate EHS experience, including accountability for client or program outcomes.

• Bachelor's degree in occupational safety, industrial hygiene, environmental science, engineering, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.

• At least one relevant professional certification (CSP, CIH, CHMM, CBSP, or equivalent), held or actively being pursued.

• Demonstrated expertise across two or more EHS disciplines, with the ability to interpret complex regulations including RCRA, OSHA, air, water, and EHS management systems.

• Experience managing client accounts or portfolios with accountability for satisfaction, renewals, and growth.

• Experience leading and developing teams, including consultants and on-site personnel.

• A track record of leading proposals and managing engagement economics — scope, budget, and margin.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present to senior client leadership.

• Willingness to travel, with client-site presence of 40 to 60%.

• Must have a reliable form of transportation

• Must be willing to work flexible hours within the work week (Monday through Friday) with overtime as necessary

Preferred Requirements:

• EHS consulting experience in life sciences, healthcare, or advanced manufacturing such as battery, semiconductor, or aerospace. Or direct industry experience working in the aforementioned verticals.

• Multiple professional certifications.

• Experience managing accounts across an integrated or blended-services model.

• A history of business development or cross-sell success built on client relationships.

• Familiarity with EHS management and tracking platforms such as Intelex.
