jobs.title: Growth Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT MECHANISM

Mechanism is a venture studio. We build, run and grow a portfolio of companies across health, sleep, golf, pets, education and fintech, with about 80 people.

The product team is working toward something most companies only talk about, which is launching and running a company with a very small team and a lot of AI. Earlier this year we started a digital business from scratch that runs about 90% autonomously on AI agents. Agents handle most of the day-to-day work, and a person checks in, makes the calls that matter, and decides what to try next. Within months it reached a multi-million-dollar annual run rate.

Now we're bringing what we learned there to the rest of the portfolio. We also want to start more businesses like it.




THE ROLE

We're hiring a builder who understands growth and can ship real AI systems. You'll take the things our product team has proven in one business and deploy them across the rest of the portfolio. These are AI systems that touch almost every part of running a business, from acquisition and creative to conversion, retention and support.

You'll work with the founders and CEOs of our portfolio companies. You'll figure out what their business needs, build it, get their team using it, and measure whether it made money.

The long-term version of this job is running one or more mostly autonomous businesses of your own inside Mechanism.




WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Package the AI systems we've already built so they can be set up quickly at a new company, then deploy them. That can mean anything from connecting them to a company's tools and data to redesigning how a whole team works.

 - Sit with a portfolio CEO, learn how their business works, and find where an AI system would save time or make money.

 - Build working prototypes fast, put them in front of real customers, and iterate on what the numbers tell you.

 - Explain what you built and why in plain language to people who aren't technical, and get them to adopt it.

 - Run experiments across paid ads, funnels, lifecycle email and support, and know when a result is real and when it's noise.

 - Hand off anything that needs heavier backend work to our engineering team, and know when that's the right call.

 - Over time, take ownership of a business line and drive its growth with the tools you've built.




WHO YOU ARE

You’ve spent time in growth, or in product on a lean team, and you’ve run campaigns, outreach or experiments yourself. You’ve owned a number like revenue, CAC or LTV. Somewhere along the way you started building with AI, and you got good at it.

 - You've built AI systems that people actually use and that solved a business problem. You can draw how the pieces fit together and explain why you built it that way.

 - You can write and ship code with AI tools. You don't need a computer science degree, and we care more about how you think in systems than which language you know.

 - You have side projects you're obsessed with. You keep up with AI because you're curious, and you learn new tools quickly.

 - You'd rather build the thing than write a report about it. You try a lot of ideas, expect most to fail, and move on quickly when they do.

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity. Priorities here change often, and you're happy to say yes and own something new.

 - You communicate well with CEOs and operators and can make a complex idea simple.

 - You've worked at startups or small teams, ideally in DTC or consumer. 

 - If you’ve started your own company or have a side project you’re proud of, link it in your application.

This job probably isn't a fit if you want a lot of structure, a narrowly defined scope, or a large-company pace. Your title and resume matter less to us than what you've built.



Time Commitment

This role is full-time and will need to overlap with US ET for the majority of the workday. It is an exciting opportunity that demands a level of dedication beyond the standard 9 to 5. We need someone who's willing to go above and beyond to help us achieve our ambitious goals, and who's eager to put in the effort to make a real impact.

 

Location

US-Based - Fully remote.

 

Compensation

Our compensation packages are designed to make this your dream job for the short and long term. Each compensation package is tailored to suit your priorities and can include base, equity in the companies we help build, and performance bonus based on the success of our portfolio companies. Benefits include medical, dental, vision, and an unlimited time off policy with a two-week minimum.

jobs.title: Phlebotomist / Administrative Assistant (Marietta)
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

The Opportunity

As a One Medical Phlebotomist/Administrative Assistant, internally known as Lab Services Specialist/Member Support Specialist, you’ll provide an exceptional experience for our patients and help them accomplish an important part of their care journey by providing venipuncture as well as other clinical support services. You will be an ambassador for patients, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for our patients, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or providers.

You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You combine excellent specimen collection technique with tactful interpersonal skills during every interaction with your patients, at both the front desk and in the lab. jobs.title: Director of AI and Enterprise Architecture
jobs.description:
Director of AI and Enterprise Architecture

Remote – Western US (Pacific or Mountain time zone preferred)

Why Us

NewRocket is a ServiceNow Elite Partner and a Claude Select partner, helping enterprises reimagine how work gets done with ServiceNow and AI. We work with public and private sector organizations, including some of the world’s biggest brands, to simplify processes, remove complexity, and turn the promise of AI into measurable business outcomes. We are “Raising the Bar” in delivering technology’s promise to create new kinds of experiences for our customers.

Our Core Values: Excellence, Creativity, Integrity, Teamwork and Empathy #ExCITE. At NewRocket, these values guide everything we do: they are the foundation of our culture and define how we Go Beyond for our clients.

The Role

About the role

We're hiring a Director of AI and Enterprise Architecture to be the technical leader on our client engagements, working alongside our forward deployed engineers as they build and deploy agentic AI inside complex enterprise environments. This is a billable, client-facing consulting role.

Large enterprises don't run on one system. They run on decades of layered platforms: ERP backbones like SAP and Oracle, service and workflow platforms like ServiceNow, CRM, HR and finance suites, custom integrations, data warehouses, and the identity and security controls that hold it all together. Agentic AI only creates value when it can work safely inside that landscape: reading the right data, taking the right actions, respecting approvals and access controls, and leaving an audit trail that satisfies IT, security and compliance.

On each engagement, you're the person who understands that landscape. You map the client's systems, translate their business goals into the architecture and requirements agents need, and lead the forward deployed engineers through it as they build, so workflows make it out of pilot and into the client's production environment.

What you'll do

• Lead engagements technically. Serve as the senior technical leader on client engagements, setting architecture direction and guiding the forward deployed engineers who are building alongside you.

• Map the client's system landscape. Quickly get to grips with each client's environment, including ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Workday, custom systems and the integrations between them, and turn it into a clear picture the engineering team can build against.

• Translate business processes into agent-ready requirements. Work with client process owners to break down workflows like incident resolution, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash and employee onboarding into the tasks, data, decisions, permissions and human approval points an agent must handle.

• Design how agents connect to systems of record. Define the integration approach for each engagement: APIs, integration platforms, event streams, MCP and tool-calling layers, and data access patterns.

• Get workflows into production. Navigate the client's environments, change management, release processes, testing, monitoring and support handoff so agentic workflows move from pilot to production.

• Clear the path with security and governance. Design identity and access models for agents (service accounts, least privilege, delegated authority), audit logging and controls, and win sign-off from client CISOs, risk teams and auditors.

• Advise senior client stakeholders. Act as a trusted architecture advisor to client CIOs, CTOs, enterprise architects and platform owners, and identify where agentic workflows can expand into new use cases.

• Strengthen the practice. Turn what you learn on engagements into reusable blueprints, integration playbooks and readiness assessments, and share field insight with our product and engineering teams.

What you bring

• 7 to 10 years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture or technical leadership roles within large, complex enterprise software environments.

• Deep hands-on knowledge of at least two major enterprise platforms, such as ServiceNow, SAP (S/4HANA, BTP), Oracle (Fusion, E-Business Suite, OCI), Salesforce or Workday, including their data models, APIs, extension frameworks and upgrade constraints.

• Strong grounding in enterprise integration: REST and SOAP APIs, middleware and iPaaS (MuleSoft, Boomi, SAP Integration Suite or similar), event-driven architecture, and master data management.

• Practical experience with AI or automation in production, such as LLM-based applications, agentic workflows, RPA or intelligent automation, and a clear point of view on where agents fit and where they don't.

• Proven track record moving enterprise systems from design to production, including environment management, SDLC and change control, testing, monitoring and operational support.

• Solid understanding of enterprise security and governance: identity and access management, SSO and OAuth, role-based access, audit, and regulatory requirements such as SOX, GDPR or HIPAA.

• Client-facing consulting experience, such as at a Big Four firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG), Accenture or another global systems integrator or enterprise software vendor's professional services team, including working in a billable delivery model and advising executive stakeholders in plain business terms.

• Experience serving as technical lead for engineering teams on delivery engagements, guiding engineers who are building while staying hands-on enough to unblock them.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Location and travel

• You must live in the Western United States, in the Mountain or Pacific time zone.

• You must be willing to travel up to 75% to client sites.

Nice to have

• Enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, or platform certifications (ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect, SAP or Oracle architect certifications).

• Familiarity with agent frameworks and protocols, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool use and function calling, retrieval-augmented generation and agent evaluation methods.

• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks).

• Experience working alongside forward deployed engineering teams, or in a similar embedded delivery model.

• Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, public sector or manufacturing.

• Public thought leadership: talks, writing or published reference architectures on enterprise AI.

What success looks like

This is a billable, client-facing consulting role. You'll be embedded on customer engagements alongside our forward deployed engineers, serving as the architecture lead who helps the team navigate complex enterprise system landscapes.

• Engagement delivery: You consistently meet billable utilization targets and are the go-to architect on our most complex client engagements.

• Landscape mastery for the team: On each engagement, you quickly map the client's system landscape (ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle and the integrations between them) and give forward deployed engineers a clear path through it: where the data lives, which APIs and controls apply, and who owns what.

• Production outcomes: Agentic workflows you architect reach the client's production environment, with sign-off from their IT, security and risk teams.

• Client trust: Clients see you as a senior advisor, leading to engagement extensions, expanded scope and referenceable outcomes.

• Repeatable delivery: Patterns, integration playbooks and readiness assessments from your engagements are reused across the practice, making each new deployment faster.

We Take Care of Our People

NewRocket is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We value and celebrate diversity, believing that every employee matters and should be respected and heard.  We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer, committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin, or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, citizenship, military, or Veteran status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please contact hr.us@newrocket.com.

jobs.title: Junior Attorney / Paralegal, Sales Contracts
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Boostlingo is a leading language technology platform powering interpretation and translation services for healthcare, legal, government, and enterprise clients worldwide. Named an Inc. Magazine Best Workplace for four consecutive years, we are a high-growth, mission-driven company at the intersection of language access and AI innovation. Our team operates with urgency, operates with heart, and holds the bar high — for each other and for the people we serve.

WHAT IT MEANS TO BE A BOOSTIE

At Boostlingo, we operate through the lens of our four Core Values. These Core Values drive everything we do; from how we approach identifying talent we invite to join the team, to the energy and contributions we bring to our amazing culture, to the decisions we make at both the tactical and strategic level. To be a Boostie means to embody these Core Values every day:

• Positive Vibes: Bring positive energy and a solutions-oriented mindset to every interaction. High performance isn’t just about outputs — it’s about showing up with intentionality, resilience, and the belief that obstacles are problems worth solving.

• Drive Change: Stay curious, challenge assumptions, adapt quickly, and take action even when the path isn’t perfectly clear. Be proactive rather than reactive — and lean into AI as a force multiplier.

• Be Bold, Stay Humble: Growth lives in the tension between confidence and humility — be willing to stretch beyond what’s comfortable, own your development, and invest in the potential of the people around you. Every voice matters, and no one person is bigger than the team.

• Be Inclusive: Create and contribute to an environment where anyone can feel welcomed, supported, respected, and valued. Inclusive teams collaborate better — bring your full self, invest in others, and build the psychological safety that makes shared impact possible. Boostlingo is extremely honored to have been recognized as one of Inc. Magazine's Best Workplaces for the last three consecutive years (2022-2025). This esteemed recognition reflects the dedication that our incredible team has towards embodying our Core Values every day and we couldn’t be prouder of this team!

About the Role

We're looking for a detail-obsessed, solutions-oriented Junior Attorney or Paralegal to own the end-to-end sales contracting process, reporting to the VP of Legal & Compliance. This is a high-volume, high-visibility role at the intersection of Legal and Revenue/Go To Market functions — you'll be the person who keeps deals moving without sacrificing the terms that protect the company. You'll draft, redline, and negotiate a large volume of sales agreements against tight SLAs, working directly with Sales, Deal Desk, Rev Ops, and Finance to unblock contracts and get to “yes” on terms that work for everyone.

The ideal candidate combines a lawyer's precision with a dealmaker's pragmatism: someone who reads every clause twice, catches the inconsistency everyone else missed, and then finds the creative middle ground that gets a stuck contract signed.

What You'll Own

Contract Lifecycle Management

• Own full-cycle drafting, review, and negotiation of sales contracts — MSAs, SOWs, Order Forms, DPAs, BAAs, NDAs, and amendments — from initial draft through execution.

• Manage a high-volume contract pipeline against defined SLAs, prioritizing and triaging based on deal urgency, size, and complexity.

• Redline incoming customer paper against Boostlingo's playbook and fallback positions, flagging material deviations for escalation.

Negotiation & Problem-Solving

• Serve as the primary point of contact for Sales and customers on contract terms, driving negotiations to close.

• Identify contractual blockers early and proactively propose alternative language or structures that satisfy both risk tolerance and commercial goals.

• Know when to hold a position, when to compromise, and when to escalate — exercising sound judgment on what's truly non-negotiable versus what's flexible.

Process & Cross-Functional Coordination

• Maintain and continuously improve the contract playbook, templates, and fallback clause library.

• Track contract status, turnaround times, and bottlenecks; report on volume and SLA performance to the VP of Legal & Compliance.

• Partner with Deal Desk and Finance on pricing, billing terms, and revenue recognition implications of contract language.

• Coordinate with Security and Compliance on data protection, BAA, and SOC 2 Type II-related terms for regulated customers, including healthcare and language access accounts.

• Support contract lifecycle management (CLM) tooling and workflow improvements to increase throughput as deal volume scales with Boostlingo's AI-first growth.

Risk & Compliance

• Ensure contracts comply with company policy, applicable law, and industry-specific requirements, including HIPAA/BAA obligations for healthcare and language access customers.

• Maintain organized, audit-ready contract records and metadata in support of Boostlingo's broader compliance program.

What You'll Bring

Minimum Qualifications

• J.D. or paralegal certification/degree, with 1–4 years of relevant contract drafting and negotiation experience (in-house, law firm commercial practice, or paralegal role supporting a commercial legal team).

• Demonstrated experience managing a high volume of commercial contracts in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

• Extraordinary attention to detail — you catch what others miss, every time.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to explain legal terms in plain language to non-legal stakeholders.

• A pragmatic, creative problem-solver who can find acceptable middle ground rather than getting stuck on positions.

• Comfort operating with ambiguity and competing priorities, and confidence making judgment calls within delegated authority.

• Proficiency with contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools and redlining in Word/Google Docs (track changes fluency is a must).

Preferred

• SaaS or technology industry experience, particularly subscription/usage-based commercial models.

• Familiarity with data privacy and security terms (DPAs, BAAs, SOC 2-related provisions).

• Experience supporting a Sales or Deal Desk function directly, with an understanding of sales cycle pressure and SLA-driven workflows.

• Prior experience building or refining contract templates and playbooks.

What Success Looks Like

• Contracts consistently turned around within SLA, with a shrinking backlog as volume grows.

• Sales and Deal Desk trust you as a partner who removes friction, not a bottleneck.

• A well-maintained playbook and fallback library that reduces escalations over time.

• Legal risk is properly managed without becoming a blocker to revenue.

Why Boostlingo

• Join a four-time Inc. Magazine Best Workplace at a pivotal moment in the company's AI-first transformation.

• High-impact, high-visibility role with direct exposure to Legal, Sales, and Executive Leadership.

• Backed by Mainsail Partners, with a fast-growing customer base across healthcare, government, and enterprise language access.

WHAT MAKES BOOSTLINGO A GREAT COMPANY?

• A values and mission-based ethos that drives our Finance strategy

• Fun, energetic environment with an incredible culture (just ask about our eNPS scores!)

• Hybrid/Remote working arrangements

• Competitive compensation and robust benefits offerings, including 401(k) plan with match!

• Flexible PTO

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity here at Boostlingo. Boostlingo does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

What the Role Is

At Babylist, we help expecting parents make confident decisions with less stress and more joy. Our platform and products make the parenthood journey easier, from preparing for a new baby to navigating the early years.

We’re growing fast, and we need a high-volume Senior Fulfillment Recruiter to help build our Supply Chain, Logistics, and Fulfillment Operations teams with top talent. In this role, you’ll be the go-to hiring partner for warehouse managers, ensuring a seamless, high-touch candidate experience while keeping the hiring process efficient and effective. You’ll be on site daily, working directly with warehouse leadership.

This role specifically is held on-site at our Commercial Point, Ohio Fulfillment Center. The hours for this role are Monday through Friday, 8:30am - 5:00pm

About Pay

We pay competitive market rates.

Starting salary for this position is $136,450 to $163,759 annually

Holidays Observed

The Fulfillment Center is closed on the following days  in 2026:

• Thanksgiving Day

• Christmas Day

• New Year's Day (2027)

All shifts receive 4 floating holidays in addition to the holidays observed, so you can celebrate what matters to you the most, whenever that may be.

Who You Are

• Recruit & Advise: You have 7+ years of full-cycle, high-volume recruiting experience, bringing top talent into fulfillment, logistics, and supply chain teams.

• Source & Connect: You excel at finding, engaging, and building relationships with high-volume candidates, from warehouse associates to team leads and operations professionals.

• Know the Columbus labor market: including what nearby fulfillment and manufacturing employers offer

• Build & Influence: You establish trust and credibility with hiring managers, guiding them to make smart, strategic talent decisions.

• Delight & Impress: You are passionate about creating an unforgettable candidate experience, ensuring every applicant walks away excited about Babylist.

• Adapt & Thrive: You navigate fast-paced, high-growth environments with ease, balancing multiple priorities without missing a beat.

• Strategize & Innovate: You bring fresh ideas and creative sourcing strategies to find the best talent in a competitive market. You are comfortable running job fairs, group interviews, hiring days, and pre-hire site tours

• Learn & Elevate: You are curious and constantly improving, refining processes to make recruiting smoother and more impactful.

How You Will Make An Impact

• Lead & Execute: Manage full life cycle recruitment for high-volume and specialized fulfillment roles, including Fulfillment Team Members, Supervisors, and Operations Specialists.

• Collaborate & Align: Partner closely with hiring managers to ensure recruitment efforts support team goals and reflect Babylist’s values. Build and maintain relationships with agency support.

• Source & Build: Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of warehouse talent through sourcing, networking, and proactive outreach. Create effective and efficient ways to engage with

• Engage & Elevate: Deliver a seamless and positive experience for both candidates and hiring teams, championing Babylist’s values at every stage.

• Innovate & Attract: Implement creative strategies to engage and secure top talent in competitive warehouse markets.

• Problem-Solve & Adapt: Navigate challenges like high-volume hiring periods and shifting priorities with empathy and strategic problem-solving.

• Plan & Grow: Support fulfillment center hiring initiatives that drive Babylist’s long-term growth and operational success.

Why This Role

• Own and shape a hiring program instead of inheriting one

• Work directly with a stable fulfillment center leadership team

• Your work shows up in retention, not only time-to-fill

• A real on-site seat in a growing Columbus market

Who We Are

At Babylist, the work our fulfillment and fulfillment administration teams do reaches millions of families across the country — whether you're on the floor moving product, supporting the pepole or leading the operation that makes it happen. We're one of the leading platforms for expecting and new families — a $750M business with 10 million customers and eight consecutive years of profitability. Our fulfillment centers are where the mission becomes real, and the people who run them are a core part of how we deliver on it every single day.

Our Ways of Working

Our fulfillment teams work on-site in a fast-paced, team-driven environment where every role — from the floor to leadership — plays a direct part in delivering the Babylist experience to millions of families.

Why You Will Love Working At Babylist

Our Culture

• Work hard, then recharge — we respect your time on and off the clock

• Strong management team that supports you

• AI is part of how we work, not a side experiment. You'll have leading tools like Claude and ChatGPT from day one, with no waiting on access, so the busywork gets handled and your judgment goes where it counts

Growth & Development

• Competitive pay and meaningful opportunities for career advancement

• We believe technology and data can solve hard problems

• We're committed to career progression and performance-based advancement

Benefits

• Competitive pay on a weekly basis

• Bonus opportunities

• Company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) with company match and flexible spending accounts

• Paid parental leave and PTO

Important Notices

Recorded Interviews. Babylist uses an interview recording tool to record and transcribe interviews for evaluation purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. By participating in an interview, you consent to this recording and transcription.

Interview Integrity. AI is part of how we work at Babylist. We expect you to use it too. Your application and interviews should still reflect you and your own thinking. We'll tell you when AI is encouraged. Misrepresentation at any stage may result in removal from consideration for this and future roles.

How We Review Applications We use AI throughout our hiring process to help review, screen, and assess applications. These tools support our team's review; they do not replace it, and every hiring decision is made by a person.

Connections at Babylist. If you have a family member or close personal relationship with a current Babylist employee, please let your recruiter know. This helps us keep our process fair and transparent for everyone.

Protect Yourself from Scams. All official outreach comes from the Babylist Talent Team via @babylist.com email addresses only. We will never ask for payment or personal financial information. If you receive outreach via WhatsApp, Telegram, or a non-Babylist email, it's not us. Verify open roles at babylist.com/careers.

jobs.title: Staff Hardware Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
About Gather AI

Are you ready to build the future of supply chain? At Gather AI, we're not just creating software; we're pioneering a new era of warehouse intelligence. We've developed a groundbreaking, vision-powered platform that uses autonomous drones and existing equipment to capture real-time data, completely digitizing workflows that have historically been manual and error-prone. This means facilities operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently, ultimately redefining "on-time, in full" delivery.

If you're looking for an opportunity to contribute to truly transformative technology and make a significant impact in a vital industry, Gather AI is the place for you. We're leading the charge in the rapidly evolving robotics industry, and we invite you to join us in reshaping the global supply chain, one intelligent warehouse at a time.

About the role

We're hiring a Staff Hardware Systems Engineer to own requirements, integration and verification and validation (V&V) for our warehouse robotics hardware: autonomous inventory drones, forklift-mounted vision systems, and the charging and battery systems that support them. You'll make sure every Gather hardware product is built from testable requirements, de-risked one technology block at a time, integrated cleanly with firmware, software and autonomy, and released on objective evidence that holds up in real warehouses.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role on a small, senior hardware team in Pittsburgh. You'll set up the framework and do the work yourself: scout and test new technologies, write the requirements, build the test rigs, run the tests and analyze the data.

What you'll do

• Own the requirements and V&V framework for our hardware products, from system requirements down to subsystem, technology-block and interface requirements, with traceability to verification evidence.

• Scout, characterize and compare candidate technologies (cameras, illumination, propulsion, wireless charging, batteries and more), and recommend which to take into the next product.

• Own integration of electrical, firmware, software and autonomy into the hardware product design, including bring-up, integration testing and root cause of interface failures.

• Write and run V&V plans: test methods, rigs, fixtures and instrumentation; statistically based sampling plans; design of experiments; clear conclusions with stated uncertainty.

• Own environmental and compliance testing (shock and vibration, thermal and condensation, ingress, EMC/FCC), working with external test labs.

• Own technical budgets (power, thermal, mass, EMC/RF), lead system-level hazard analysis, and feed DFMEA.

• Deliver decision-ready evidence for design reviews, design freeze and release, and assess the verification impact of engineering changes.

• Close the loop from field failures back to requirements and tests, and shape production test strategy with our contract manufacturer.

What success looks like

• 30 days: Own verification for our next-generation forklift vision system and break its system requirements down to hardware level.

• 60 days: Define requirements and the V&V plan for a new charging system, and get the requirements cascade and verification matrix in use on a live product line.

• 90 days: Requirements cascade and verification matrix in use across active product lines; test plans for current technology blocks; a reusable library of environmental test profiles.

• 1 year: V&V evidence built into every hardware stage gate, next-generation products released against that standard, and a production test coverage proposal handed to manufacturing.

What you bring

• You've owned requirements through V&V on an electromechanical product taken from concept to production: decomposing product requirements to subsystem level with traceability, and writing and running V&V plans with objective, measurable acceptance criteria.

• You've integrated hardware with firmware and software in a robotic, embedded, autonomous or complex electromechanical system, including bring-up and root-causing interface failures.

• You use statistics to make engineering decisions: design of experiments, data analysis and statistically based sampling plans (confidence/reliability, AQL or similar).

• You build the test, not just the plan: test methods, rigs, fixtures and data acquisition, including measurement system analysis (e.g., Gauge R&R).

• BS in an engineering field with 10+ years of relevant experience, or an MS (preferred) with 8+ years.

Nice to have

• Environmental and compliance qualification with external labs: shock and vibration, thermal cycling and condensation, IP ingress, EMC/FCC.

• Vision and power technology: camera characterization and illumination, lithium batteries and charging systems, and trade studies to choose between them.

• Regulated product development (medical, aerospace, automotive), with the judgment to scale that rigor to a startup.

• Experience with drones/UAVs, material handling equipment or robotics.

Location

Pittsburgh, PA. On-site 4–5 days a week (this is a lab-heavy, hands-on role), with about 10% travel to test labs, our contract manufacturer and customer warehouses.

jobs.title: Analyst, Operations Excellence
jobs.description:
Sometimes referred to as Home Chef’s operations “SWAT” team, the Ops Ex team works on cross-functional initiatives that help to define the future state of the operations organization. The team prides themselves on being great problem solvers and thought partners.  The Ops Ex team is a key partner to the fulfillment team, creating and maintaining technologically-driven tools to enable more efficient processes, and serving as the operations organization’s center for strategy development.

The Operations Excellence Analyst helps lead the strategy function, and the ‘digital SWAT’ function, which runs KPI reporting, demand forecasting, procurement excellence and data analytics. The Analyst Is responsible for supporting the priorities and expectations of the team, delivering strategic recommendations, and acting as a key subject matter expert and partner to fulfillment teams.

Detailed Responsibilities

Strategic Project Work

• Own high priority project work as necessary. Includes analysis, project management, and strategic recommendations

• Support 3rd party vendors with tools and guidance to coordinate delivery between sites and customers

• Continuously optimize production plans and planning tools to support plant function

Data Analysis & Reporting

• Develop models and methodologies to monitor success of multiple facets of the business (facility capacity, machinery usage, labor, production, etc.)

• Find innovative ways to make data actionable for our production teams - build processes to better collect, store, and visualize operational data in a meaningful and impactful way

• Enable data-driven decision making by reporting on core KPIs and performing ad-hoc analyses

Setting strategic priorities

• Oversee fulfillment KPIs & reporting; use data to identify highest-impact project work

• Help team to structure project work and deliver clear, data-driven recommendations

• Drive project work from strategy to project recommendation and partner with CI team for implementation with the fulfillment teams.

Collaboration with operations technology team

• Develop V1.0 of tools and reporting to support efficiency and quality improvements at the plants

• Act as conduit between plants and IT for targeted quick support and results

• Partner with operations technology team as business lead in the development of technology-driven applications to implement in the plants

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a Senior Project Manager to join our Goods Movement Market Sector. This role will partner closely with Freight and DOT Client Account Managers (CAMs) across the United States to strengthen, expand, and deliver AECOM’s rail planning offerings. The successful candidate will play a key role in driving strategic growth, enhancing technical excellence, and supporting safe, efficient rail planning and operations for our clients. This is a hybrid position, offering a combination of office-based and remote work flexibility.

Typical duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Collaborate with Freight and DOT CAMs nationwide to identify, position, and deliver rail planning services aligned with client needs and strategic priorities
• Lead and support rail planning pursuits, including proposal development, scope definition, and client engagement to win new work
• Provide technical oversight and contribute to the successful delivery of rail planning projects, ensuring quality, consistency, and adherence to client and regulatory requirements
• Develop and maintain strong client relationships with railroads, state DOTs, and other key stakeholders to expand AECOM’s presence in the rail planning market
• Identify emerging trends, risks, and opportunities in rail planning and translate them into actionable service offerings and growth strategies
• Mentor, train, and develop staff across the rail planning and broader Goods Movement team, fostering technical expertise and professional growth
• Support the development and implementation of best practices, standards, and innovative solutions related to rail planning
• Participate in and represent AECOM at industry organizations, conferences, and technical committees to enhance visibility and thought leadership
• Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, including design, construction, environmental, and program management, to deliver integrated solutions
• Contribute to internal initiatives focused on operational excellence, safety culture, and continuous improvement

Minimum Requirements:

• BS Degree + 10 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education, including 2 years of leadership
• Experience in freight rail planning
• As a condition of employment, candidate must pass client required background check(s)

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with state rail plans and consolidation studies
• Experience with developing and maintaining strong client relationships with railroads, state DOTs, and other key stakeholders
• Experience with quiet zone projects

Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.

Relocation support is not available for this position.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Lead
jobs.description:
About Inspira Education

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

The Role

We’re expanding our revenue operations team and looking for a Sales Operations Lead to help scale and strengthen the systems and processes we’ve already begun building. This is a highly impactful role where you’ll partner closely with our existing revenue operations leadership and collaborate with marketing, sales, and student success teams to drive efficiency as we continue to grow globally.

In this role, you’ll support and enhance our revenue operations by improving workflows, refining processes, and ensuring our systems evolve alongside the business. You’ll work hands-on in HubSpot, helping enable DTC sales motions, reporting, and day-to-day execution across teams. If you enjoy translating business needs into scalable CRM solutions and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, this role will be a great fit.

You’ll play a key role in scaling Inspira’s revenue funnel by supporting process improvements, enabling teams with the right tools and data, and contributing to actionable business insights. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and brings a strong bias toward action, problem-solving, and continuous improvement.

This role requires 5 days a week in person at our NYC-based office.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate with sales, marketing, and operations teams to enhance operational excellence and rigor in the business

• Define, develop, and implement sales, marketing, and student success support systems and scalable processes

• Work closely with key stakeholders/cross-functional teams to understand operational needs and improve existing workflows

• Educate the sales, marketing, and student success teams about process changes and system updates, keeping them informed about change management

• Assist the team in finding simple and scalable process solutions for day-to-day challenges

• Ensure data accuracy in HubSpot CRM

• Lead all attribution infrastructure - UTM tracking, Google Analytics, Ad platforms

• Integrate all of our platforms, e.g., GTM, GA4, and HubSpot

• Integrate our third-party tools with GTM, GA4, and HubSpot (e.g., webinar tools, outgrow, etc.)

• Write and maintain documentation for operation processes

• Prepare ad hoc analyses and participate in special projects as needed

• Create and maintain reports and dashboards that facilitate quick decision-making at scale

• Drive process improvement, adoption, and effectiveness at all levels of the sales process

Qualifications

• 2+ years of experience in Business, Sales, Success Operations, or a similar role

• Proven experience collaborating with sales, marketing, and operations teams to drive strategic initiatives

• Bachelor’s degree required, Masters degree preferred

• Experience in a startup environment and a demonstrated ability to work within a scaling team, ideally having been part of a team with less than 50 employees

• Strong knowledge and understanding of sales and customer success disciplines

• Solid functional understanding of HubSpot CRM, with robust experience in creating and maintaining reports and dashboards

• Excellent analytical thinking skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems into clear, manageable components and identify optimal solutions

• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, along with strong organizational abilities; experience in project or program management is a plus

• Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to escalate issues and roadblocks as necessary

• Commitment to drive actionable outcomes and results

• Ability to balance a sharp focus on measurable outcomes with genuine empathy for people, customers, and the business. Flexible team player with a proactive approach

• High energy, humility, and the capacity to work effectively with diverse personalities

• This is a hands-on position; the ideal candidate must be willing to "roll up their sleeves”

What we look for

• A passion for cultivating authentic connections

• Individuals who embody a winning attitude

• A mindset fueled by curiosity

• Determination to hustle and overcome challenges

• An infectious enthusiasm and adaptability

jobs.title: Assistant Health and Wellness Director (RN)
jobs.description:
Brandywine Living, a premier provider of quality senior living, is seeking an Assistant Health and Wellness Director / Assistant Dir. of Nursing (RN) to join our team.

Salary Range: $90,000 - $95,000 Yearly

Reports To:

The Assistant Health & Wellness Director will report to the Health and Wellness Director.

FLSA Classification:

This position is classified as exempt and is a salary position

Job Overview:

Under the direction of the Health and Wellness Director, the principal purpose of this position is to act in the absence of the Health and Wellness Director. As the Assistant Health and Wellness Director / ADON, you will be responsible in collaboration with the Health and Wellness Director for planning, organizing, and directing the overall clinical operations of the nursing department to provide comprehensive care for residents in accordance with current federal, state, and local standards, guidelines, and regulations.

Responsibilities:

• Develops and maintains a working knowledge of all policies and procedures pertaining to the position, the department, and the personnel.
• Develops and implements active wellness program for residents, working with Activity Director.
• Maintains resident files in an orderly manner and documents all pertinent information regarding residents.
• Prepares resident charges and reports to the Director for approval and billing.
• Assesses resident within 30 days prior to move-in and throughout residency or as the resident's condition changes.
• Develops the initial Individual Service Plan (ISP) to meet the needs of the resident within 72 hours of move-in and the comprehensive ISP within 30 days of move-in and/or as the resident's condition changes.
• Oversees resident care provided by the nursing department
• Investigate all resident and family complaints or concerns regarding the nursing department and report findings to the Director. Acts to ensure problems are resolved.
• Hires, trains, schedules, and evaluates all nursing staff.
• Assist with on call coverage
• Other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

• Graduate of an accredited school of nursing with a current, valid Registered Nurse (RN) license or Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN).

• One year experience in a supervisory role in Senior Living, Assisted Living, LongTerm Care or Skilled Care.

• Proficiency in computer skills, Microsoft Office (Windows, Outlook, Excel) with the ability to learn new applications. • Able to work weekends & holidays.

Physical Abilities:

• While performing the duties of this job, the associate is often required to stand, walk, sit, use fine and gross motor skills, reach with hands and arms, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, talk, hear, and smell. • An individual in this position will be required to lift or carry weight in up to 50 lbs. Intermittent physical activity includes lifting and supporting residents. The associate must use proper body mechanics.

jobs.title: Staff Pharmacist, Entry Level Closed-Door | Onsite, Chesterfield
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody.  Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients.

BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

Location: 12639 West Explorer Dr Suite 100 Boise, ID 83713

Hours:  Fulltime, 40 hrs/week. Available shifts: (1)  Monday- Friday 7am-7pm rotating shifts and rotating weekends am-3p:30pm

Responsibilities:

• Responsible for the supervision of pharmacy technicians in support of the pharmacy manager involved in the pharmacy workflow

• Oversee data entry by pharmacy staff from providers and receiving pharmacies and insure the quality of the pharmacy technicians work

• Ensure confidentiality of patient information and their records, and destruction of relevant documentation which contains patient information

• Assist the pharmacy manager in overseeing staff in fielding calls from major pharmacy chains and independent pharmacies across the country

• Assist the pharmacy manager staff in receiving, processing and transferring patients’ prescriptions, and own the success of the transfer end-to-end

• Perform pharmacist verification of filled prescriptions in a high-volume closed-door fulfillment environment, ensuring accuracy of drug, dose, quantity and labeling prior to dispensing

• Review and clinically verify new and refill prescriptions for therapeutic appropriateness, drug interactions, contraindications, and dosing accuracy

jobs.title: Product Manager - Spark
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Manager, Spark Projects to join our Product Team and lead a new Supabase project type built for how agents use infrastructure.

Agents are creating an unprecedented amount of software, and every app, prototype, preview, and experiment needs a backend from the moment it’s created. Spark projects provision in a second, scale down when idle, and are cheap to enough to use liberally, guilt-free. while keeping the Supabase interface agents already know. Some of these projects will be small and short-lived while others will grow and graduate to larger instances on Supabase. This role owns establishing Spark as the default starting point for agent-built software and how projects grow from an early experiments into production workloads on Supabase.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Own the product strategy and roadmap for Spark projects, from early MVP through general availability.

 - Make Spark effortless for agents and the platforms they run on, so a backend exists the moment an idea does.

 - Define the path from experiment to production, including how projects get claimed, upgraded, and grown into the full Supabase platform.

 - Shape packaging and pricing with Engineering, Growth, and Finance so Spark is economical at very large scale.

 - Partner closely with Supabase for Platforms customers to understand their needs and bring Spark to them first.

 - Define what success looks like, instrument it end to end, and let the data guide what gets built next.



YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have 5+ years of product management on developer tools or infrastructure, or are an ex-founder with strong product instincts.

 - Have a strong point of view on agent-driven development and how it changes what developers and platforms need from a backend.

 - Know your way around AI Evals, controlled experimentation, and data analysis.

 - Are biased toward speed and would rather ship, learn, and iterate than perfect a spec.

 - Build with what you own and form opinions through first-hand use.

 - Use AI tools to compress research, drafting, and feedback synthesis so you can focus on judgment calls.

 - Work async by default, making decisions in writing in a fully remote team.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: Kitchen Manager, DashMart - [Charlotte, NC]
jobs.description:
About the Team

We're looking for someone to help scale DoorDash's next billion dollar business, DashMart, by growing our in-house food program, DashMart Kitchens. The DashMart Kitchens team is focused on building a new type of restaurant platform within DashMart, offering a broad selection of prepared foods and well-known restaurant staples to our customers' doorsteps.

About the Role

As the Kitchen Manager for DashMart Kitchens (DMK), you’ll lead the daily operations of a DoorDash-owned kitchen located within a DashMart fulfillment center. You’ll oversee a team of operations associates and shift leads to ensure every meal is prepared safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards.

You’ll combine hands-on culinary leadership with operational excellence — managing staffing, scheduling, and kitchen performance while ensuring food safety, order accuracy, and team success. You’ll work closely with your Site Manager to lead multiple food concepts, improve processes, and create a great place to work. This role requires strict adherence to food safety, inventory controls, and safety protocols due to routine access to food, supplies, equipment, and operational systems.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you...

• Thrive on iteration and have experience leading teams through changes

• Are excited about coaching, managing, and leading teams in fast-paced environments

• Enjoy building systems and processes and seeing ideas come to life

• Are eager to learn how different parts of a complex operation connect

• Are obsessed with preparing consistent, high-quality food for customers

• Want to grow in delivery-only kitchen operations

You’ll Make an Impact By...

• Leading: You’ll demonstrate compassion and commitment to inclusivity as you lead a team of hourly Kitchen Operations Associates and Shift Leads. You’ll hire, coach and develop high-performing team members, while building a safety-first culture where employees are excited to drive success, personally and for the team. Because this position supervises staff and is responsible for maintaining a safe, inclusive, and respectful workplace, strong adherence to professional conduct, clear communication, and employee safety standards is required. You’ll serve as a leading change agent for your DMK, helping your team to navigate new food concepts and growth projects. You’ll tackle onsite escalations, including coordination with cross-functional partners.

• Operating and Building Systems: With your thumb on the pulse of all outcomes for your team, you will be directly responsible for driving results for your kitchen. To achieve your performance targets, you’ll drive success by building, implementing, and improving systems for effective scheduling, ensuring par levels are met, executing recipes accurately, and deploying best practices.Because this role oversees high-risk kitchen equipment and fast-paced food production, maintaining sound judgment and unimpaired performance is essential to ensure a safe work environment. You’ll engage cross-functional partners within DoorDash as needed for support.

• Strategizing: You will analyze performance metrics, identify root causes of issues like prep gaps or order quality, and implement solutions that drive efficiency and adoption. You will refine processes, and partner with your Site Manager and cross-functional teams to execute new initiatives and continuously improve how the kitchen operates.

• Delighting: You care deeply about delivering great food and a great customer experience. You will coach your team to maintain recipe accuracy, food safety, and storefront availability, knowing that consistency is key in a multi-concept kitchen. You will collaborate with central teams so your site has the tools, training, and support needed to achieve excellent quality outcomes.

We’re excited about you because…

• You have 3+ years of experience in a medium/high-volume fast-casual or full-service restaurant environment.

• You have 2+ years of experience leading teams, including hiring, scheduling, coaching, and performance management.

• You hold (or are willing to get) a ServeSafe Manager certification and set high standards for food safety and cleanliness.

• You’re a hands-on leader who motivates teams of 5+ employees to perform and grow.

• You take ownership and thrive in fast-changing, startup-style environments where no task is too big or small.

• You’re a creative problem solver who challenges “how it’s always been done” and finds better ways forward.

• You’re analytical, data-driven, and comfortable using Excel or Google Sheets to make decisions.

• As the leader of the site, you will need to ensure your team and the site is fully supported, which will include regularly scheduled late-night and weekend hours.

• You’re comfortable flexing between kitchen and fulfillment operations, and you understand how culinary execution and order flow connect to overall site metrics like accuracy, quality, and efficiency.

• You have (or can quickly learn) a working knowledge of inventory management systems (IMS), product flow, and fulfillment best practices within a multi-operation site.

Why You’ll Love Working at DoorDash

• We are leaders - Leadership is not limited to our management team. It’s something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.

• We are doers - We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions that will lead our company and our industry is what we do -- on every project, every day.

• We are learners - We’re not afraid to dig in and uncover the truth, even if it’s scary or inconvenient. Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we’ve been in a role for one year or one minute.

• We are customer-obsessed - Our mission is to grow and empower local economies. We are committed to our customers, merchants, and dashers and believe in connecting people with possibility.

• We are all DoorDash - The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights.

• We offer great compensation packages and comprehensive health benefits.

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. jobs.title: Product Manager -  Administration & Governance
jobs.description:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Manager, Administration & Governance to join our Product Team and make Supabase the default starting point for software built inside a company.

Supabase already spreads from the bottom up: someone has an idea, creates a project, and builds something useful. Inside most companies, Supabase starts the same way: someone has an idea, creates a project, and builds something useful. The next step is making that momentum company-wide: one platform where anyone can start building, and where IT can see what’s running, who owns it, and what it costs.

You’ll own how companies run Supabase as their internal development platform: approved by IT and easy for anyone in the company to use. You’ll make it possible for people and the agents they work with to start building without waiting on infrastructure, while giving platform, IT, and security teams the controls they need to say yes. The goal is to make the approved path the easiest path, from an early experiment to a production application, with the controls companies need built in.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Own the product strategy and roadmap for internal innovation, from a company’s first IT-approved rollout to adoption across teams and business units.

 - Make getting started self-service, whether someone creates a project in Supabase, through an internal developer portal, or with an agent. Give builders the access and infrastructure they need without a ticket for every project.

 - Steer scattered usage into a manageable company-wide platform. Give companies one view of everything they run on Supabase. Shape how ownership, delegated access, and boundaries work so teams can move independently as usage grows.

 - Partner closely with platform, IT, security, and finance teams to understand what it takes to approve Supabase and keep it approved. Translate their needs into practical identity, policy, audit, and spend controls that don’t slow builders down.

 - Define the path from experiment to production, including project ownership, access, and the guardrails that change as an application becomes important to the business.

 - Work with Engineering, Design, Sales, and Customer Success to turn early customer rollouts into a repeatable experience, rather than a new custom integration for every company.

 - Define what success looks like, instrument it end to end, and let the data guide what gets built next—from time to first project and self-service adoption to production usage and expansion across the company.
   


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have 7+ years of product management on developer tools, infrastructure, or internal developer platforms.

 - Have built self-service products that developers love and platform or IT teams trust. You understand both the person trying to ship an app and the team responsible for how it runs.

 - Can reason about identity, permissions, organization boundaries, and usage attribution, and turn those systems into workflows people can actually understand.

 - Have a strong point of view on how agents change who can build software inside a company and what an internal development platform needs to make that possible.

 - Know your way around controlled experimentation and data analysis, and can connect easier adoption to sustained product use.

 - Are biased toward speed and would rather ship, learn, and iterate than perfect a spec.

 - Build with what you own and form opinions through first-hand use, from creating a project to configuring the policies around it.

 - Use AI tools to compress research, drafting, and feedback synthesis so you can focus on judgment calls.

 - Work async by default, making decisions in writing in a fully remote team.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Software Engineer, AI Tooling Infrastructure to join our AI Tooling team and help build and run the backend services behind Supabase’s AI products. The Supabase MCP server is one example of what the team runs in production, alongside the services that support agent skills and the dashboard assistant. You’ll work closely with the Platform, SRE, Auth, Billing and Edge Functions teams, and with the engineers on the AI Tooling team who build the product surfaces.

The AI Tooling team runs its own services in production and carries its own on-call. Traffic from AI clients and agents behaves differently from traffic from people: hundreds of calls a minute, retry loops, and no reading of deprecation warnings. This role makes sure the services they use are reliable, correctly authorized and observable. It is a systems and infrastructure role rather than a product AI role, and it is not an SRE role. You will build and operate these systems, not only advise on them.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments, owns what they ship in production, and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.




WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

In this role, you’ll:

 - Build and operate the production backend services behind Supabase’s AI products, including the MCP server: deployment, scaling, configuration and release.

 - Take ownership of how those services are structured, including splitting or reshaping a service when that makes it safer to run and easier to change.

 - Define, measure and meet reliability targets for the services the team runs. Set SLOs with the SRE team, track error budgets, and use them to decide what to fix first.

 - Participate in the AI Tooling team on-call rotation, and be a first responder for incidents in those services. Investigate, fix, coordinate with other teams during incidents, and write the follow-ups and runbooks.

 - Work the AI Tooling team support queue alongside on-call, and turn recurring issues into fixes rather than repeated manual answers.

 - Own authentication and authorization for AI and agent clients: OAuth apps, scoped tokens, and permissions that make sense for agents as well as humans, including how we change or deprecate a permission without breaking existing integrations.

 - Own observability for the services the team runs: metrics, traces, logs, dashboards and alerts, so we find problems before customers do.

 - Handle capacity and abuse for agent traffic: rate limits, cost and safety controls, and behavior under load or when a dependency degrades.

 - Improve the architecture of the services the team owns as they grow, including splitting or reshaping a service when that makes it safer to run and easier to change.

 - Work with the Platform team on shared code, review ownership and release process, and with the SRE team on infrastructure, alerting and incident practice.

 - Contribute to the code of the AI Tooling team’s tools, such as the MCP server, where it affects reliability and security, in partnership with the engineers who own the product surface.



YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

Must have:

 - Have 5+ years of experience building and running backend services in production, and have carried on-call for them.

 - Write strong TypeScript or Go, and are comfortable working in the other.

 - Have designed and operated APIs with real consumers: versioning, error handling, rate limiting, and backwards-compatible change.

 - Know OAuth, OIDC, JWT and API authorization well enough to debug them in production and to explain where implementations commonly deviate from the spec.

 - Have a good understanding of PostgreSQL and relational databases.

 - Are comfortable with CI/CD, Docker and containerized deployments, and with infrastructure as code. Any tool is fine.

 - Can debug across services: follow a slow or failing request through several systems using metrics, traces and logs.

 - Communicate clearly in writing, work with a wide range of stakeholders, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams.

 - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly.

Pick your centre of gravity. We expect you to be deep in at least one of these, and to tell us which:

 - APIs and auth: You have designed permission models, token scopes or OAuth flows for third-party or machine clients, and you have migrated them without breaking users.

 - Operations: You have run production services yourself: carried the pager, written alerts and runbooks, used SLOs or similar to decide what to fix, and made shared systems less risky over time.

 - Gateways and distributed systems: You have built or run proxies or gateways, or debugged hard failures across services (retries, partial failures, upstream outages, fail-open vs fail-closed decisions), and you can reason about load and degradation.

Nice to have:

 - Experience with agent tooling (MCP or similar), or serving traffic from AI agents and LLM clients.

 - Experience moving a service out of a larger codebase while keeping existing clients working.

 - Experience with Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Logflare or a similar observability stack, and real SLO work.
