jobs.title: Technical Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description:
ABOUT ABBY CARE: POWERING THE FUTURE OF CARE AT HOME FOR ALL OF AMERICA.


Abby Care is building the leading AI-native platform for family-led care. America is facing a growing care crisis. Millions more people need care at home than ever. Over 50 million family caregivers support loved ones without the tools, training, or recognition they deserve.

We believe families are the largest untapped caregiving workforce in America, and that technology can help them deliver better care while driving stronger outcomes and greater transparency across the healthcare system.

Abby Care combines clinical oversight with an AI-powered platform to train, enable, and support family caregivers in delivering high-quality care at home. Our platform helps health plans and government partners better understand, verify, and improve care in the home. We expand access to care, reduce reliance on higher-cost settings, and help ensure public dollars are spent effectively.

We are proud to partner with leading health plans, providers, and community organizations and are backed by top VCs. We envision a future where family-led care is a core part of the healthcare system. Abby Care is building that future.

Join us in solving one of the most important challenges of our time.



The Opportunity:



At Abby Care we are building an organization that is at the intersection of technology and healthcare delivery. Our goal is to build AI native platforms that drastically improve how caregivers deliver care, more efficiently and safely, and with better outcomes. We are excited to hire a Technology Talent Acquisition Partner to focus on sourcing, engaging and closing the best tech talent here in the SF Bay Area. Reporting to the Director of Talent Acquisition, you will partner with our leadership team across Engineering, Product, Analytics and Design to understand the profiles and personas who are attracted to mission driven work, while articulating our particular value proposition in an intensely competitive market.



A high performing individual contributor, you have a strong bias for action and a clearly defined owner mentality. You take pride in managing clear, structured processes end-to-end, and understand that the best tech candidates are the ones we source. Human-centered, understanding candidate motivations and connecting them to a mission is second nature, and you take pride in building teams that have real, tangible impact. You’re naturally data-driven, and are comfortable using data to tell the Talent story, and aren’t afraid to come to the table with a POV and subject matter expertise in Tech hiring. If you are excited about the opportunity to build a team with a high bar, and even higher goals, we’d love to hear from you.



This is a full-time role based in our San Francisco Headquarters with an expectation of 3-4 days a week in office. 



What you’ll work on:



 - Scale Abby Care’s technical teams across Engineering, Product and Data while delivering an expedient, elevated and transparent candidate experience.

 - Build and execute a multi-channel sourcing engine tailored to capture top-tier technical candidates in a competitive market.

 - Design rigorous technical assessments and evaluation frameworks that keep the hiring bar consistently high.

 - Serve as a strategic advisor to leadership on headcount prioritization, equity dynamics, and closing tactics.

 - Champion the Abby Care story through high-converting outbound campaigns, technical content, and community engagement.

 - Lead end-to-end offer strategies in partnership with TA and executive leadership to close critical hires.
   
   

What success looks like:



 - Accelerate early pipeline velocity by securing initial priority technical hires and cultivating a consistent engine of highly-vetted passive talent.

 - Establish seamless loop calibration with EPD leadership through standardized evaluation frameworks, optimized pass-through rates, and rapid interview throughput.

 - Serve as a high-impact strategic advisor on market equity and compensation while articulating our complex engineering roadmap through compelling outbound storytelling.



What you’ll have:


 - 5+ years of full-cycle technical recruiting experience (engineering, product, data).

 - Proven ability to source and close senior technical talent, including Lead, Manager and Director level roles in fast-paced or high-growth environments - specifically within the SF Bay Area. Focus on Applied AI roles strongly preferred.

 - Strong understanding of engineering concepts, stacks, architectures, and product development cycles.

 - Experience running 4-6+ active technical requisitions simultaneously.

 - Excellent communication skills, critical thinking skills, strong attention to detail, and ability to manage complex processes.

 - Metrics-driven with a focus on throughput, quality, and continuous improvement.

 - High ownership mindset, low ego, and ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

 - Comfort and familiarity with our recruiting stack: Ashby, Juicebox, LinkedIn Recruiter, Notion, Google Workspace, Slack




BENEFITS:



 - Competitive compensation packages that reflect the value you bring. We reward our team for the impact of their work.

 - Comprehensive health coverage that works for you. Choose from high-quality medical dental and vision options, including a $0 deductible PPO and a company-funded HSA, alongside employer-paid life and disability insurance.

 - Generous paid time off. We provide policies that allow you to recharge along with 10 paid company holidays.

 - Financial savings benefits to support your future. We support your financial well-being with HSA contributions, optional FSA and commuter benefits, and full coverage of all 401(k) account fees (employer match not currently offered).

 - Paid parental leave to support your growing family. We provide up to 10 weeks of paid parental leave based on tenure, so you can focus on bonding and adjusting to life as your family grows.






OUR VALUES

 1. Families First
    Redefining healthcare starts with how we treat the parents and children we serve. We go above and beyond for every family, building strong, lasting relationships. We continually ask ourselves, “Would we want this for our own families?”

 2. Urgency with Precision
    Millions of families are waiting for care, and they cannot wait, therefore this is not your typical 9 to 5 job. We match their urgency with our own, delivering exceptional care without compromise. Here, speed and excellence go hand in hand.

 3. Relentlessly Resourceful
    As an ambitious startup, we adapt quickly and make the most of limited time and resources. We solve challenges with creativity to deliver results without unnecessary complexity.

 4. Purpose with Positivity
    We take our mission seriously while never losing sight of the people behind the work. Respect, kindness, memes, and coffee make us stronger as a team and better for the families we serve.

 5. Driven to Redefine What’s Possible
    We are here to make healthcare better, which means asking hard questions, challenging outdated systems, and finding smarter, more compassionate ways to deliver care.



Equal Opportunity Employer

Abby Care is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis. If you have a disability and require reasonable accommodation during any portion of the application or hiring process, contact talent@abbycare.org.



Abby Care considers qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment and conducts background checks consistent with applicable law, including the California, Los Angeles County, San Francisco, Philadelphia, and New York City Fair Chance laws. jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Hardware Engineering is an innovative and collaborative group of electrical, mechanical, reliability, software and vehicle engineers. We design, build, and perfect the products which are the eyes and ears of Waymo's autonomous driving technology, and integrate those products into vehicle platforms. We're seeking curious and talented teammates to keep us moving in the right direction.

You will:

• Supplier Assembly Line Deployment: Lead the industrialization of "build to print" automotive autonomous sensors & ECUs (cameras, radars, lidars, compute) at external supplier partner facilities. Oversee the design, installation, and validation of automated and semi-automated assembly lines. Track production line readiness (PCBA and FATP) for all NPI builds and early production builds. Drive the resolution of open technical questions from external suppliers.

• Process Engineering & Quality: Ensure supplier manufacturing processes strictly adhere to engineering drawings, tolerances, and automotive quality standards. Drive the completion of DFxs, PFMEAs, Control Plans, MSA and capability studies (Cp/Cpk). Enforce structured equipment/station development with FMEA approach. Support ILQC audits and drive implementation of Preventative & Detective controls at external suppliers.

• Program Management: Act as the primary technical project manager for supplier launches. Establish realistic timelines, track milestones, manage equipment buy-offs (FAT/SAT), and ensure flawless execution through PPAP and Start of Production (SOP). Coordinate material supply to ensure the manufacturing development schedule stays on track. Ensure CMs have the latest BOMs and corresponding component specifications. Drive the mitigation of all process development / qualification risks that pose a threat to meeting the product performance and quality requirements.

• Contract & Commercial Management: Collaborate with Procurement and Legal to develop Statements of Work (SOW), technical specifications, and equipment contracts. Negotiate technical terms, manage change orders, and hold suppliers accountable to contractual obligations. Track suppliers Capex spend.

• Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the technical liaison between Internal R&D, Quality, Purchasing, and External manufacturing partners. Coordinate with Waymo cross-functional technical teams for support in debugging & resolving issues that impact manufacturing line qualification. Ensure compliance to defined requirements and manage any changes proposed by Waymo or external suppliers. Provide clear updates to Waymo management on the manufacturing process & test development & qualification status.

• Continuous Improvement: Identify manufacturing bottlenecks, yield issues, and cycle time constraints on supplier lines. Drive root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to optimize production efficiency and product quality. Identify key learnings from past projects and ensure target action items are fully executed. Ensure all proposed product or component changes are properly evaluated and appropriately implemented while mitigating associated risks for the production / equipment processes.

You have:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.

• Experience: 10+ years of experience in process or manufacturing engineering within the automotive industry, with direct experience handling automotive sensors, ECUs or complex electronic assemblies.

• Technical Skills: Deep understanding of "build to print" manufacturing models, automated assembly processes, testing/calibration of sensors, and automotive core tools (APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, SPC, MSA).

• Supplier Management: Proven ability to drive Tier 1/Tier 2 suppliers and equipment integrators to meet strict launch deadlines and quality metrics.

• Commercial Acumen: Hands-on experience reviewing, negotiating, and executing technical contracts, SOWs, and capital equipment agreements.

• Program Management: Strong project management skills. PMP certification is a strong plus.

We prefer:

• Advanced Manufacturing Experience: Hands-on experience with automation, active alignment (AA) of optical lenses, precision automated adhesive/TIM dispensing, UV curing, wire bonding, or cleanroom manufacturing (ISO Class 5-7).

• Specialized Testing Knowledge: Familiarity with end-of-line (EOL) functional testing for ECUs, optical target rooms for cameras/LiDAR, or RF testing in anechoic chambers for radar.

• Certifications: Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.

• Software Proficiency: Experience using statistical analysis software (e.g., Minitab, JMP) to analyze supplier yield data, and basic proficiency in CAD (e.g., CATIA, SolidWorks) to review engineering prints and supplier DFM feedback.

• Industry Standards: Deep working knowledge of TS16949, ISO 26262 (Functional Safety) and ASPICE, specifically how they dictate manufacturing traceability, serialization, and line-side controls.

Travel requirements:

• 30% to travel domestically and internationally to supplier manufacturing sites as required during critical launch phases.

The expected base salary range for this full-time position across US locations is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the role location or, if the role can be performed remote, the specific salary range for your preferred location, during the hiring process.

Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

Salary Range

$230,000—$284,000 USD

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
About Figure

Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale, and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.

Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.

We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies.

About the Role

We are seeking a Solutions Engineer to architect and scale technical integrations for mortgage lending partners. This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Engineering and is responsible for designing integration solutions, accelerating onboarding, and ensuring partners fully leverage our API, webhook, and identity infrastructure.

You will work with enterprise and institutional partners from technical discovery through integration and early scale as a trusted technical advisor. You will work directly with partners to ensure implementations are robust and scalable. Your core responsibilities will include:

• Designing and documenting integration architectures, workflows, and data exchanges.

• Guiding partners through implementation using clear technical best practices.

• Proactively mitigating integration risks to accelerate onboarding and troubleshoot complex issues during implementation and early production.

Over time, you will help build more scalable onboarding infrastructure - including documentation, integration templates, and reusable patterns - to enable efficient, repeatable partner launches.

What You'll Do

Technical Discovery & Solution Architecture

• Lead technical discovery sessions with prospective and signed partners.

• Understand partner systems (CRM, LOS, servicing platforms, identity providers).

• Design scalable API and webhook integration architectures.

• Recommend preferred implementation patterns and identify edge cases and platform constraints early.

• Document solution designs for internal and external stakeholders.

Integration Enablement & Acceleration

• Serve as the primary technical advisor during API onboarding.

• Guide partners through REST API, webhook, authentication, and SSO flows.

• Support sandbox testing and production readiness.

• Reduce integration time by standardizing implementation patterns.

• Bridge partner engineering teams with internal Product and Engineering.

Post-Launch Optimization & Expansion

• Identify opportunities to expand API and real-time data usage.

• Improve partner workflows to increase throughput and ROI.

• Surface product gaps with structured technical feedback.

• Contribute to improved documentation and integration playbooks.

What We’re Looking For

• 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role. Fintech and Lending experience is a big plus.

• Strong fluency with APIs and integration patterns (REST, JSON, webhooks), including the ability to design and debug end-to-end integrations.

• Deep understanding of authentication and identity standards (OAuth 2.0, SAML, SCIM) and secure system design principles.

• Proven experience partnering with enterprise engineering teams to implement scalable, production-grade integrations.

• Ability to architect full system workflows and data exchanges — not just explain endpoints — with clear tradeoff analysis.

• Experience translating ambiguous partner requirements into structured technical implementation plans and strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex technical issues across distributed systems.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with an affinity for technical documentation.

• Comfortable influencing cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Compliance, Partnerships) and providing actionable product feedback.

• Experience in fintech (or regulated financial services environments) and familiarity integrating with CRMs, Loan Origination Systems (LOS), and other financial platforms is a plus.

• Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.

• Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.

• Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

• 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly

• Company equity in the form of RSUs

While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

jobs.title: Workplace Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.

About the team/role

Our Workplace Operations and Talent Coordinator, reporting into Workplace, will be essential to the Workplace team's function and will hugely impact our company culture and workplace experience. We are looking for someone with great operational prowess, an upbeat and approachable attitude, impeccable customer service skills, and a willingness to cultivate the best employee experience for Checkrs!

What you'll do

• Support daily facilities operations in our Nashville office in coordination with the Checkr Workplace Operations Team. This includes assisting with janitorial services, HVAC maintenance, food services, badge and security management, and resolving general maintenance issues promptly and effectively.

• Partner with the Talent team to support onsite interviews: greeting candidates, managing breaks between interviews and additional talent and recruiting responsibilities. Assist with scheduling on occasion.

• Build strong working relationships with HR business partners (HRBPs), internal Checkr Resource Groups (CRGs), local management, and other stakeholders within Checkr to help implement employee experience strategies that enhance workplace satisfaction and productivity.

• Staff the front desk during absences and break periods, and provide coverage for Workplace team members during absences.

• Help implement the hybrid work strategy developed by the Workplace Operations leadership team to ensure effective operational continuity across different work arrangements.

• Support and help enhance employee experiences across the lifecycle from onboarding to off-boarding, including assisting with offboarding processes and presenting at new hire orientations.

• Coordinate and help execute engaging intra-office events for local Nashville Checkrs that reflect company culture and foster team cohesion, including site setup, item and food sourcing, and cleanup.

• In coordination with the Nashville Workplace team, help oversee daily lunch service and the snack and beverage program, organizing food needs for group meetings, internal employee meetings, and offsites.

• Support various project and program implementations to create smooth, transparent experiences for all employees, including coordinating with teams and tracking timelines.

• Assist in managing relationships with property management, coordinating necessary building operations and maintenance.

• Help manage shared audio-visual spaces within the Nashville office, resolving basic technical issues and ensuring these resources are used effectively.

What you bring

• 1-3 years of operational, people ops, talent and/or facilities-related experience; internships or relevant coursework welcome. A strong interest in creating and delivering great employee experiences.

• Enthusiasm for supporting and executing successful events.

• Familiarity with (or willingness to quickly learn) Zoom Rooms, A/V technologies, GSuite, and Slack to support effective communication and collaboration.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with all levels from vendors to executives. Demonstrated ability to collaborate across different functions and with a range of stakeholders.

• Comfort working within a fast-paced office environment, and capability to work efficiently in the physical Nashville office daily.

• Willingness to work overtime periodically. Sometimes early days, sometimes late weekdays, and very rarely weekends for office moves or large capital project executions.

• An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Pay Transparency Disclosure

We use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop ranges for our roles and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range. If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. For more information on our compensation philosophy, see our website.

Hourly Pay Range (Nashville, TN)

$27.89—$32.70 USD

What We Offer

• A fast-paced and collaborative environment

• Learning and development allowance

• Competitive cash and equity compensation, and opportunity for advancement

• 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Up to $25K reimbursement for fertility, adoption, and parental planning services

• Flexible PTO policy

• Monthly wellness stipend

At Checkr, we believe an in office work environment strengthens collaboration, drives innovation, and encourages connection. Our hub locations are Denver, CO; San Francisco, CA; Nashville, TN; and Santiago, Chile. Individuals are expected to work from the office 3+ days a week. In-office perks are provided, such as lunch five times a week, a commuter stipend, and an abundance of snacks and beverages. A relocation stipend may be available for those willing to relocate to a Checkr hub location.

Equal Employment Opportunities at Checkr
Checkr is committed to building the best product and company, which requires hiring talented and qualified individuals with a diverse set of perspectives and lived experiences. Checkr believes in hiring people of all backgrounds, including those whose histories are impacted by the justice system in accordance with local, state, and/or federal laws, including the San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance.

Applicant Privacy Policy
If you are a California resident or are located in Alberta or British Columbia, our Applicant Privacy Policy applies to our collection and processing of your personal information when you apply for a role with us or otherwise participate in our recruitment process.

For applicants in Massachusetts: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: Senior TA Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

The role

You will be the hands-on operator behind our Workday work and a key resolver for our core recruiting systems. In the near term you will help test and implement Workday for Talent Acquisition, then support it and improve its processes after go-live. Alongside that, you will resolve issues across Greenhouse and ChartHop for the core processes that recruiters and coordinators depend on, such as backfills and conversions. You will spot patterns in what breaks and fix the process, not just the ticket.

What you will do

Workday testing and implementation

• Partner with the Workday project team and TA stakeholders to document requirements, write and run test scenarios, and track and retest defects.

• Coordinate user acceptance testing with recruiters, coordinators, and business partners, and make sure issues are resolved before go-live.

• Validate data and process flows between Workday and our other TA systems, and help prepare cutover, training materials, and communications.

Workday support and improvement after go-live

• Be a first point of escalation for Workday questions and issues from TA, resolving what you can and routing the rest with clear context.

• Iterate on processes after launch: gather feedback, find friction, and propose and test improvements.

• Keep process documentation and job aids current as configuration and workflows change.

Core systems resolution (Greenhouse and ChartHop)

• Resolve system issues that affect core processes, including backfills, conversions, and requisition and headcount alignment between systems.

• Investigate data and sync discrepancies, fix the root cause where you can, and escalate with a clear summary where you cannot.

• Handle support tickets and requests with consistent quality and response times.

Continuous improvement

• Track recurring issues and questions, identify root causes, and recommend changes to configuration, process, or training.

• Partner with the enablement team so recurring questions become better training and guidance.

• Help define process around outcomes and actual tool usage, so the tools get used correctly and consistently.

How the role evolves

Early on, your time is split between Workday testing and implementation and core systems resolution. After go-live, the balance shifts toward Workday support and process improvement, while core systems resolution continues. As the Workday footprint grows, this role is a natural path toward leading larger systems projects, initiatives, and process improvement for TA to meet increasingly complex and scaling business needs.

US Salary Range

$101,000—$135,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

POSITION TITLE: EVENT OPERATIONS COORDINATOR

On board experiential marketing

OBE is a global marketing agency that brings brands to life through culture-shaping experiences. For more than 30 years, we've partnered with iconic brands — including Nike, the NFL, JPMorganChase, Meta, Sephora, Starbucks, and Converse — to build community, create cultural relevance, and drive measurable business impact. With offices in Los Angeles, New York, San Francisco, and London, we activate globally. OBE is also a founding member of The ADD Collective, extending our reach and resources while staying true to our core capabilities.

We've been recognized by Event Marketer as one of the best places to work in events — and we couldn't agree more.

The most important part of our business is our people. They are hardworking, imaginative, and make genuinely remarkable things happen. But behind every great activation is a human who deserves rest, connection, and a life outside of work. That's why we invest in recovery days, company offsites, happy hours, and the kind of friendly-but-competitive fitness challenges that bond teams for life.

We show up for each other — in open conversations that heal, inspire, and bring us closer. We want to hear about your lived experiences, your unconventional ideas, and the perspectives only you can bring. Being unapologetically yourself isn't just welcome here. It's part of the job.

SUMMARY OF POSITION

The Event Operations Coordinator is an integral part of the team responsible for successful management and production of our programs. Reporting to a senior Event Operations team member, this person performs various duties in the planning, development, activation and wrap up stages of both client programs and internal initiatives, both in office and onsite. The Event Operations Coordinator helps ensure the highest quality of service in the performance of the approved client statement of work so that all deliverables are executed with the utmost in professionalism, accountability, skill, and timeliness, thus successfully meeting program objectives at the highest level of client and agency satisfaction.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

• Prepare materials, documents, meeting agendas, and communications to client and internal teams.

• Support in tracking deliverables across Event Operations and cross functional teams (Production, Creative, Strategy, Tech), update key documents.

• Participate in weekly status meetings both internal and external as required, capturing detailed and accurate notes and action items.

• Ensure assigned areas of program responsibilities are successfully completed, delivered, and implemented during pre-production planning phase.

• Successfully manage areas of program execution onsite

• Participate in program tear down meetings, internal & client recap decks, and client KPI measurement reporting.

• Join or lead internal agency initiatives & task forces, offsite planning for department and agency needs.

DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Education / Experience

• BA/BS in marketing, business administration, communications, or related field.

• 1 - 3 years’ experience in marketing, promotions, and/or events, including on-site event experience. Experiential marketing agency experience preferred.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

• Strong interpersonal communication skills

• Ability to interact, internally, and with clients, at various organizational levels.

• Ability to connect with others authentically while equally honoring and respecting diverse perspectives.

• Ability to build trust and respect through communication and listening.

• Think creatively, with willingness to extend beyond the unexpected and consistently strive for innovation.

• Experience with brand management, ensuring brand integrity and quality is consistently maintained.

• Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and excellent organizational skills.

• Ability to navigate competing priorities and deadlines with ease.

• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and within teams.

• Pulse on social media trends and an understanding of how to utilize online methods to promote engagement.

• Must be able to work in a collaborative manner both internally and with clients.

• Ability to learn and navigate various office management platforms (inclusive of but not limited to Office 365, Keynote, Google Drive, Smartsheet, Slack, Zoom, etc)

Other Qualities and Skills

• Natural curiosity—the drive to always be learning and growing, professionally and personally.

• High energy and flexibility in working non-traditional hours as needed (some nights and weekends as deadlines dictate).

• Ability to lift up to 25 pounds and stay on your feet for extended periods of time.

• Willingness to work a hybrid schedule (at least 2 days in office) and travel up to 50% of the time.

Compensation Range: $70,304 - $77,652 annually. This is the pay range OBE believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the level of experience, relevant skills, professional certifications, market pay, and demand for the role. OBE reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. For this role, Benefits include medical/dental/vision insurance, employer-paid basic life and personal accident insurance. Also included: Annual Profit Sharing/Bonus Plan based on the company’s performance and your individual performance, 401(k), Healthcare Flexible Spending Account, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, PTO, STD/LTD insurance benefits.

On Board Experiential is An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other federally protected class.

jobs.title: H&M Sales Advisor (Seasonal) - Quail Springs Mall
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Sales Advisor, you'll be responsible for providing excellent customer service, welcoming & guiding customers through your store to actively sell our products and providing customers with support & guidance. You'll use your fashion and product knowledge to provide our customers with all the relevant information they need for the best experience. You'll also work on garment refill & care, presentation and contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house, working closely with the rest of your store team to deliver an excellent customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Provide excellent customer service: welcoming & guiding customers through the store & OMNI experience where available, supporting them with direct customer service
• Willingness to engage and have conversations with customers to provide excellent service
• Guide customers through our fashion trends, stories & products in all areas of the store
• Ability to effectively promote and sell our products to customers
• Actively promote our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during all customer interactions
• Support with commercial or operational actions to reach sales targets with store management team

General Information

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors, and relevant influencers, etc.
• Use your product & fashion knowledge to share relevant information to customers

Team & Development

• Retain and share your service, fashion and store operations knowledge and skills with colleagues
• Follow all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding, introduction processes & trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Complete full garment cycle from unpacking and refill to steaming and ensure good garment care
• Operate fitting room and checkout areas according to best practice & processes
• Contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house (including stockrooms)
• Support with garment presentation, execution and maintain attractive merchandise displays, clear trends & stories according to visual & commercial guidelines
• Ensure good stock levels with replenishment routines on sales floor
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Support with opening and closing of the store
• Following all H&S guidelines and legal requirements applicable to role and responsibilities

Who You Are

• As a Sales Advisor, you'll be passionate about fashion and everything we create in-store.
• Motivated by giving customers a great experience.
• You should also be communicative, creative and curious, motivated, flexible, decisive, and action-oriented.
• You should also enjoy working in a collaborative and dynamic environment.
• You have sales experience working in a dynamic and collaborative environment that you can apply to your role
• Experience working with customer service in fashion, retail or other service-related industries

Why You'll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You'll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you're encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You'll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Job Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $13.50 per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: People Operations Manager
jobs.description:

About the role

Grüns is scaling fast, and our People team needs a hands-on partner who can coach managers and run the operational engine at the same time. You'll be the first line of support for managers and employees on policy, performance, and growth, while owning payroll, leaves, benefits, and the employee lifecycle end to end. You'll step in during a major Q1 2027 systems transition, protecting talent density, keeping pay and compliance airtight, and freeing our People leadership to focus on strategy.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

• Be the first point of contact for managers and employees on policy, performance, corrective feedback, and growth

• Coach managers on feedback, documentation, and follow-ups, with hands-on support through performance and termination situations that keep talent density high and legal risk low

• Run People Team 1:1s and exit interviews for Levels 1 and 2, and surface culture themes, flight risks, and training gaps for our quarterly People Pulse report

• Administer leaves (FMLA, ADA, state, STD, parental) and accommodation requests from start to finish, and oversee workers' comp claims

• Own payroll accuracy across HQ, field, and international teams by resolving complications directly with our partners and tracking every issue to closure

• Own benefits administration end to end: enrollments, qualifying life events, COBRA, carrier coordination, renewals, and clear employee communication

• Own onboarding and offboarding, so every new hire starts with complete paperwork and correct pay, and every exit closes out cleanly on final pay, benefits notices, and access

• Keep employee data clean (levels, titles, departments, managers, compensation) so comp, survey, and headcount decisions are always backed by accurate data

• Support employees through our Q1 2027 payroll, benefits, and retirement platform changes

• Turn repeat work into AI-supported workflows, and know when AI shouldn't be involved

We're looking for someone who:

• Has 5+ years scaling HR support, ideally on a coordinator to HRBP to HR Generalist track in a fast-growing consumer or DTC company

• Has hands-on payroll administration experience

• Has run leaves (FMLA, ADA, state leaves, STD, parental) and workers' comp end to end

• Has administered benefits: enrollments, qualifying life events, COBRA, and open enrollment

• Has a track record in employee relations and manager coaching, including performance documentation and terminations

• Has handled sensitive employee situations and exits with discretion and good judgment

• Has working knowledge of FMLA, ADA, COBRA, E-Verify, and multi-state leave and final pay laws

• You bring a customer service mindset: you acknowledge fast, focus on solutions, and can't rest until every loop is closed

• You build real relationships and stay culture-aligned while making decisions in the best interest of Grüns

• You have extreme ownership and self-motivation, so micromanagement isn't needed because you're always 10 steps ahead

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $100,000 - $130,000 plus bonus depending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

The Lucas Museum of Narrative Art is dedicated to illustrated storytelling.  Founded by George Lucas and Mellody Hobson, the museum’s collection features works by artists including Norman Rockwell, Kadir Nelson, Jessie Willcox Smith, N. jobs.title: Staff Materials & Process Engineer
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:
Awerx is a team within Relativity Space building agentic design tools for aerospace. The team focuses on agentic mechanical engineering and advanced manufacturing: systems that reason about geometry, materials, and process alongside the engineers who use them. The goal is design tools that produce parts that are not just analyzable, but buildable, qualifiable, and right the first time. You’ll work where software meets hardware, turning hard-won shop-floor knowledge into tools that change how aerospace hardware gets designed and built.

This role requires on-site presence at least three days per week, with flexibility to work remotely when the work allows. Much of the work is hands-on and best done alongside the engineers and hardware it supports.

About the Role:
As a Staff Materials and Process Engineer, you’ll bring deep metallurgical and manufacturing-process expertise into the Awerx design-for-manufacturing (DFM) systems. You’ll turn what you know about how metals solidify, deform, crack, and machine into the rules, models, and constraints our agents use to design and plan aerospace hardware. The focus is hybrid manufacturing. That means multi-additive routes that combine processes such as sintered metal powder and wire arc additive manufacturing (WAAM), and additive-plus-subtractive workflows that pair deposition with CNC finishing. Few tools reason well about these process chains today. You’ll help define how ours should, then build coupons and parts to prove it.

• Encode metallurgy and process knowledge into Awerx DFM systems as design rules, process windows, material models, and manufacturability checks, including how agents reason about multi-additive builds, process interfaces, and deposition-to-machining handoffs

• Develop process guidance for directed energy deposition (WAAM and other DED), CNC machining, and their combination, covering near-net-shape allowances, fixturing, distortion, and inspection access

• Characterize how process route drives microstructure, residual stress, defects, and properties in nickel superalloys, copper alloys, aluminum, and titanium, and build the materials and process datasets the agents depend on, with clear provenance and uncertainty

• Plan and run validation programs hands-on in lab and shop environments, including coupons, test articles, heat treatment, NDE, metallography, and mechanical testing, to confirm or correct what the tools predict

• Lead materials and process qualification of hybrid-manufactured hardware, including qualification plans, process controls, and statistically based design allowables in line with NAVSEA requirements and MMPDS methodology

• Collaborate with software engineers, designers, Relativity’s production, materials, and quality teams, and outside suppliers to specify and review tool features, evaluate agent-generated designs and process plans, and turn tacit shop knowledge and recurring failure modes into clear, explicit constraints

About You:

• Bachelor’s degree in Materials Science, Metallurgy, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

• 10+ years of materials and process engineering experience on aerospace or other high-reliability metal hardware

• Expertise in physical metallurgy across nickel superalloys, copper alloys, aluminum, and titanium, including solidification, phase transformations, heat treatment, and defect formation

• Hands-on experience developing or qualifying directed energy deposition processes (WAAM, laser DED, or electron-beam DED) and integrating them with CNC machining

• Experience designing and running test programs (coupons, metallography, NDE, mechanical testing) and generating statistically based design allowables (A- and B-basis) to NAVSEA, MMPDS, or comparable requirements

• Proficiency in Python or a similar language for data analysis and scripting

Nice to haves but not required:

• PhD in Materials Science, Metallurgy, or a related field

• Experience with sintered-powder routes (binder jet, metal injection molding, press-and-sinter) or laser powder bed fusion, including multi-material or bimetallic interfaces such as copper-to-superalloy transitions

• Experience with ICME, CALPHAD, or thermo-mechanical process simulation for additive manufacturing, or with CAM and deposition path planning

• Experience qualifying additive parts for flight under NASA-STD-6030 or comparable standards, or applying machine learning to materials or process data

At Relativity Space, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation practices. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Compensation is only one part of our total rewards package. Relativity Space offers competitive salary and equity, a generous PTO and sick leave policy, parental leave, an annual learning and development stipend, and more! To see some of the benefits & perks we offer, please visit here.

jobs.title: Field CISO
jobs.description:
What we do:
Halcyon is the industry’s first dedicated, adaptive security platform that combines multiple proprietary advanced prevention engines along with AI models focused specifically on stopping ransomware.

Who we are:
Halcyon was formed in 2021 by a team of cyber industry veterans after battling the scourge of ransomware (and advanced threats) for years at some of the largest global security vendors. Comprised of leaders from Cylance (now Blackberry), Accuvant (now Optiv), Fireye and ISS X-Force (now IBM), Halcyon is focused on building products and solutions for mid-market and enterprise customers.

As a remote-native, completely distributed global team, we recognize great talent can exist anywhere. We invite you to apply to a job you’re interested in and we'll work a plan to meet your needs.

Field Chief Information Security Officer (Field CISO)

Role Overview
The Field CISO is a customer-facing executive who serves as a trusted security advisor to prospects, customers, and partners. This role bridges security leadership and go-to-market strategy, helping accelerate revenue and strengthen market credibility by translating complex security challenges into clear business outcomes.

Unlike an internal CISO, this position does not manage internal security operations. Instead, it focuses on enabling sales success and building trust with executive stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Go-To-Market & Revenue Enablement

• Partner with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to drive pipeline growth, accelerate deals, support closures, make strategic introductions, and deliver positive outcomes.

• Serve as the executive security voice in late-stage sales cycles, board-level discussions, and strategic customer engagements.

• Lead security-focused meetings, including architecture reviews, risk assessments, and executive briefings.

• Navigate complex buyer dynamics involving CISOs, CIOs, risk, legal, and compliance stakeholders.

• Provide actionable insights to influence GTM strategy, pricing, and positioning.

Market & Thought Leadership

• Represent the company as a security leader at conferences, webinars, and executive roundtables.

• Contribute to thought leadership through blogs, whitepapers, and industry commentary.

• Build credibility in new markets and verticals through public engagement and strategic relationships.

Customer Advocacy & Trust

• Develop long-term relationships with CISOs and security executives.

• Act as a trusted advisor during critical discussions, audits, or regulatory reviews.

• Help customers articulate security value to their boards and leadership teams.

Success Metrics

• Impact on pipeline growth, deal velocity, and win rates.

• Executive engagement and customer satisfaction.

• Adoption of security messaging in GTM activities.

• Market visibility and thought leadership reach.

Qualifications

• 10+ years in cybersecurity or technology leadership, with prior CISO or equivalent experience.

• Strong understanding of enterprise security domains (cloud, identity, risk, compliance).

• Proven ability to communicate complex security topics to executive audiences.

• Experience in high-trust, customer-facing roles within fast-paced environments.

Preferred:

• Background in B2B SaaS or security vendors.

• Experience in regulated industries (finance, healthcare, and government).

• Established network of security executives.

Halcyon offers the following benefits to eligible employees:

• Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, and vision) with premiums paid in full for employees and dependents.

• Short and long-term disability coverage, basic life and AD&D insurance plans.

• Medical and dependent care FSA options.

• 401k plan with a generous employer contribution.

• Flexible PTO policy.

• Parental leave.

• Generous equity offerings.

The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.

The expected base salary range for this position is $200,000 - $250.000 Compensation varies based on a variety of factors which include (but are not limited to) role level, skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, location, and experience. In addition to base pay, certain roles are eligible to participate in our bonus or commission plans, as well as our benefits offers, and equity awards.

jobs.title: AI Silicon Performance Modeling and Analysis Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

About the Role and Team

The AI Silicon Architecture and Performance Engineering team is responsible for developing and maintaining performance models that enable architecture exploration, design evaluation, scalability analysis, and performance projection for next-generation AI silicon products. These models are a critical component of the product development process, providing early visibility into architectural tradeoffs, bottlenecks, and optimization opportunities long before silicon availability.

We are seeking a highly experienced and motivated engineer to drive AI silicon performance modeling, validation, architectural analysis, and stakeholder engagement activities. The candidate will work closely with architects, performance stimulus generation teams, silicon design teams, and product stakeholders to evaluate and optimize key AI silicon subsystems that determine overall platform scalability and performance.

The role focuses on performance modeling and analysis of AI SoC communication fabrics, memory subsystems, scale-up and scale-out interconnects, host-device memory paths, and end-to-end data movement infrastructure. The successful candidate will leverage SystemC/TLM-based modeling methodologies to generate actionable insights that directly influence architecture and product decisions.

This position requires a unique combination of software development expertise, architecture understanding, analytical problem solving, and cross-functional technical leadership. The engineer will be expected to independently drive complex technical initiatives while serving as a trusted performance expert across multiple organizations.

Key Responsibilities:

AI Silicon Performance Model Development

• Implement new architectural features and capabilities based on evolving product requirements.
• Improve model fidelity, scalability, maintainability, and simulation performance.

• Perform detailed debugging and root-cause analysis of model issues and performance anomalies.

• Contribute to the evolution of modeling infrastructure, methodologies, and best practices.
• Develop, maintain, and enhance SystemC/TLM-based performance models representing critical AI silicon subsystems.

• Drive modeling of key architectural components including:SoC fabrics and on-chip communication networksMemory controllers and memory subsystem behaviorScale-up controllers and fabrics enabling accelerator-to-accelerator communication within a node, tray, or podScale-out controllers and fabrics enabling communication across nodes, racks, and larger AI clustersHost CPU to accelerator memory pathsLocal, host, and remote memory access pathsEnd-to-end data movement architectures

Functional Validation and Model Correlation:

• Define and execute comprehensive validation strategies to ensure correctness and architectural accuracy of performance models.
• Develop validation plans, regression suites, coverage methodologies, and quality metrics.
• Correlate modeled behavior against architectural expectations, reference simulations, performance projections, and available hardware measurements.
• Investigate and resolve discrepancies between expected and observed behavior.
• Establish robust validation frameworks that improve stakeholder confidence in model-generated performance projections.
• Continuously improve validation methodologies and model quality.

AI Silicon Performance Characterization and Architectural Analysis:

• Design and execute performance studies covering a wide range of workloads, traffic patterns, and system configurations.
• Analyze performance of communication fabrics, memory systems, and data movement paths under representative AI workloads.
• Evaluate bandwidth utilization, latency characteristics, congestion behavior, traffic distribution, buffering efficiency, and resource utilization.
• Characterize interactions across local memory, host memory, and remote memory domains.
• Assess scalability of scale-up and scale-out architectures across increasingly larger deployment footprints.
• Identify performance bottlenecks and quantify their impact on overall system throughput and efficiency.
• Conduct architectural tradeoff studies to evaluate alternative design approaches.
• Provide performance-driven recommendations that influence architecture and product decisions.

Performance Data Generation, Analytics and Visualization:

• Develop frameworks and methodologies for large-scale performance data generation and analysis.
• Create automated workflows for data collection, processing, correlation, and reporting.
• Develop performance dashboards and visualization tools that simplify interpretation of complex performance data.
• Define and track meaningful performance KPIs and architectural metrics.
• Utilize Python-based analysis frameworks to process large datasets and generate actionable insights.
• Enable efficient consumption of performance information by architects, designers, and engineering leadership.

Cross-Functional Technical Leadership and Stakeholder Engagement:

• Partner closely with architecture teams, performance stimulus generation teams, silicon design teams, and product stakeholders.
• Drive technical discussions related to performance methodology, architectural assumptions, workload behavior, scalability analysis, and bottleneck identification.
• Review architectural proposals and provide performance-driven feedback.
• Present performance studies, technical findings, and architectural recommendations to engineering leadership.
• Influence product and architecture decisions through data-backed analysis and sound engineering judgment.
• Act as a key technical bridge between architecture, modeling, and performance analysis organizations.

Methodology Development and Team Growth:

• Drive improvements in modeling methodologies, simulation efficiency, and analysis workflows.
• Identify opportunities for automation across modeling, validation, performance analysis, and reporting activities.
• Establish best practices for model quality, performance characterization, and architectural analysis.
• Contribute to technical mentoring and knowledge sharing across the team.
• Support the development of junior engineers and future team growth initiatives.
• Help cultivate a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate should show the following behavioral traits:

• Strong quantitative reasoning and data-driven decision-making skills. Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills
• Strong communication and collaboration skills.
• Presentation (technical) and stakeholder management skills.
• Influence engineering decisions through rigorous analysis and technical credibility.
• Operate independently and deliver results in ambiguous problem spaces.
• Independently solve complex technical problems.

Qualifications:

Minimum qualifications, you must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics Engineering.

• 6+ years of industry experience in:

• Performance modeling, AI silicon architecture, SoC architecture, computer architecture, performance engineering, or related domains.SoC architecture, including on-chip communication fabrics, NoC concepts, high-speed interconnects, and scale-up/scale-out communication architectures.Memory subsystem architecture, including memory controllers, cache hierarchies, data movement, and latency/bandwidth characterization and performance bottleneck analysis.Software development experience in C++.Working proficiency in Python for automation, performance analysis, data processing, and visualization.Hands-on experience with SystemC and Transaction-Level Modeling (TLM) methodologies.Experience developing or validating performance models for AI accelerators, SoCs, CPUs, GPUs, networking products, or complex hardware systems.Performing architectural tradeoff analysis and performance debug and characterization studies.

This position is not eligible for Intel immigration sponsorship.

Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

• Deep understanding of AI accelerator architectures and modern AI infrastructure.
• Experience modeling memory, communication, interconnect, or scalability-related subsystems.
• Experience with Network-on-Chip (NoC) architecture and interconnect performance analysis.
• Understanding of scale-up and scale-out architectures used in modern AI computing platforms.
• Familiarity with AI/ML workloads, large language models, distributed training, and inference environments.
• Experience with performance stimulus generation methodologies and workload characterization.
• Experience building automated dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, Grafana, Plotly, or similar technologies.
• Experience evaluating large-scale distributed AI systems and accelerator clusters.
• Experience mentoring engineers and providing technical leadership in cross-functional environments.

jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

The Role and Impact

As a GPU Software Development Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing and developing software solutions that enable Intel's GPUs, ranging from firmware and device drivers to APIs and application layers. You will work on cutting-edge kernel-level features that drive functionality, power management, and performance optimization for integrated and discrete graphics products. Your contributions will directly shape immersive visual experiences for millions of users, ensuring Intel's leadership in graphics technologies.

Business Group

We are the Windows Kernel Mode Driver Team within Intel's Client Graphics IP group of DCG. Our primary objective is the development and deployment of robust and performant Windows kernel GPU drivers.  These drivers are instrumental in unleashing the full potential of Intel's integrated and discrete GPU hardware for user-space clients, games, and applications.

Our focus lies in managing critical low-level functions, including device activation, reset and power state transitions, workload submission, power conservation, and scheduling, as well as collaboration with System-on-Chip (SOC) Intellectual Properties (IPs). With this charter, we conceive, create, and verify software solutions that serve as the link between user-space applications and the underlying GPU and SOC.  If you thrive in an environment that involves working on system-level software, with regular exposure to diverse domains such as graphics rendering, firmware, SOC, and power management, then a role on our Kernel Mode Driver Team is where you should be.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop, validate, and optimize GPU kernel-mode drivers for Windows operating systems.
• Collaborate on implementing low-level features, including device activation, power management, and workload scheduling for integrated and discrete GPUs.
• Design and debug firmware and software features related to GPU hardware and accompanying System-on-Chip (SOC) components.
• Analyze telemetry and resolve complex issues across layers of driver stacks, domains, and IP integration.
• Contribute to the creation of test frameworks, workload automation, and validation methodologies to ensure high-quality code delivery.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position:
